articleTitle: Review and Generalization of the Orthogonality of Scattering Characteristic Modes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Scattering characteristic modes (CMs) are a set of independent and complete fundamental working modes of the objective scatterer. The CMs satisfy a series of valuable features, such as the energy decoupling feature expressed as field-current interaction and the field-field orthogonality feature expressed as field-field interaction. The features have become the theoretical foundation of the CM-based engineering applications. In this paper, both the energy decoupling and field-field orthogonality features are simply reviewed first, and then the field-field orthogonality feature is further generalized.

articleTitle: A Da-Shaped Slotted Circularly-Polarization Antenna for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a Da-shaped slotted antenna, where the Chinese culture is integrated into the antenna design to achieve an artistic antenna that can be used in 5G communication system. The designed antenna has circular polarization characteristic, which is composed of ground plane, dielectric layer and metal sheet A engraved with Da-shaped slot, and a U-shaped wall (metal sheet B). A simple L-shaped feed probe is used to improve the working bandwidth of the antenna. A U-shaped metal sheet B is considered to improve antenna gain and axial ratio bandwidth. The simulation and optimization results show that the axial ratio bandwidth is 2.30-2.71GHz, and the impedance bandwidth is 2.44-2.7GHz, both of which can cover operating frequency in the range of 2.515-2.675GHz of 5G.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-layer Metamaterial Absorbers Using Kriging Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The multi-layer metamaterial absorbers (MMAs) are designed by using Kriging surrogate model. By selecting different metamaterial models from the metamaterial database, metamaterial absorbers used in different wavebands can be designed quickly. In this paper, the six MMAs are designed through kriging model. Their absorptivity greater than 90% has been achieved at the important radar band within 4-18GHz respectively.

articleTitle: A Novel Mandelbrot Fractal Microstrip Antenna with Fourth Set Degree and Different Iteration Numbers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel fractal microstrip antenna based on the Mandelbrot-set geometries with an iteration number of 3, 5 and 20. The Mandelbrot fractal geometry is designed from a circular geometry and can intrinsically enable a size reduction for patch elements. In the design, the key step of converting a bitmap shape into an emulate-able antenna design is introduced and the influence of Mandelbrot fractal patch geometry with different iterations on the performance of antennas is simulated and analyzed. Simulations show that the proposed Mandelbrot fractal antennas have a good performance in gains, radiation patterns, and reduction of dimensions, and could be very useful for millimeter-wave communications.

articleTitle: A Circularly Polarized Antenna for GPS L1 band with U-Shaped-Like Strips
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A U-shaped-like parasitic strip loading antenna is proposed and designed, which can work in L1 band of GPS with circular polarization (CP) characteristics. The antenna consists of ground plane, dielectric, radiation patch and U-shaped-like parasitic strips using a simple coaxial feed probe. The asymmetric U-shaped-like strips are to realize CP. The simulation and optimization results for the modeled directional CP antenna show that the axial ratio bandwidth is 10MHz and the impedance bandwidth is 30MHz, which can meet the requirements for GPS L1 band.

articleTitle: Single-Layer Dual-Band Circularly Polarized Reflectarray Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel unit cell for the design of dual-band dual-circular polarized offset reflectarray is proposed.The cell consists of a top metallic layer, a single dielectric layer and a metallic ground, which can enables full 360° phase adjustment simultaneously by the variable rotation technique(VRT) in two separted frequency bands. Compared with multilayer antenna,the proposed element adopts single layer,hence yielding lower cost and fabrication with lower complexity. Finally, a reflectarray prototype has been designed to radiates LHCP at 19.1 GHz and RHCP at 29.1 GHz.The results are satisfactory and will be useful for the future work, involving the design of the Multispot beam reflectarrays for satellite telecommunications applications.

articleTitle: Numerical and experimental demonstrations of a Si-based photonic crystal optomechanical cavity
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the optical properties and mechanical modes of a silicon-based hexagonal photonic crystal cavity optomechanical structure are modelled and simulated, the processing of the structure is described, and the optical resonance characteristics of the chip are tested.

articleTitle: Design of a Two-Stage Rectifier with Wide Input Power Range
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A two-stage rectifier for microwave power transfer (MPT) is proposed to achieve high conversion efficiency over a wide dynamic input power range. According to the input power level, a single rectifier cell or both the two rectifier cells have been selected to operate at low-power path and high-power path. By employing the two operating modes, the proposed rectifier is able to achieve power conversion efficiency (PCE) within a wide input range. A prototype of 2.4 GHz rectifier is designed and implemented. The simulation results show that the radio frequency (RF)-DC conversion efficiency maintains over 50% within the input power range of 2. 4-22.2dBm. The maximum PCE reaches 68.8%. Compared to the single-stage rectifier, the input power range with high PCE is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Multistep electricity load forecasting method based on the hybrid GRU neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Accurate prediction of the electricity load of Electric Vehicles (EVs) is beneficial for the electric grid stations to make adjustments in time, especially during the peak consumption periods. To improve the accuracy of forecasting, we introduce a hybrid neural network based on deep learning. The proposed neural network combines the FNN (Feedforward Neural Network) with the GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit), which would assist in the ability to capture data characteristics. Besides, we also apply the K-means clustering algorithm in data pre-processing. The experimental data are obtained from recordings of electricity consumption per hour at a large-scale charging station. The result shows that this method shows advantages compared to other methods in predicting the demand for charging stations in the short term.

articleTitle: An Improved DSDV Protocol based on Link Stability with Adaptive Period for Intra-cluster Routing in High-dynamic Flying UAV Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We propose a stability-based adaptive-period DSDV intra-cluster routing protocol that automatically adjusts the routing update period by the link stability among the nodes in the cluster structure, thus reducing the network overhead of the network structure in maintaining the routing table. We describe the link stability and adaptive period implementation and test the proposed routing protocol in the cluster structure based on network simulation. The implementation results show that the proposed routing protocol has better performance than the traditional DSDV routing protocol, can improve the network throughput and reduce the routing overhead in the network, and has good adaptability in the cluster with fast changing network topology.

articleTitle: A Provably Stable SBP-SAT FDTD Subgridding Method Using Staggered Yee’s Grids
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A provably stable finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) subgridding method is proposed to efficiently solve the transverse magnetic (TM) problems. By using the summationby-parts simultaneous approximation term (SBP-SAT) technique, the staggered Yee’s grids without sampling additional components on the interfaces is used, and several projection operators are carefully designed to make sure that SBP properties are satisfied. Therefore, its long-time stability is theoretically guaranteed. Numerical results show that it shows significant accuracy and efficiency improvement compared with the traditional FDTD method.

articleTitle: Microstrip Antenna Array Based on LTCC for 5G Millimeter-Wave Application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a microstrip antenna array based on Low Temperature Co-Fired Ceramic (LTCC) Technology for millimeter-wave applications. Within a compact structure, the E-shape patch antenna used as the building block of the four-element linear array is working at N260 band. Mutual coupling reduction for limited inter-element spacing of the proposed array is achieved by using multi-layer metal strips with via and parasitic strip structure on LTCC. The compact array with the inter-element spacing of around 0.44 wavelength at the center frequency, yet the port isolation between each element is still above 16 dB within operating frequency. Hence, the array directivity at large scanning angles is improved. The scanning angle of the array on LTCC ranges from −62° to 62° at 38 GHz within 3 dB scanning loss. Compact and well-performing array is suitable for packaging, which is attractive for fifth-generation (5G) millimeter-wave mobile communications.

articleTitle: A Solution for A Disaster Recovery Service System in Multi-cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The current enterprise information architecture is becoming more complex. As a result, user business data is lost or destroyed, services are interrupted, and systems crash, all of which harm users’ businesses. These factors include equipment failure, network attacks, and human error. Data disaster recovery has become an important method to ensure the sustainability of enterprise business. It is an inevitable trend toward disaster recovery services and technologies that “business in the cloud, cloud disaster recovery, and multi-cloud disaster recovery.” Traditional disaster recovery services systems and single-cloud disaster recovery services systems are unsatisfied with users’ current demands for business system deployment in multi-cloud environments, cloud resource sharing, and cross-cloud disaster recovery. We discuss the structure, composition, and functional ideas of a solution for a disaster recovery service system in multi-cloud environments. To provide cross-cloud disaster recovery management service in a multi-cloud environment with full-stack virtualization in response to user business requirements, it combines conventional disaster recovery technology, blockchain distributed multi-copy data storage and security audit, and system security state awareness.

articleTitle: Numerical Dispersion Analysis of Isosceles Triangular Meshes in the Finite-Element Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Different meshes in the finite-element method (FEM) have different dispersion characteristics. For isosceles triangular meshes with equal height and base, the interpolation scheme in FEM uses fewer sampling points than the Lagrange interpolation for the same interpolation order, while the maximum dispersion error is approximately equal to the square meshes under the same sampling density. In particular, the dispersion error distribution of equilateral triangular meshes is the most uniform under the same interpolation order and sampling density. The results can be used for the selection of appropriate meshes for the FEM applications.

articleTitle: A Wideband Differentially-Driven Dual-Polarized Antenna for 5G mmWave Terminal Application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A wideband differentially-driven dual-polarized magneto-electric (ME) dipole antenna suitable for 5G mmWave terminal application is presented in this paper. A cross-shaped strip differential feeding structure is designed to achieve the high port-to-port isolation and meanwhile reduce the profile height. For proof-of-concept demonstration, the proposed antenna is investigated, implemented and measured. The measurement results of the antenna show a wide overlapped impedance bandwidth of 60.9% (24.2-45.4 GHz) and the high isolation of better than 30 dB over the operating band. Apart from the broadband bandwidth, promising radiation characteristics including stable gain and radiation pattern, low cross-polarization level and large front-to-back ratio (FTBR) are of significance to practical applications as well.

articleTitle: Study on the Multiple tuning for VLF Umbrella Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to investigate the electrical properties of multiple tuning and single tuning on input resistance and input current of VLF Umbrella. Owning to the adverse conditions of low radiation resistance of the singled tuned antenna, the coupling network that provide the impedance transformation is need in feeders. We propose a multiple-tuned method of increase the impedance of VLF Umbrella Antenna to eliminates the coupling network. A model of a trideco-tower umbrella antenna (the NWC antenna) is established in the FEKO simulation software. Using the multiple-tuned, the radiation resistance of multiple-tuned VLF antenna is the square of n times that of a single-tuned antenna, where n is the number of elements. Meanwhile, the current in tuning inductance is 1/n times that of a single-tuned antenna. The antenna voltage of the multiple-tuned is the same as for the single-tuned condition.

articleTitle: Triple-Mode Resonant Planar Antenna with Enhanced Endfire Radiation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel design approach to a low-profile, enhanced endfire gain and triple-mode resonant microstrip patch antenna is proposed. A 2.0 -wavelength sectorial magnetic dipole and an annular sector reflector with width of 0.75 -wavelength can be employed to yield enhanced wideband endfire radiation. As validations, prototype antenna is fabricated and verified on a substrate with a relative permittivity of $\varepsilon_{r}=2.65$, and a thin profile of 0.037 -wavelength at the V2X (Vehicle-to-Everything) band. The prototype antenna exbibits a maximum endfire gain up to 4.1 dBi and an impedance bandwidth of 18.0%.

articleTitle: An clustering routing Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks based on Density
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposed a kind of cluster algorithm DKUCR, which is KUCR algorithm’s improvement. In order to solve the problem that in KUCR algorithm, the initial headers’ election is not uniform, this paper take the node’s density to assist choosing initial cluster center. What’s more, with the number of dead nodes increase, KDUCR algorithm adaptively adjust the number of clusters according to the overall network survivability. By comparing the performance of DKUCR algorithm with KUCR, LEACH algorithms, the simulation results show that under the constraint of limited energy, the network operation life of DKUCR algorithm is longer and the energy consumption is slower.

articleTitle: Nested Equivalence Source Approximation for Multiscale and Penetrable Medium Simulations
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we will review the further research on our proposed NESA (Nested Equivalence Source Approximation) as a low-rank method for MoM (method of moments) for realistic multiscale and penetrable medium simulations. For the low-frequency problem, the equivalent sources are placed uniformly in the closed spherical shell space surrounding the original discrete region with linear complexity. For the high-frequency problem, the space is evenly divided into six regions according to six directions, and the equivalent sources are evenly placed in each region with O(NlogN complexity, where N is the number of unknowns. We apply NESA to simulate some real models and calculate Surface Enhanced Raman Scattering (SERS) enhancement factor under different materials. The numerical results demonstrate the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Recognition of Continuous Phase Modulation Signals Based on Synchrosqueezing Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We present a new algorithm that can solve the problem of recognition of continuous phase modulation (CPM) signals to phase shift keying (PSK) signals. The algorithm uses synchrosqueezing wavelet transform (SWT) to extract the instantaneous frequency (IF) of the signal. On this basis, a recognition characteristic parameter is proposed. This paper verifies the parameter is suitable for PSK and CPM signals with different modulation parameters. Finally, the simulation shows that the algorithm can fully recognize CPM signals to BPSK and QPSK signals when signal-to-noise ratio (snr) is above 6dB. Compared with the existing algorithms, the algorithm proposed in this paper has a higher recognition rate in the low snr environment.

articleTitle: A 1-Bit Wideband Beam Reconfigurable Metasurface Reflectarray Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an electrically controllable wideband 1-Bit beam reconfigurable metasurface reflectarray antenna is designed. The antenna is designed based on 1-Bit reflection coding element. The designed antenna has the advantages of wide bandwidth, low reflection loss and simple unit structure. The bandwidth of the antenna is 11~14GHz, the relative bandwidth is 24%, and the reflection loss of the unit is within −1dB, that is, the reflection coefficient is greater than 0.9. The reflective array antenna can realize beam scanning of −30 °~+30 °, which can better realize beam switching.

articleTitle: Three-band tunable metamaterial absorber based on varactor diode
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We propose a three-band tunable metamaterial absorber based on varactor diodes. The proposed structure is composed of two symmetrically-arranged stepped square rings connected by a varactor diode. By decreasing the reverse bias voltage from 0V to -15V, the first and the second absorption peaks can be dynamically tuned from 2.85GHz to 4.30 GHz and 9.53GHz to 10.11GHz respectively, while the third absorption peak remains stable at around 15.26GHz. The absorptivity of all three peaks remains higher than 99.9%. The proposed absorber demonstrates good absorption properties and angular stability, which can be applied in antenna design, electromagnetic stealth, electromagnetic compatibility and electromagnetic shielding.

articleTitle: Dual-notch Ultra-wideband Bandpass Filter Based On Folded Dual-mode Resonator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that ultra-wideband systems are easily interfered by narrowband signals, In this paper, a novel ultra-wideband (UWB) bandpass filter with dual-notch characteristics. This filter is mainly composed of Composition of a multimode resonator (MMR)and a folded dual-mode step-impedance resonator. Paralleling T-shaped SIR stubs in the basic MMR structure realizes the introduction of transmission zeros within the passband. At the same time, a pair of high-impedance stubs are also loaded to extend the upper stopband of the filter, and a folded dual-mode stepped impedance resonator is coupled below the filter to generate dual-notch frequencies. Through the electromagnetic simulation software HFSS for simulation optimization, the simulation results show that the passband of the filter is 3.42~11.21GHz and its notch frequencies are 8.8GHz and 9.5GHz respectively. Insertion loss below 0.5dB and stopband up to 20GHz (S21<−15dB). It can effectively suppress the influence of the X-band satellite communication system on the ultra-wideband communication system, and can be applied to the ultra-wideband wireless communication system.

articleTitle: Study on the Reference level of Shielding Effectiveness for Electromagnetic Shielding Doors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The performance of the shielding door directly affects the shielding effectiveness (SE) of the shielding enclosure. In practical measurement, it is found that the SE reference level of a shielding door is sometimes tested in an incorrect way, and subsequently, wrong SE result is obtained. In this paper, the limit method is employed to analyze the SE reference level of a shielding door. The relationship is determined between the SE results of the shielding door, the shielding enclosure opened, and the shielding enclosure closed. Furthermore, the SE requirement for an accompanying shielding enclosure is determined. Finally, a typical shielding enclosure is modeled and simulated. The conclusion is useful for testing the SE of a shielding door in a correct way. It is also helpful for engineers to choose a suitable accompanying shielding enclosure.

articleTitle: An Incident Angle Insensitive Absorption Frequency Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel angle insensitive frequency selective surface (FSS) is presented by combining the ring, square loop and cross to achieve better electromagnetic absorption performance. The unit cell consists of three layers, which are FSS, dielectric layer and patch substrate. The structure makes the reflections and transmission of the two sides not equal. The simulation results show that the proposed FSS provides absorption on several distinctive frequency bands ranging from C-band to K-band with maximum absorption of 99%.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Direction Finding Method Based on Space-Time Modulated Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we present a X-band space-time modulated metasurface to realize direction finding. An analytic method of recovering the base-band signals is firstly developed. Then the signal covariance matrix is calculated, to estimate the direction of arrival (DOA) through multiple signal classification (MUSIC). Finally, the simulation and experiment were implemented to verify the feasibility of the direction finding system. The proposed method helps to reduce complexity, comparing with antenna array system and has broad application prospects in future wireless communications.

articleTitle: Research on the Small Circular Arc Antenna Based on the Method of Moments
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The radiation characteristics of circular arc antenna are studied by applying the method of moments (MoM) to solve the electric field integral equation (EFIE). Based on the triangular current distribution of small circular arc antenna, the analytical expressions of radiation fields and power of circular arc antenna are derived. It is found that the circular arc antenna is equivalent to a superposition of an electric dipole and magnetic dipole. The radiated power of the circular arc antenna with different sizes is calculated by using the MoM and analytical expression respectively. The validation range of the electric and magnetic dipole model is verified with numerical results.

articleTitle: A Planar Dual Polarized Shared-Aperture Array for K-/Ka-band Satcom Application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a planar shared-aperture array antenna with dual linear and dual circular polarization for K-/Ka-band Satcom applications. K-band horizontally polarized waves are generated by substrate integrated coaxial line (SICL)-fed transverse slots, whereas Ka-band vertically polarized waves are formed by a substrate integrated waveguide (SIW)-fed slot pair. In addition, the circularly polarized solution is also provided in this paper to meet the requirements of some Satcom applications. Two independent rotated dipoles are placed above the horizontally polarized K-band and vertically polarized Ka-band elements, resulting in dual circularly polarized waves. Since the K-band and Ka-band elements share the same metal fence, the proposed arrays can obtain high channel isolation and high aperture usage efficiency in the linear and circular polarization states. Furthermore, the channel isolations in both bands can be also improved by introducing the high-pass characteristic of SIW. The outstanding isolations in both frequency bands demonstrate that the proposed antennas can be adopted for the Satcom system.

articleTitle: Numerical Calculation of THz Emission of a GaN HEMT Using Coupled Hydrodynamic-Maxwell Equations
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, the characteristics of plasma oscillations in the two-dimensional electron gas in a GaN HEMT and its THz emission properties are studied using finite difference time domain method. Differentiation of the hydrodynamic equation satisfied by the two-dimensional electron fluids and Maxwell equations in two-dimensional space are conducted and coupled with each other. In order to reduce the calculation time and ensure the computational accuracy, the gradient non-uniform grids are adopted in the computational area. In the process of time iteration, different variables of the two-dimensional electron gas and electric and magnetic fields in two-dimensional plane are investigated, respectively. The coupling of the electric field in the two-dimensional space and current in two-dimensional gas are coupled together and the stable numerical results are obtained. The temporal dependence of the source areal current is studied and the areal current along the channel at different times are analyzed. At the end, the two-dimensional distribution of the power flow density generated by a GaN HEMT and its THz radiation power are obtained.

articleTitle: A brain-inspired unsupervised learning algorithm for SAR Target Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) have driven remarkable progress in AI over the past decade. Based on the ability of feature extraction and the Back Propagation (BP) supervision algorithm, ANNs can achieve outstanding performance in classification tasks. However, the dependence on data limits the application of ANNs in tasks with insufficient data. Spike Timing Dependent Plasticity (STDP) is widely believed to underlie the unsupervised learning process in the brain. Inspired by STDP, this paper presents a Phase-dependent plasticity (PDP) unsupervised learning algorithm. Combined with phase information, this method can introduce STDP into the ANNs. Our method can achieve a classification accuracy of 98.47% on the MSTAR dataset. PDP unsupervised algorithm is a practical attempt to combine ANNs with Spike Neural Networks (SNNs).

articleTitle: A KNN-Assisted Differential Evolution Algorithm for EM Optimization of Microwave Filters and Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In microwave devices optimization, the full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulation is usually computational expensive. In this work, to alleviate this problem, a new optimization algorithm is proposed to reduce the total amount of EM simulation cost. The algorithm combines k-nearest-neighbor (KNN) and differential evolution (DE) methods to achieve both convergence speed and the ability of global optimizing. To benchmark the performance of the proposed algorithm, a waveguide filter and an antenna are investigated. The numerical experiments also considered high dimension problems.

articleTitle: A Compact circularly polarized Beidou antenna loaded with U-slot parasitic patch
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the continuous development of the Beidou navigation system, the demand for Beidou terminal antennas is also increasing. This paper introduces a compact microstrip patch antenna working in the Beidou B2 frequency band. The bandwidth is broadened by means of probe coupling feeding and loading of parasitic patches. The proposed antenna has a profile of 4.6 mm (0.018 $\lambda_{0}$), and occupies an area of 80 mm $\times 80$ mm (0.31$\lambda_{0} (\times 0.31) \lambda_{0}$). The simulated impedance bandwidth with $\vert \mathrm{S}11 \vert \lt -10$ dB is 7.7%, respectively. The simulated 3 dB axial-ratio bandwidth is more than 1.5% for B2 bands. This is a small wideband patch antenna with wide application prospects.

articleTitle: Design of an Ultra-Wideband Omnidirectional Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An ultra-wideband omnidirectional array using hollow biconical antenna as the array element is proposed, and the square coaxial power division network is inserted in the center of the antenna to realize one-to-four equal-amplitude and in-phase feed, thus achieving the high-gain omnidirectional beam coverage. The simulation results show that the antenna can achieve a gain of 5dBi, VSWR$\le$2.5, and out-of-roundness within 1dB in the 2.5-6GHz frequency band. The antenna array realizes the integrated design with the power division network, and has good application prospects.

articleTitle: A broadband metamaterial absorber based on split-rings frequency selective surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this article, a metamaterial absorber based on lumped resistors loaded frequency selective surface is proposed. Simulation results show in a wide frequency range of 7.4-21.7GHz, the designed absorber has an absorptivity greater than 90% under normal incidence, and the relative bandwidth of the perfect absorption is 98.3%. Moreover, the designed absorber has a good characteristics of polarization insensitivity and oblique incidence.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Metamaterial Inspired Peano Fractal Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A metamaterial inspired antenna with peano fractal loaded at the top is designed and discussed in this paper. Two peano fractals were loaded on the top of monopole antenna and then, four interdigital LHMs were loaded. Transmission line model was used to analyze the theory of miniaturization and multiband. The size of the proposed antenna is $34\times 25\times 0.8\mathrm{m}\mathrm{m}^{3}$ and it covers $1.47\sim 1.50\mathrm{GHz}$, $2.27\sim 2.41GHz$, $3.05\sim 3.08\mathrm{GHz}$, $3.26\sim 3.31GHz$, $6.78\sim 7.35\mathrm{GHz}$ and $7.65\sim 7.88\mathrm{GHz}$, which is applicable to GPS, L-band, C-band and WIFI 6E. This antenna shows good omnidirectional property.

articleTitle: Antenna Arrays Design Based on Hyperuniform Disordered Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Antenna arrays with aperiodic element distribution are often used to suppress grating lobes and increase scanning range, particularly when the arrays interelement spacing is larger than half a wavelength. In this paper, a new antenna array design approach, based on the concept of hyperuniform disorder is presented, in order to suppress the grating lobes and achieve low sidelobe level values over a wide bandwidth. Hyperuniform disordered structures are exotic states of matter that lie between the disordered and ordered (periodic) regime. On one hand, the hyperuniform disordered antenna array has similar properties to that of aperiodic antenna array, regarding the prediction of the radiation properties and especially the sidelobe level values. On the other hand, it can achieve grating lobe suppression like an a periodic array for a wide bandwidth during scanning. The antenna array based on the hyperuniform disordered distribution can be regarded as an extension of the periodic antenna array, in the sense that the former offers a wider bandwidth than the latter, due to the connection between the structure factor formula of a hyperuniform disordered structure and the antenna array formula.

articleTitle: A Novel Radiated-Power-Based Sub-Structure Characteristic Mode Formulation Considering Lossy Background Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel radiated-power-based sub-structure characteristic mode (sub-CM) formulation is proposed. The full structure is divided into two parts: the active part and the passive part. The active part is the sub-structure to be studied and the passive part is called the background structure. The eigen space of the proposed formulation is confined to the sub-structure with the power balance of full structure taken into account. Compared with the active-power-based formulation, the radiated-power-based formulation can be used to separate the contributions of radiated, reactive and dissipated powers, giving different physical insight into radiation mechanism. The proposed formulation is a good candidate for the modal analysis of structures consist of multiple parts.

articleTitle: Design of A 400-Element Reflectarray Antenna Fed by Tapered Slot Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The design and measurement of a reflectarray antenna fed by a tapered slot antenna (TSA) is reported. The reflectarray contains 400 unit cells combined by square patches and square loops. The tapered slot antenna is 90 mm away from the center of the array, allowing for an edge illumination level of –10 dB. The compensation for the non-spherical wavefront of the feeding TSA is included during the element design, leading to the accurate direction of the scattering wave of a pencil beam. The TSA-fed reflectarray antenna is prototyped and experimentally investigated. The measured radiation patterns show maximum gain at 30 degrees as designed across 9.8–10.2 GHz with sidelobe levels all below –10 dB.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Assisted Automatic Filter Synthesis with Prior Knowledge and Its Application to Single-Mode Bandpass Filter Design
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Filters are an essential component of microwave circuits. An automatic single-mode narrowband bandpass synthesis algorithm based on a priori knowledge of filters and machine learning techniques is proposed. It is applied in substrate-integrated waveguide (SIW) filter synthesis, verified that the algorithm can automatically synthesize SIW filters that meet the specifications and further advance circuit design automation.

articleTitle: Calculation of the Transmission-Reflection Coefficients of Composite Periodic Structures Using Characteristic Mode Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the calculation of transmission-reflection (T-R) coefficients of composite periodic structures is discussed based on characteristic mode theory (CMT). The single-mode structures are studied and numerical results show that the T-R coefficients calculated from CMT well coincide with those obtained from Floquet mode theory. The CMT provides us with a new perspective to understand the field behaviors of periodic structures.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Based Radio Wave Propagation Model for Multi-Shape Tunnels
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The vector parabolic equation (VPE) method has been widely applied to modeling radio wave propagation in guiding structures such as tunnels. However, simulation with VPE for long tunnels is computationally intensive. This paper proposes an efficient artificial neural network (ANN) based model for radio wave propagation prediction in tunnels with various cross-section geometries. The ANN model can accurately predict the received power based on tunnel geometry and antenna specifications. The performance of the proposed model has been validated through comparisons with VPE simulations.

articleTitle: Low SLL and High Gain Reflectarray Antenna Based on Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a reflectarray antenna with unequal spacing based on metasurface is presented. The reflector of the antenna is an unevenly spaced metasurface composed of $13\times 13$ units, and the spacing increases step by step from the center to the outside. The antenna has higher gain and lower sidelobe level by optimizing the increasing factor. The simulated maximum beam gain is 26.2dBi at 10GHz, while the sidelobe level of plane E and plane H are -18.5dB and -20.1dB respectively. In addition, the impedance bandwidth, i.e., $|S11|< -10dB$, is 9.65-11GHz.

articleTitle: A single notch ultra-wideband filter with wide Stopband
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An ultra-wideband filter with wide stopband performance with single notch using E-shaped resonator is proposed. Based on a U-shaped MMR structure loaded by an open-circuited stub connected at its center, the loaded basic open-stub structure can generate transmission zeros on both sides of the passband to improve the in-band selectivity. Meanwhile, the symmetrical U-shaped open stub introduced not only strengthens the out-of-band suppression ability, but also optimizes the lower stopband. To suppress the in-band interference phenomenon, the proposed UWB BPF used E-shaped resonator coupled to the main transmission line of the basic UWB BPF to generate a notch band at 8GHz (Satellite communications X band). The filter has passband from 2.74 GHz to 11.5 GHz, the insertion loss is lower than 0.6dB and the filter has a relative high selectivity (30dB skirt factor is 0.891), Meanwhile, the filter has a wide stopband of up to 20.8GHz ($S21 \lt -20$dB).

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation for Interrupted-Sampling Jamming Recognition Based on Piecewise Shannon Entropy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Interrupted-sampling jamming (ISJ) is a big threat to large time-band width radar. In order to resist ISJ, it is a key problem to estimate the parameter accurately and quickly. However, until now, most of the estimation methods exist various defects like complex operation and application difficulty. To solve this problem, this letter proposes a method to estimate the interfering period and the sampling pulse width of ISJ in noisy environment based on piecewise Shannon entropy (ShEn). Experiments show that this method estimates the parameter accurately and stably when the ratio of jamming to noise (JNR) ratio is above 6dB.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Assisted Metal Corrosion Detection Based on Back-Scattering Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Here a metal corrosion detection system based on back-scattering sensor is proposed, with aid of machine learning classification algorithms. The data are obtained through full-wave simulation, then multi-label modeling and classification are carried out. The effects of different classification algorithms are compared. Among them, the random forest classifier has the best performance and the classification accuracy rate is up to 94%.

articleTitle: Radar HRRP Target Recognition Based on Composite Deep Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Radar target recognition is to extract the acquired target echo information to achieve the determination of target category and attribute. The feature extraction and classifier in radar target recognition determine the quality of the recognition. However, the shallow structure used by traditional feature extraction algorithms and classifiers cannot fully utilize the original measurement data of radar targets, and it is easy to ignore the hidden information in the data. To solve this problem, a target recognition method based on composite deep networks is proposed. In this paper, autoencoder and convolutional neural network are combined to make full use of the complex function representation capabilities of deep network structure. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by experiments with radar high-resolution range profile (HRRP) data based on dynamic scene simulation. The experimental results show that the proposed method of radar target recognition can achieve better performance than traditional method.

articleTitle: A Switchable Absorption/Transmission Active Frequency Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a switchable absorption/transmission active frequency selective surface (AFSS) is presented. It is shown that the AFSS can realize two functions as an electromagnetic absorber and a transmission surface for both TE and TM modes. The proposed design mainly consists of two FSS structure layers with PIN diodes loaded and a dielectric layer. When the diodes are turned on and off, the incident wave can be transmitted and absorbed by AFSS in the frequency range of 9.5 GHz to 10.7 GHz, respectively. The absorptivity and transmittance of the AFSS structure are over 90% The proposed work can be applied in the intelligent radome in future.

articleTitle: Investigation on ULA Fitting Promoting Low Coupling Sparse Arrays
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A low coupling sparse array (LCSA) is presented, analyzed and discussed on the basis of the recent proposed uniform linear array (ULA) fitting scheme with close-expressions, and its performance with different uniform subarrays in the basic layer is investigated via parameter estimation like direction-of-arrival(DOA). The results gives a superior performance for the presented LCSA.

articleTitle: An L-Shaped Miniaturized Ultra Wideband Vivaldi Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a miniaturized ultra-wideband Vivaldi antenna with L-shaped slot line is designed. The fan-shaped microstrip-circular resonator coupling feeding method in the traditional Vivaldi antenna design is changed to an open-circuit straight slot line. The loading method commonly used in the traditional design to realize the miniaturization of the antenna is abandoned, and the same effect is achieved. The bandwidth of the antenna 2.3GHz-20.3GHz (8.8: 1), the antenna size is $38mm\times 30mm$ ($0.28\lambda_{0^{\times}}0.22\lambda_{0}, \lambda_{0}$ is the maximum operating wavelength). The whole antenna structure is simple, and the pattern has good end-fire characteristics.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Disaster Recovery Data Storage and Security Auditing Solution in Multi-cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The utilization of cloud disaster recovery services has emerged as the current trend in data disaster recovery research and application due to the quick growth of virtualization technology and cloud applications. Single-cloud disaster recovery services fall short of users’ demands for data security backup due to technical flaws, managerial weaknesses, network attacks, natural calamities, etc. To implement cross-cloud disaster recovery and multi-cloud data storage, disaster recovery systems must be deployed in multi-cloud and heterogeneous cloud settings. To do this, problems with distributed cross-cloud storage’s data batch audit and problem resolution must also be resolved. In this paper, we propose a blockchain-based distributed storage and security audit solution for disaster recovery data in a multi-cloud environment, which addresses the issues of multi-copy storage management and security audit of multi-cloud data.

articleTitle: 1-bit Wideband Fully-metallic Reflectarray Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A 1-bit metal element is presented for wideband reflectarray design. Phase shift is achieved by alternating the height of the element. Comparing with the conventional one-stage metal block, the proposed two-stage metal block can provide wideband performance. The phase difference is within 180±10° in the band of 28.6 to 39.5 GHz. The reflection loss is very low, since no substrate is used. A reflectarray with $20 \times 20$ elements is designed. The simulated realized gain and aperture efficiency at 32 GHz are 23.03 dBi and 21.91 %, respectively. The aperture efficiencies of the 1-bit reflectarray antenna in the desired band are larger than 18%.

articleTitle: Response Control of Conformal and Near-field Excited Magnetic Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents an analytical approach to control the response of conformal magnetic metasurfaces when excited by a near-field source. We first describe the general framework adopted to manipulate the metasurface response in terms of currents amplitude and phase circulating in its unitcells. We therefore develop a numerical test-case aimed at eliminating the truncation effects when a curved metasurface is illuminated by a closely placed RF source, obtaining satisfying results. The proposed methodology allows to overcome hypotheses on impinging plane wave and planarity, generalizing and facilitating the design of this particular type of curved metasurfaces.

articleTitle: An Inflatable Wideband Stacked Microstrip Antenna with Circular Polarization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this letter, a concept of inflatable wideband stacked microstrip antenna with circular polarization is proposed. The stacked antenna is consists of two layers of substrates including rectangular patches with triangle cuts and air gap with inflatable structure as a median layer. Simulated result shows that -10 dB impedance bandwidth of the proposed design covers 1.35 to 1.79 GHz (27.5%). The antenna has a satisfying characteristic of right-hand circular polarization, and the simulated axial ratio bandwidth can cover 1.4-1.58 GHz (12.1%). The radiation gain of the antenna are over 8 dBi at working band. The proposed antenna demonstrates the potentials in satellite navigation system.

articleTitle: Design of Luneburg Lens Active Reflector with Tunable RCS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a Luneburg lens (LL) with a flexible active reflector is proposed. The reflector is composed of six layers of five media from outside to inside and an absorber/reflector based on active frequency selective surface (AFSS). Through a unique feeding method and changing the bias voltage of the PIN diodes loaded on the AFSS, it can switch between four working states in the frequency range of 5.5GHz-7.0GHz, and realize the changes of four kinds of radar cross section (RCS). Compared with the traditional LL reflector, the designed structure has more flexible working states.

articleTitle: Efficient Extraction of SAR Attributed Scattering Center Based on Alternating Optimization and Serialized OMP Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) provides an effective method for target recognition. Scattering features extraction from the SAR data can contribute to obtaining the physical features of the target, which is important for radar target recognition. The attributed scattering center (ASC) is widely used in the accurate modeling of target scattering. This paper studies the efficient extraction of the ASC feature of targets. In view of the complexity of the frequency domain parameter estimation method brought by the high-dimensional parameter space of the ASC, alternating optimization and dictionary refinement are introduced, and a serialized orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) algorithm is proposed that combines the order of energy proportions of candidate scattering centers. Experiments on simulated scattering data of a typical model show that the proposed method can accurately extract the parameters of the ASC features while reducing time consumption and memory requirements.

articleTitle: Study on Intrapulse Modulated Echo Simulation Method for Target with Micro-motion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Active Frequency Selective Surfaces (AFSS) have been widely studied due to their flexibility and designability. But the characteristics and jamming effects of the echo modulated by AFSS are still unclear. The ballistic target has obvious microDoppler effect in the midcourse phase, which is the main research object of this paper. In this paper, through the echo modeling and the micro-motion modeling, the simulation method of the intrapulse modulated echo for the target with micro-motion is studied. At the same time, the jamming effect against the micro-motion effect is observed. Finally, the echo model is verified by electromagnetic computation. The results show that the echo characteristics modulated by AFSS are similar to the characteristics of sub-Nyquist sampling jamming. A large number of false targets are generated by observing the high resolution range profile (HRRP), and a large number of micro-Doppler spectral lines with Doppler frequency shift are generated, which can be identified misleadingly as a large number of targets with different translational velocities.

articleTitle: Reflective Active Metasurface for Dynamic Manipulation of Electromagnetic Waves in X-Band
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An active metasurface for dynamic manipulation of electromagnetic waves is proposed in this paper. This metasurface has a high near-field focusing efficiency (64.7%) and each single meta-atom can be independently tuned by varying the capacitance of the varactor diodes. Two different simulated verifications are performed to demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed active metasurface. The proposed mechanism provides a theoretical basis for building an active metasurface system that can dynamically manipulate electromagnetic waves.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Phase Planar Transmitarray Unit Cell For mm-Wave Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper describes the design of a reconfigurable phase planar transmitarray unit cell for mmwave communication. The transmitarray unit cell is composed of two layers, each of them inspired by a mirror-antisymmetric split ring resonator structure (MA-SRR). By loading the MASRR structure with varactor diodes (one on the top ring and one on the bottom ring) it is possible to control the transmittance phase of the unit cell structure (by changing the varactor bias voltage) without significantly affecting the transmittance amplitude. Two layers have been integrated together to produce a phase variation larger than 300°, with a transmittance amplitude which varies from −3.5dB to −7.1dB.

articleTitle: Stochastic FDTD for Statistical Analysis of Thermal Field
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a computational method for thermal analysis using the stochastic finite-difference time-domain (S-FDTD) method, which can calculate the temperature statistics caused by the uncertainty of thermal properties. The derivation process of the calculation formula is given. In the simulation process, the analytical solution is used as a reference for the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) results. Then a layered tissue model is used for simulation, and the Monte Carlo results are compared to prove the feasibility and efficiency of the S-FDTD method.

articleTitle: Data-driven Modeling of Plasma Fluid Closure and Parameter Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The advances of technology enable us to discover partial differential equations (PDEs) from data of a certain size, which is of great significance for modeling physical systems. In this paper, based on kinetic data from one-dimensional vlasov-ampere simulation, we use a physics informed neural network (PINN) to learn PDEs from simulation data to achieve reduced-order modeling of fluid closure. In addition, the trained PINN enables the prediction of each physical quantity in the fluid model in time.

articleTitle: Learning Low-dimensional SAR Target Representations from Few Samples
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Due to the lack of raw data, difficulty in labeling, and limitations of sensor characteristics, Few-Shot Learning (FSL) in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images remains a significant challenge. Inspired by the geometric distribution of data, a Disentangled Feature-based Adversarial Latent AutoEncoder (DF-ALAE) model is proposed for representing typical targets in SAR images, which models the intrinsic attributes of targets and perturbation of scenes, respectively. It fuses the prior distribution information with the limited training samples to reduce sample complexity for model optimization. Experiments are conducted on the Moving and Stationary Target Acquisition and Recognition (MSTAR) dataset to evaluate the representation and generalization ability of the DF-ALAE. When the number of training samples is 121, it achieves a classification accuracy of 93.10%. Comparative experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized UWB High-Gain Vivaldi Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a miniaturized wideband high gain Vivaldi antenna is designed. A Vivaldi antenna with a size of only 10mm $\times$ 25mm $\times$ 0.508mm is designed, which is 50% $\times$ 33.2% smaller than the conventional antenna. And the miniaturization of this antenna is achieved at the expense of bandwidth. Therefore, the antenna band is broadened and the antenna gain is improved by loading a gradient corrugated structure. To further improve the performance, the same slotted slits are cut at the bottom of the antenna. The antenna performance is compared. The final Vivaldi antenna achieves a bandwidth of 15GHz-40GHz. The gain is also significantly improved, with an average antenna gain increase of l. 8dBi in the bandwidth range.

articleTitle: Scattering center modelling from geometrical model of target
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: this paper presents a method of scattering center (SC) modelling from geometrical model of target. In this method, the geometrical information of targets is firstly extracted from the meshed model of the targets; and then the parametrical model of SCs is built based on the local scattering mechanism and extracted geometrical information. This method does not need any numerical computation process; therefore, it can quickly build 3D SC models of a target. To validate the feasibility of this method, the Radar Cross Section (RCS) of an aircraft target simulated by the built model is compared with the results of full-wave numerical method. The results show the built SC model has high precision in simulating the RCS fluctuation of the aircraft.

articleTitle: A Dual-band Common Aperture Waveguide Slotted Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Slot waveguide antennas are widely used in ground, ship and airborne radars due to their compact structure, high radiation efficiency and easy control of side lobes. For the same aperture, the X-band frequency is low, the spatial attenuation is small, and the action distance is long, but the beam width is large, and the resolution of scanning or detection is low; the absolute bandwidth is small, the communication capacity is low, and the anti-interference ability is weak; the Ka-band frequency is high, the beam width is small, the resolution of scanning or detection is high; the absolute bandwidth is large, the communication capacity is high, and the anti-interference ability is strong; but the spatial attenuation is large, and the working distance is not enough. Aiming at the shortcomings of these two bands, this paper proposes an X/Ka dual-band co-aperture waveguide slot antenna. And the electromagnetic simulation software HFSS is uesd for simulation analysis. The simulation results show that the bandwidth of the X-band antenna with VSWR less than 2 is about 7%; the bandwidth of the gain greater than 12dBi is about 8%. The simulation results show that the bandwidth of the Ka-band antenna with VSWR less than 2 is about 4.6%; the bandwidth of the gain greater than 22dBi is about 5.2%. The X/Ka dual-band co-aperture waveguide slot antenna can realize spatial multiplexing, give full play to the advantages of the electromagnetic characteristics of the two bands, and have broad application prospects in the fields of terminal guidance, air defense, and communication radar.

articleTitle: Surface Simulation and Design of C-band Energy Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Based on the equivalent circuit model of PIN diode and the full wave simulation method of CST software, the system performance of finite large energy selective surface (ESS) is simulated and analyzed when the number of cells is small. The simulation results show that the working performance of ESS will be degraded by the slight surface deformation caused by external force but not fail completely. Therefore, in the practical application of ESS, attention should be paid to avoid deformation caused by external force extrusion, which will reduce the shielding performance of ESS. The simulation results provide reference value for the practical design and application of energy selective surface.

articleTitle: Miniature and Near-3D Omnidirectional Antenna Based on Simple Structure for UHF Band RFID Tag
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel planar and miniature ($0.14 \times 0.1 \times 0.002$ $\lambda ^{\mathbf{3}}$) UHF band RFID tag antenna is proposed whose radiation pattern is near-3D omnidirectional. The proposed antenna is comprised of two open-loops who are mirror symmetrical to the substrate. The proposed antenna is easy to change its shape in order to match different chips without making great impact on performance. Simulated operating 3 dB bandwidth of the antenna is near 29 MHz and the gain deviation is less than 1.7 dB.

articleTitle: Research on Luneburg lens reflector with switchable working state
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a working state switchable Luneburg lens (LL) reflector, based on active frequency selective surface (AFSS). By changing the bias voltage of PIN diodes loaded on AFSS, the working state of LL and radar cross section (RCS) can be switched in the frequency range of 6 GHz-8 GHz. When the PIN diode is in ON state, the AFSS working in a reflective state, and the LL reflector’s RCS can be improved to at least 15dB, the effect is the same as the metal plate. When the PIN diode is in OFF state, the AFSS working in a transmission state, and the RCS of the LL reflector can decreased by about 2-3dB in all OFF state, 5-22dB in OFF-ON strate.

articleTitle: A Lowpass Filter Based on Microstrip Splitter-Combiner Section loaded With Multiple CSRR Coupled Units
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a lowpass filter (LPF) with N-controllable transmission zeros in stopband is proposed. It is consisting of N-stage complementary split ring resonator (CSRR) coupled units and a microstrip splitter-combiner section. The equivalent circuit of the proposed filter and relevant lumped parameters are summarized and applied to predict the resonance frequencies in stopband. The resonance frequencies can be controlled arbitrarily through adjusting the physical parameters of CSRR units. As an example, an LPF with four CSRR coupled units is designed, simulated, experimentally fabricated and measured. The stopband rejection level is suppressed to be better than 17.7 dB within the passband. The measured results compare well with the EM simulated results, which validates the configuration and corresponding equivalent circuit of the proposed class of filter.

articleTitle: Multifunctional Active Frequency Selective Surface with Switchable Modes of Absorption, Transmission and Reflection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a multifunctional active frequency selective surface (AFSS) with compound modes of absorption, transmission and reflection is presented. The proposed structure consists of three parts including a switchable transmission/lossy layer, an air spacer and a switchable transmission/reflection layer from top to down. PIN diodes are employed in the two switchable layers to realize the switching function and resistors are used to introduce ohmic losses in the top switchable transmission/lossy layer. Due to the separated bias networks in the two switchable layers, the PIN diodes for different polarizations can be controlled independently. Compared to other multifunctional designs previously reported, the proposed structure simultaneously integrates three different operating modes of absorption, transmission and reflection, and meanwhile, dual-polarized and wideband characteristics are also achieved.

articleTitle: Microwave Imaging for Dielectric-Magnetic Mineral Substances by Full Volume Integral Equations
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An integral equation method is developed for reconstructing dielectric-magnetic mineral substances by using microwave illumination. Since the objects are dielectric-magnetic, full volume integral equations (VIEs) are needed to describe the problem and the reconstruction is based on the distorted Born iterative method (DBIM). The Nyström method is used to solve the forward scattering VIEs (FSVIEs) while the Gauss Newton minimization method (GNMM) with a multiplicative regularization scheme (MRS) is employed to solve the inverse scattering VIEs (ISVIEs). The Nyström method is a point-matching method which is more suitable for solving the FSVIEs of inverse problems. Also, the GNMM with the MRS can lower the requirement on measured data for solving the ISVIEs. A numerical example is presented to illustrate the approach and its good performance has been validated.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous CPU-GPU Accelerated Parallel Subgridding FDTD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The subgridding method can efficiently deal with the tremendous mesh involved in the Finite-Difference Time-Domain simulation. Here, we introduce a heterogeneous CPU-GPU parallel technique to further accelerate the subgridding FDTD algorithm. According to the proposed parallel strategy, GPU is used to calculate dense grid regions, and CPUs only take into account the coarse mesh region. The algorithm’s efficiency is benchmarked by simulating a frequency-selective structure. The numerical results reveal that the execution speed of our proposed method is significantly improved, while the computational accuracy is also guaranteed.

articleTitle: Simulation Experiment of Stripmap SAR Imaging Using Planar Near Field Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: At present, the experiments for strip SAR imaging mainly use airborne or spaceborne platforms, and there are few relevant literatures on experimental measurements in microwave anechoic chambers. This paper presents an experimental method for simulating strip SAR imaging using a planar near-field measurement system in an anechoic chamber. By controlling the antenna to simulate the motion pattern of SAR imaging, measurements are made at different locations and echo data is collected. Compared with the general experimental scheme, the scheme proposed in this paper does not require continuous motion of the radar platform, which will reduce the complexity of the measurement system.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength pitch optical antenna array with low crosstalk for optical phased array
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Electromagnetic couplings are ubiquitous in the microwave and optical systems. Notably, high-density integration of photonic chips will suffer from strong crosstalk between different channels due to the larger electrical size of dielectric waveguides, resulting in the degradation of device performance. For the application of optical phased arrays (OPAs), strong crosstalk between adjacent channels will prevent the independent phase control over each antenna element. Here, we propose a sub-wavelength pitch optical antenna array with low crosstalk for wide-angle beam steering of OPA. In this design, two thin strips along the transmission waveguide are introduced to increase the cladding anisotropy, suppressing evanescent wave couplings. Besides, period nano-blocks arranged along both sides of silicon strip waveguide are utilized to suppress the crosstalk further and radiate electromagnetic waves into free spaces simultaneously.

articleTitle: Design of A Metamaterial Bandpass Filter in the Terahertz Region
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A metamaterial bandpass frequency selective surface (FSS) in the terahertz (THz) range is realized by the cascade of two similar double-ring-like structures with four transmission zeros on either side of its passband to obtain a quasi-elliptical filter response. The proposed FSS is analyzed by the equivalent circuit model, and the simulation results show that the structure has a 3dB bandwidth of 0.06THz at the center frequency of 0.43THz, and has stable bandpass characteristics in the range of incident angle $0-40^{0}$. The FSS has a simple structure, good rectangular coefficient, great out-of-band rejection below 30dB and rectangular coefficients, and can play an important role in terahertz imaging, communication and other fields.

articleTitle: Design of Satellite-borne VDES Receiver
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a satellite-borne VDES receiver which has a four-channel structure. The proposed receiver can receive the three subsystem signals of AIS, ASM and VDE simultaneously. Meanwhile, it has the capability of separating collided signals, estimating and compensating frequency deviation, which is suitable for satellite receiving. Finally, the prototype is implemented, test results show that the receiver has a good performance under large frequency deviation conditions.

articleTitle: SAR Simulation of Kelvin Wakes Patterns induced by Moving Ship on Time-Varying Ocean Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Now researchers can observe most oceanographic phenomena such as surface wakes, ocean currents or internal solitary waves by virtue of high-resolution monitoring capability provided by synthetic aperture radar (SAR) in all weather, all day and all night. In fact, the scarcity of ship wake SAR images somewhat frustrated in-depth research, hence, the study on simulation of kelvin wake is quite meaningful, but lack of attention to detail. Conventional simulation pipeline is specific in a single moment, not considering the dynamic mechanism of sea surface, as well as the movement trends of ship wakes during the imaging process. To further refine the microwave theory of ship wakes, we propose here a dynamic composite model of ship-sea pattern and build a full-link simulator, which taken the dominating modulation effect and nonlinear phenomena into account. Given the initial velocity vector of ship, successive wave height status can be carried out with dispersion relation and influenced by time slice number and interval.

articleTitle: On the Concept of Semantic Electromagnetics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Radar is becoming more intelligent when mounted on autonomous platforms sensing in complex environments. However, radar intelligent sensing is still challenging because of the weak generalization ability and poor interpretability of deep learning when applied onto electromagnetic data. The main reasons are the uniqueness of radar sensing principles and complexity of electromagnetic scattering mechanism. Conventionally, electromagnetic modeling serves the objective of quantitative accuracy such as radar cross section prediction, while semantic information is the key from the perspective of radar intelligent sensing. Thus, this paper proposes a new research topic of semantic electromagnetics for scattering modeling for the purpose of intelligent radar sensing. It employs semantic-centric approaches in geometric/physical modeling and scattering computation so that the model discretization and representation is semantic preserving and the computational algorithm is semantic compatible. Some preliminary progresses on multi-scale hybrid scattering modeling and atomic scatterer dictionary are reported.

articleTitle: A Novel Frequency Reconfigurable Mode Reconfigurable Ultra-Wideband Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Aiming at the inability to reconstruct the frequency and the pattern of the traditional monopole antenna, an ultra-wideband monopole antenna with frequency reconstruction and pattern reconstruction is proposed. The antenna consists of a monopole antenna and a metasurface with a distance H1 between them. Using HFSS simulation software to simulate, the size of the monopole antenna is 30mm×30mm×1.6mm, and the center frequency is 4.3 GHz. The simulation results show that the impedance bandwidth of the antenna when S11 is less than -10 dB is 3.21-13.64 GHz. In this design, the antenna widens the bandwidth while realizing the frequency reconstruction and pattern reconstruction, and basically does not affect other performances. The simulation results are basically consistent with the measured results, indicating that the antenna has good gain and radiation characteristics in the working frequency band, and can be widely used in ultra-wideband communication systems.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization and Design of High-Efficiency OAM Antenna Based on Single-Sideband Time Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a design of circular single-sideband (SSB) time-modulated array (TMA) for generating orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams is proposed. It increases signal bandwidth significantly compared with conventional TMAs for generating vortex waves. Theoretical analysis and simulated results of the proposed SSB TMA modulated by the optimized four-step pulse are reported. Higher harmonic efficiency and total efficiency (98.73% and 64.15%) are achieved simultaneously. And mode 1, 2, and 3 OAM beams with mode purity up to 97.3%, 97.2%, and 79.6% are generated at the first positive harmonic frequency.

articleTitle: Near-field to Far-field Transformation with an Equivalent Magnetic Current Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper provides an equivalent magnetic current approach for near-field to far-field transformation. The method utilizes near-field measured data to determine equivalent magnetic current sources over a fictitious planar surface that encompasses the antenna. An electric field integral equation (EFIE) is developed to relate the near fields to the equivalent magnetic currents, and method of moments (MoM) procedure is applied to transform the integral equation into a matrix one. Numerical results based on measurement data of phased array antenna are given to demonstrate the accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: High-Q-factor Spoof Localized Surface Plasmon Sensor for MIM Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this research, a metal-insulator-metal (MIM) sensor consists of two spoof localized surface plasmon (LSP) structures with corrugated rings coupled to each other is designed, fabricated and measured. The experimental verification is consistent with the simulation. Q-factor up to 161.6 and sensing Figure of merit (FoM) up to 33.7 RIU<sup>-1</sup> are achieved. This sensor potentially has a wide application prospect in the field of high-frequency resonator and sensitive sensor.

articleTitle: Low-Sidelobe Beamscanning Based on Time-Modulated Programmable Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper introduces the design method of low sidelobe beamscanning based on time-modulated e metasurface. The time modulation technology is combined with the digital metasurface, and the amplitude and phase modulation of the metasurface units can thus be realized on the first harmonic component of the RF signal by controlling the coding distribution and the real-time periodic coding sequences through the optimization algorithm. The simulation results show that, through using the amplitude and phase weighted methods with time modulation, the sidelobe level can be supressed to -40 dB for scanning beams at different angles.

articleTitle: Equivalence between Work-Energy Theorem (WET) and Poynting’s Theorem (PT)
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Focusing on scattering problem, the mathematical expressions and physical interpretations of the entire-structure-oriented work-energy theorem (ES-WET) and some different forms of Poynting’s theorem (PT) are simply reviewed. Using Maxwell’s equations and volume equivalence principle, the equivalence between the ES-WET and PT is proved rigorously. The equivalence provides a clear physical explanation why the external impressed and environmental fields are treated as a whole–incident field–in the scatterer-oriented characteristic mode theory. In addition, the equivalence between the partial-structure-oriented work-energy theorem (PS-WET, which governs the working process of lumped-port structures) and PT can also be proved similarly. Thus, it can be concluded that work-energy theorem (WET, which is the collective name of the ES-WET and PS-WET) and PT are equivalent to each other.

articleTitle: Periodically-coded ITR Modulation Characteristics of PCM Signal in Radar Radiation Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The overlapping and mutual coupling between transmitting and receiving signals is a knotty problem in radar radiation simulation. Interrupted transmitting and receiving (ITR) modulation can effectively solve this problem caused by limited space of the microwave chamber. In order to further expand the application of ITR modulation method, the characteristics of periodically-coded interrupted modulation signals are analyzed in this paper.
