Focusing on the modulated pulse coded modulation (PCM) signal, the time-frequency domain characteristics and matched filter output characteristics are studied in detail. Signal simulation experiments are carried out with MATLAB to verify the accuracy of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A Single-Port Polarization Reconfigurable Antenna Using a Stacked Structure with Broad Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Abstract - In this paper, a wideband polarization reconfigurable antenna (PRA) that can realize polarization conversion between linear polarization (LP) mode and circular polarization (CP) mode is proposed. The polarization reconfigurable antenna in this paper consists of a crossed-slot antenna and two parasitic radiation patches. Four p-i-n diodes are then introduced to control the polarization modes. The simulation results show that the antenna achieves a wide bandwidth over 2.1-2.7 GHz (both $\left|S_{11}\right|\lt -10 d B$ and axial ratio $\lt 3 \mathrm{~dB}$) for the $C P$. For the $L P$, the antenna also gets the same bandwidth $\left(\left|S_{11}\right|\lt -10 d B\right.$ over 2.1-2.7GHz). Finally, the PRA is also used as a unit to build a polarization reconfigurable antenna array (PRAA), which still has excellent polarization reconfigurable characteristics.

articleTitle: Design of broadband frequency-selective rasorber with square resonators
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A polarization-insensitive frequency-selective rasorber (FSR) with a wide passband is proposed in this research. The FSR can be divided into a frequency selective surface (FSS) layer and an absorptive layer. The FSS layer consists of three metallic layers and two dielectric plates. The metallic layers are divided into two square patches and a square gap respectively. The absorptive layer is connected by a series of square resonators and chip resistors. The simulated results show that the 3dB passband of the proposed FSR is from 6.0 to 10.0 GHz, and the in-band insertion loss (IL) is 0.6 dB. Besides, the bandwidth of reflection below - 10 dB can reach 122% from 3.2 to 13.3 GHz. The simulated outcomes demonstrate that the proposed FSR has a wide passband and a wide working bandwidth.

articleTitle: Design of a 1-bit Coding Broadband Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel design of l-bit coding metasurfaces tuned by a PIN diode is presented in this paper. The designed metasurface consists of two T-shaped metal patches connected by a PIN diode, two layers of dielectric substrates, and a metallic ground. Over frequencies from S to 19.65 GHz, the reflection coefficient is higher than 0.85 when diode in both on and off states, and the reflection phase difference between two states is about 18$0^{\circ}\pm 37^{\circ}$. The designed structure has broadband characteristics that relative bandwidth reaches 84.27%. In addition, the DC bias circuit of the PIN diode is etched on the metasurface. Therefore, no additional feeding lines are introduced, decreasing the impact on the active metasurface.

articleTitle: Design of X-Band Microstrip Leaky-Wave Antenna with Horizontal Beam Scanning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A periodic leaky-wave antenna with horizontal backward-to-forward beam scanning is designed in this paper. The proposed leaky-wave antenna is based on a microstrip structure with interlaced additional patches and defected ground on the top and the bottom layers, respectively. The equivalent currents on the edges of the ground plane and the patch are in the same direction, and thus the two edges can be equivalent to a dipole unit, contributing to the horizontal energy leakage. Subsequently, a pair of stubs are loaded on the strip to suppress the open-stop band effect. As validation, a prototype with broadside frequency of 10 GHz is designed, fabricated, and measured, aiming for applications in X-band. The measured results show that the proposed antenna scans from-50° through the broadside to+27° along the horizontal plane, as the frequency varies from 8.0 GHz to 12.0 GHz.

articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave Ultrawideband and Gain Enhancement Planar End-fire Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel millimeter-wave ultrawideband and gain enhancement planar end-fire magneto-electric (ME) dipole antenna is presented in this paper. The antenna consists of an arched open cavity composed of substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) and an L-shaped turning patch. Impedance matching can be better achieved by adjusting the length of the L-shaped patch. The antenna has the characteristics with wideband of 56.3% (37.6-67.04 GHz) and gain of an average value of 5.1 dBi stable radiation patterns throughout the operating bandwidth with a peak gain of 5.9 dBi at 67.04 GHz. The proposed gain enhancement antenna structure has a smaller size relative to other end-fire antennas.

articleTitle: Clutter simulation of two-scale rough surface under multi-main-lobe fuze antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents the scattering simulation of rough surface under the illumination of multi-main-lobe fuse antenna. Generally, DEM Terrain Data can describe the large-scale fluctuation trend of the surface. However, small-scale random fluctuation, i.e. the random fluctuation within the large-scale grid, will greatly affect the detection echo of microwave radar. In this paper, the SPM (Small Perturbation Method) is used to compute the scattering of each rough element, and the polarization rotation and phase interference is performed on large-scale grid elements. Since the multi-main-lobe fuse antenna covers a wider area of the surface, the real-time simulation of clutter faces great challenges. A part of rough surface grid is selected according to the radiation footprint of the antenna on the reference plane for echo simulation, so as to accelerate the simulation speed for practical application.

articleTitle: A Poisson’s Equation Solver Based on Neural Network Precondtioned CG Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this study, we investigate the feasibility of utilizing deep learning technique to construct preconditioners for iterative matrix solvers. A neural network (NN) is proposed to simulate the optimum-preconditioner’s mapping properties, and participates in NN-precondtioned conjugate gradient (NNPCG) method. Training and testing sets are generated by finite difference method (FDM). Numerical examples demonstrate that compared to conjugate gradient (CG) method, NN-PCG significantly improves convergence performance on solving 2-D Possion’s equation.

articleTitle: Study on Electromagnetic Scattering from the Grassland Based on Method of Moment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of radar detection and remote sensing of grassland and its nearby targets, the Gaussian type distribution is chosen to represent the height undulation of grass and soil surface, the Topp model is chosen to represent the dielectric constant of soil layer, and the double dispersion model is used to represent the dielectric constant of grass, the Method of Moments is applied to study the characteristics of electromagnetic scattering from the grassland, and the angular distribution curve of scattering coefficient is obtained, the effects of incident angle, incident wave frequency, grass water content, soil moisture, on the scattering coefficient are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on the Scattering Characteristics of the Van Atta Cube Scatterer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to realize good omnidirectional backtracking of electromagnetic waves, a Van Atta cube scatterer consists of six identical Van Atta plane arrays is proposed. In this paper, the scattering characteristics in different incident directions are emphatically studied. Simulation results show that the Van Atta cube scatterer has the advantage of omnidirectional scattering, with the effective backtracking angle range exceeding 77% of the whole angle domain.

articleTitle: X-Band High-Gain Three-Layer Transmittarray Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a three-layer elliptical transmission array element with the parasitic loop is proposed for the design of a transmission array antenna. The transmission phase of the element reaches 306 ° and the transmission amplitude is greater than -1.6dB. A transmitarray with 13 × 13 (195 mm × 195 mm) elements is designed. The simulation results show that the gain at the central frequency of 10 GHz reaches 22dBi and the cross polarization is less than - 15dB. It shows that the designed transmitarray has the characteristics of high gain and low sidelobe. The antenna has great application potential in long-distance communication and radar detection.

articleTitle: A Wideband Tightly Coupled Antenna with Wide-Angle Scanning Range
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A wideband tightly coupled antenna element is presented in this paper. The antenna is fed by a microstrip line connected to the ground and a microstrip feed balun. The bandwidth of the antenna is effectively expanded through the tight coupling structure between the units. The impedance bandwidth is 6:1 (2-12GHz) with VSWR less than 2.5. The cross-polarization of the antenna element is less than -20dB. Then, A $1 \times 10$ finite antenna array is established. In the working frequency band, the antenna array can scan to 62°.

articleTitle: High-Gain Ultra-Wideband Vivaldi Antenna Using Spoofing Surface Plasmons Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An ultra-wideband high gain low profile antenna loaded with deceptive surface plasmon (SSPP) structure is proposed. By loading SSPP structure on the front end of Vivaldi antenna, the antenna increases the gain in the required frequency band without reducing the bandwidth, and improves the radiation characteristics of Vivaldi antenna. The antenna can reach 189% of the working bandwidth in the range of $1\sim 35$ GHz. In this range, the antenna has good end emission radiation and the peak gain is 17.3 dBi.

articleTitle: An LTCC Phaser-Integrated 0.1 THz Vivaldi Antenna for Dispersive Delay Radiation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an exponential tapered slot Vivaldi antenna with a bandwidth of 90 G-110 GHz is proposed. The antenna is designed on the low temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) substrate with 50 $\mu$m thickness and is fed by stripline C-sections. The proposed antenna has a compact size of $7.23 mm \times 4.13 mm$ ( $2.41 \lambda_{\mathrm{O}}\times 1.38\lambda_{\mathrm{O}}$). The endfire radiation pattern with a maximum realized gain of 9.8 dBi is obtained. In addition, a frequency-dependent group delay is realized by the C-sections implemented in our proposed antenna, which enables it to operate as a phaser. The proposed THz endfire antenna integrated with phaser functionality has potential application in the millimeter-wave/THz integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of Multi-layer Metamaterial Absorber with Thin Thickness and Wide Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The multi-layer metamaterial absorbers (MMAs) are designed by a dual-objective optimization. The structure of the MMA which have thin thickness and wide absorptivity bandwidth are designed and optimized based on the combination of the metamaterial models from the metamaterial database. In this paper, the optimized MMA has a thickness of 6.2mm and high absorptivity of more than 90% from 4.304 to 17.872 GHz has been designed.

articleTitle: Piecewise Linear Recursive Convolution Method Applied in One-dimensional Unmagnetized Plasma
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The piecewise linear recursive convolution(PLRC) method based on finite difference time domain(FDTD) is used to calculate the reflection and transmission characteristics of electromagnetic waves from one-dimensional unmagnetized plasma. The results are shown that this method has obvious advantages in accurately calculating the electromagnetic problems of one-dimensional, small-scale and thin-layer dielectric materials.

articleTitle: A Band Stop Decoupling Structure for Circularly Polarized Antennas With Different Intervals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel band stop decoupling structure (BSDS) for circularly polarized microstrip antenna array with different intervals to realize mutual coupling reduction is proposed. The BSDS is composed of complementary split-rings resonator (CSRRs) and split-rings resonator (SRRs), where the CSRRs block TM waves by electric resonance and the SRRs block TE waves by magnetic resonance, respectively. The proposed design is verified by the simulation and the results indicate that the isolation enhancement more than 35 dB can be obtained at the center frequency of 3.4 GHz when the center spacing is 0.37 $\lambda$0. Futhermore, when the center spacing reduces to 0.26 $\lambda$0, the mutual coupling remains below 25 dB. Besides, the BSDS can improve the radiation pattern offset without affecting the gain and the backward radiation of antennas.

articleTitle: Enhancing Farfield Isolation between Nearby Base Station Array Antennas by a Resistive Film Wall
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the development of 5th Generation Mobile Communication Technology, large array antennas have been widely used in base stations, while the farfield isolation of array antennas is an urgent problem to improve. Related research in the past has focused on the isolation between the array elements. Some isolation structures, like metal wall with different shape unit are widely used to reduce the coupling of the array elements. However, the farfield isolation between different arrays and the effects of the sidelobe on isolation get bare attention and still need more research. In this work, a wall structure around array antenna based on resistive film is proposed to improve the farfield isolation without affecting the radiation characteristics of the main lobe. We investigate the effects of the resistive film wall on the farfield isolation in a practical case of two dual-polarized array antennas with certain distance using commercial software CST Microwave Studio. By utilizing resistive films with different sheet resistivity, desirable farfield isolation improvement and less than 2dB insertion loss for the main lobe are validated in both simulation and measurement. The proposed resistive film wall for array antennas demonstrates a good potential application for electromagnetic compatibility in base station.

articleTitle: A Method of Suppressing the Velocity Deception Jamming
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An approach related to effective electronic counter-countermeasures technique to restrain the velocity deception jamming is proposed. The waveform strategy of varying the initial phases of the pulses in a coherent processing interval is given. And an optimization problem is formulated to minimize the energy in a certain range of Doppler spectrum corresponding to retransmitted false targets and keep the energy of the true targets invariant. Then a notch is formed near the true target in the Doppler frequency domain. In addition, a method named phase-only majorization-minimization (POMM) is illustrated to solve the unimodular optimization problem which is non-convex. Some results of the numerical simulations are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Microstrip Antenna Sensor for Dielectric Constant Detection of Solid-state Media
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the development of technology and society, non-destructive requirements for dielectric constant measurement is appearing. In this paper, a sensor for non-destructive measurement of the dielectric constant of solid materials is proposed by etching a compressed complementary split resonator ring on the radiation patch. The simulation results show that when the dielectric constant of the sample changes from 1 to 10, the relative frequency offset percentage reaches 6.6-35.7. Compared with the ordinary patch sensor with the same resonance frequency, the sensitivity of the sensor is improved by 7-7.5 times. The antenna sensor has a simple structure and excellent sensing effect.

articleTitle: Selection of "Time Window" in Time Domain Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, in order to determine the optimal "time window" length selection scheme, the ps-level ultra-wideband antenna time domain far-field measurement system is used to select different "time window" to measure the antenna patterns of different frequency bands, and compare them with the frequency domain measurement results. The measurement results show that when selecting the "time window", it should not be too long or too short. It should not only contain the main part of the pulse signal received by the antenna in all directions, but also ensure that it does not contain environmental noise and background clutter.

articleTitle: Ultra-Miniaturized Broadband Metamaterial Rasorber Using 2.5-D Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this article, an ultra-miniaturized frequency selective rasorber (FSR) based on 2.5-dimensional (2.5-D) structure is proposed. The rasorber is composed of a via-based lossy layer and a two-order resonance lossless layer separated by an air spacer. At the lossy layer, miniaturization and parallel resonance are achieved by the introduction of metal meandered strip-line distributed on both upper and lower surfaces. In order to increase the capacitance and inductance effects, metallized short vias are used to connect the meander-line between different loss surfaces. Besides, a square graphene-based resistive film is adopted as the main loss element to reduce manufacturing cost. As a result, a miniaturization design is achieved with the cell period of 0.016 λ<inf>l</inf> and the thickness of 0.12 λ<inf>l</inf>, where λ<inf>l</inf> is the free-space wavelength at the lowest absorption frequency. The proposed structure works as an absorber from 0.66 GHz to 2.17 GHz with the reflection coefficient less than -10 dB and the fractional bandwidth of 106.7%, and the passband is from 3.10 GHz to 4.19 GHz (relative bandwidth is 29.9%) with the insertion loss less than 0.31 dB. To explain the mechanism of the proposed rasorber, an analysis of the current and electric field distribution at different operating frequencies is presented. Due to the ultra-miniaturized and 2.5-D design, the oblique angle incidence response is up to 30°for the TE mode and 45°for the TM mode. The broad absorption and pass band make the proposed rasorber a useful candidate in the application of radome system.

articleTitle: A Surface Integral Equation-Based Sub-Structure Characteristic Mode Analysis Method for Printed Circuit Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, the electric field integral equation coupled Poggio-Miller-Chang-Harrington-Wu-Tsai equation-based sub-structure characteristic mode (CM) formulation is proposed to analyze the resonant behaviors of printed circuit structures. Superior to the full-structure (sub-structure) volume-surface integral equation (VSIE)-based CM analysis method, the surface integral equation (SIE)-based CM analysis method only needs the surface discretization of targets. The proposed method greatly reduces computational cost, and numerical examples validate its accuracy.

Author Keywords: electric field integral equation coupled Poggio-Miller-Chang-Harrington-Wu-Tsai (EFIE-PMCHWT) equation

articleTitle: Digital Predistortion in MIMO-OFDM Systems Using Power-Injection Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Digital predistortion is widely used in MIMO systems to solve the nonlinearity, memory effect, and crosstalk effect of power amplifiers. In this letter, we propose a power-injection digital predistorter, which consists of two submodules, and their outputs constitute the low-power injection signal. We have carried out simulation verification and achieved a relatively good linearization effect.

articleTitle: A Reconfgurable Patch Antenna Design based on Characteristic Mode Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The characteristic mode theory and analysis have become a novel approach for compact and multi-mode antenna design. In this work, the design of a radiation pattern reconfgurable patch antenna is considered due to its low-profle feature. Unlike the previously studied designs, the patch antenna is fully investigated and has a clear radiation mechanism. To overcome this diffculty, reconfgurability is explored by examining the characteristic modes. After selecting two characteristic modes with vast differences in radiation characteristics, the feeding structure and matching considerations are investigated through parameter sweeping. Finally, the performance of the proposed antenna design is fully studied and compared using full-wave simulations.

articleTitle: Broadband 1-bit active coding metasurface for transmission beam scanning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a new type of 1-bit active coding metasurface working in transmissive mode is proposed. The unit cell of the metasurface is a bi-layer meander line spaced by a dielectric substrate. PIN diodes are loaded for each unit cell and the tunable property of metasurface is achieved by controlling the switching state of PIN diodes. Simulated results show that the proposed metasurface occupies high transmission efficiency and the phase condition for 1-bit coding in a wide band from 8.44 to 9.45 GHz. Furthermore, a twin-beam that can scan from 24° to 50° is easily formed by changing the coding sequence of the metasurface.

articleTitle: A Broadband Stripline Wilkinson 2-way Power Divider
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the design method of the broadband stripline power divider. Based on the Wilkinson power divider, a broadband one-to-two power divider is designed. First, the parameters of the power divider are roughly simulated by ADS, and then the HFSS is used. Carrying out accurate simulation, combining the two simulation software, a Wilkinson stripline power divider with a working bandwidth of 1.2 GHz-3.4 GHz is designed, The overall size of the power divider is 21.5 mm $\times$ 31.44mm $\times$ 2 mm. The simulation results show that: in the working bandwidth, the return loss is greater than 20 dB. The transmission loss is less than 3.3 dB, and the isolation of the output port is greater than 17 dB.

articleTitle: A Design of Honeycomb-shape Coil for Wireless Charging of Leadless Cardiac Pacemaker
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel transmitting coil for magnetic resonance wireless power transfer is designed, which is called honeycomb-shape coil. It surrounds the human body and can form a stronger magnetic field than the traditional coil. Take the leadless cardiac pacemaker as an example, suppose it is on the left side of the heart and design the LCC-C compensation topology circuit to build an energy transmission system working at 13.56MHz, the simulation results show that the transmission efficiency is approximately 0.9%. When the received power is 1mW, the maximum average specific absorption rate (SAR) of the system is 0.240W/kg, which accords with the EN62209-1 human electromagnetic radiation standard.

articleTitle: Dual-Frequency Vortex Beam Generation Using Coding Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a dual-frequency coding metasurface (CM) for vortex beam generation. The metasurface unit cell is realized with two symmetric metal layers separated by a dielectric substrate. Each metal layer consists of an outer square ring, a middle square ring, and an inner rhombus patch. Two out-of-phase transmitting states in two bands are achieved by rotating the inner rhombus patch by 90 °. Two 1 = + 2 vortex beams are then realized in two different bands by properly distributing the two states on the metasurface aperture. A metasurface with $30 \times 30$ elements is designed, simulated, and experimentally demonstrated. The experimental results agree well with the simulating ones, showing that the metasurface achieves a high transforming efficiency in both Ku (13.6-14.8GHz) band and Ka (26.7-27.7 GHz) band.

articleTitle: Neural Contrast Source Inversion Method Based on Single-frequency Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a neural contrast source iteration (Neural CSI) model to solve 2D inverse scattering problems. Inspired by the traditional contrast source iteration (CSI) method, we construct a residual convolution neural network (CNN) to learn the gradient update process. With our dataset (generated by the method of the moment), we train the residual CNN by the objective function of the traditional CSI method in an unsupervised manner.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile Dual-Polarized Dipole Antenna With an EBG Reflector
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A low-profile dual-polarized antenna loaded with an electromagnetic band gap structure (EBG) reflector is proposed. Rather than the metal reflector usually used in traditional base station antenna, the EBG reflector is the most significant feature of the presented design, resulting in that the height of the base station antenna is reduced significantly, so the height of the entire antenna is $0.125\lambda _{0}$ (where $\lambda_{0}$ is the free-space wavelength at 2.6 GHz). Simulated results show that the operating frequency range is from 2.45 GHz to 2.78 GHz with $\vert \mathrm{S}11 \vert \lt -14$ dB, the isolation between two ports is better than 21 dB in the whole band, the peak gain is as high as 9.7 dB, and the cross polar discrimination (XPD) of the proposed antenna is $\gt20$ dB at boresight and is $\gt10$ dB within the entire $-60{\circ} \le \theta \le 60{\circ}$ angular range.

articleTitle: A High-Efficiency and Wideband Water Antena Using Liquid Len Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A high-efficiency and wideband water antena using liquid len structure is proposed in this paper. Both the patch and the ground plane are composed of pure water. And the liquid len structure use a low-loss ionic liquid as a new type of material. All the liquid are enclosed by the container made of transparent plexiglass. Therefore, highly optical transparency is achieved for entire antenna. The antenna can achieve 36 % impedance bandwidth for | S11 | < - 10 dB in the range of 8– 12GHz, and the radiation efficiency is above 60 %. Due to the loading of liquid len, the gain of the antenna can be increased to 11.26 dBi at 9GHz.

articleTitle: MT Inversion Based On Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithom
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Inversion is an important part of Magnetotelluric sounding(MT) data interpretation. Traditional methods rely on the initial model.Particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm has few parameters, simple calculations,but is easy to fall into local optimization.Aiming at overcoming these problems,an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed.In the whole evolution process,local evolution and contraction factors are added to avoid premature convergence and local error,and improve the convergence accuracy.The improved algorithm is compared with other algorithms by test function, and its good performance is verified.Finally, the method is applied to MT inversion,numerical experiment shows that the inverse position of the anomaly body fit good with that of the actual model.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Effective Degree of Freedom of MIMO System in Nonfree Space
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The effects of inhomogeneous environments on nearfield multi-input-multi-output (MIMO) communications are discussed by using full-polarization channel matrix that contains all necessary information. In particular, reflections from grounds are taken into account by full-wave simulations. It is found that the dielectric parameters of the grounds, the relative heights and distances between the transmitters and receivers can affect the electromagnetic effective degree of freedom, which represents the equivalent number of independent single-input-single-output systems. The simulated results also reveal that the extra propagation paths brought by the ground reflection have potential benefits and values in near-field MIMO communication when the number of the antennas of the MIMO system reaches a critical value.

articleTitle: Effects of Lightning Current Conduction on Rotating Bearings
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The effects of lightning current conduction on rotating bearing are studied in this paper. Firstly, the bearing deformation is analyzed theoretically. Then, the shape of the breakdown channel is based on multi-physical field simulation, and the relationship between the breakdown distance and the radius of the breakdown channel is obtained. Next, the lightning current distribution under three conditions of rotating bearing is simulated. It is concluded that the value of magnetic flux density of the cylindrical conductive channel model is higher than the value of magnetic flux density of the direct contact model and the elliptical contact surface breakdown model, and the most likely place to be penetrated is the contact point between the ball and the raceway wall. Finally, the temperature rises curve of the equivalent model of the breakdown channel under the current component A was obtained by simulation. The temperature at which the lightning current made the bearing breakdown point reach the steel melting was used as the criterion to obtain the time taken for bearing damage.

articleTitle: Arbitrarily shaped metasurface for wavefront shaping
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we present a general approach for highly efficient wavefront manipulation with arbitrarily shaped metasurface. Such an approach establishes a universal iterative modulation relation between the metasurface and scattered field by introducing boundary constraints at aperture plane. As a proof of concept, a flower-shaped metasurface consists of classical geometric phase-type meta-atoms in reflection mode is designed and experimentally demonstrated. Therein, a flower-shaped scattered pattern can be revealed at the aperture plane, while four random focuses at near-field plane can be further reconstructed with a high diffraction efficiency of 52%. The proposed method may pave a new route for advanced wavefront manipulation and information security regions.

articleTitle: An Eight-Element MIMO Array Based on Triple-Band Antenna Pair for 5G Smartphone Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A compact high-isolated eight-element MIMO array covers triple frequency bands of 5G communication is proposed. The multi-band operation is realized by etching slots at the grounded strip, and additional slot modes are well excited. Capacitor loading technology is adopted to expand the bandwidth and improve the isolation of the higher band. The mutual coupling reduction can be realized via the grounded shorting strip and the slits at the ground plane. The results indicate that the operation band covers 3.4-3.64 GHz, 4.8-5 GHz, and 5.15-5.95 GHz, and isolation between different ports is higher than 13.4 dB. With efficiencies of higher than 55%, the MIMO array is satisfying for 5G smartphone communication.

articleTitle: Maximal Peak Derivative and Peak Impulse Induced on Vivaldi Antenna Port by Radiated IEMI of Non-specifed Waveform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the worst-case scenario regarding an intentional electromagnetic interference (IEMI) of non-specified waveform illuminating a Vivaldi antenna, it is assumed that the antenna could be primarily disrupted/damaged by excessive peak derivative or peak impulse of the IEMI induced port voltage. Specifically, IEMI is modeled by a linearly polarized plane field of constrained energy density and bandwidth, but arbitrary time-domain waveform. Through analysis, both worst-case IEMI impinging waveforms and induced maximal peak derivative/impulse are obtained in closed-form, the obtained solutions could be used as figure-of-merits to quantify the radiated susceptibility of system against IEMI.

articleTitle: Characteristics Mode Inspired Circularly Polarized Selective Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A circularly polarized (CP) selective metasurface is proposed using characteristic mode analysis (CMA). A five-patch metasurface, consisting of $2 \times 2$ patches and an embedded cross-patch at the center, is proposed for CP response using CMA. A linearly polarized slot is placed between two five-patch metasurfaces for polarization selection. In this way, only the desired CP wave can pass the slot and the outgoing wave can be freely designed to be the left-hand or right-hand CP wave indicating a flexible polarization twisting capability. The designed CP selective metasurface has a relative bandwidth of 25.7% from 26.1 to 33.82 GHz with an insertion loss less than 1 dB.

articleTitle: Efficient time domain electromagnetic simulation of one-dimensional finite periodic structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel domain decomposition method (DDM) based on the spectral element time domain (SETD) method is proposed. For the one-dimensional domain decomposition electromagnetic structures, electric fields on each interface are solved at first, and then the internal electric fields in each domain are solved. The algorithm is especially suitable for finite periodic structures. Through the periodic numerical extension of typical structures, the electromagnetic simulation of periodic structures with arbitrary length can be realized. The accuracy and efficiency of the algorithm are demonstrated by a classic example.

articleTitle: Endfire Antenna Based on Spoof Surface Plasmon Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel endfire antenna based on spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs) transmission line is proposed in this paper. The main radiator of the antenna is excited by the SSPP transmission line. Due to the high transmission performance of the SSPP transmission line, which is realized by etching a series of periodic corrugated grooves on the microstrip. This antenna consists of two layers: On the upper layer, radiation elements are made up of periodic units and directors, the upper and bottom layers are symmetrically. The aperture is approximately 3λ0 × 0.85λ0, where λ0 is the space wavelength at the operational frequency 8 GHz. The antenna is designed to operate in the C-band and X-band, with an impedance bandwidth of 50% (6-10 GHz). The impedance bandwidth and total efficiency reach 50% and 95%, respectively. It is implemented on a single layer dielectric substrate for the endfire antenna. Due to the good performance, it has potential applications in radar and wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Broadband and Multiband Backscatter Enhancement of Dielectric Ellipsoid
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a modified method, which bases on the mode resonance theory of subwavelength particles, to enhance the bandwidth and backscattering cross-section for the ellipsoid. By adjusting the aspect ratio of ellipsoidal particles, the interactions among modes enable the individual ellipsoidal particle bandwidth to be extended and backscatter enhanced. And the simulation results of ellipsoids with different aspect radios show that ellipsoidal particles have better radar detectability than those of spherical particles, and the hollow ellipsoidal shell enables the broadband backscattering and enhances the multiband backscattering for the fixed aspect ratio.

articleTitle: Study of a 500GHz Second Harmonic Gyrotron Oscillator with Confocal Cavity
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: To meet the requirements for high frequency terahertz sources, one possible solution is to develop harmonic gyrotron oscillators. We present a design of gyrotron oscillator with quasi-optical confocal cavity which proves to possess good mode selectivity. The theoretic calculation shows the oscillator is working at 496GHz with 13.52% efficiency and 27kW output and the particle simulation is carried out to verify the theoretic calculation.

articleTitle: A 2-D Half Maxwell Fish-Eye Lens for Beam Scanning Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A two-dimensional (2-D) half Maxwell fish-eye lens (HMFL) antenna with beam scanning property is proposed in this paper. The gradient variation of the refractive index inside the lens is realized by the method of hollowing out the medium. Meanwhile, according to the high directionality of the HMFL and the defocused beam scanning characteristics, the discrete beam scanning in the range of ±24° is achieved by moving the feed source position, and the maximum gain of the designed antenna reaches 11.16 dBi.

articleTitle: A Weed Invasion and Genetic Hybrid Algorithm in Linear Sparse Array Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposed and implemented an genetic and weed invasion hybrid algorithm in Sparse Array Synthesis. The classical weed invasion algorithm has high requirements on the convergence parameters in the process of generating weeds from seeds. Inappropriate parameters can easily lead to local convergence of evolution. The mutation and crossover operations similar to the genetic algorithm were introduced into the classical weed invasion algorithm. The method improves convergence speed, avoids local convergence, and enhances the stability of the algorithm. The algorithm is used in practical application in the synthesis of linear sparsely distributed array pattern, and the predetermined index is obtained through calculation. At the same time, compared with the genetic algorithm and the classical weed invasion algorithm, the results show that the hybrid algorithm has certain advantages.

articleTitle: Characteristics Analysis on Dynamic Forward Scattering Echoes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Forward scatter radar (FSR) can achieve target detection by capturing the signal disturbance caused by the target crossing the baseline. Firstly, the FSR network based on the global navigation satellite system (GNSS) is constructed, and the basic conditions that constitute forward scattering are analyzed. Then, considering the satellite motion, a dynamic echo model is given. Finally, the influence of target parameters on the echo characteristics is analyzed by simulation. The feasibility of target detection based on GNSS-FSR is proved, and the work can provide a foundation for target detection and recognition of the FSR network.

articleTitle: Study on Langmuir Perturbation Under Non-uniform Mesh Nesting
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The full-scale simulation of electromagnetic wave heating ionosphere involves different sizes with large order of magnitude difference. In order to more accurately simulate the electromagnetic wave propagation of TEz electromagnetic wave in the oblique incidence ionosphere, this paper will discuss an effective FDTD (Finite-Difference Time-Domain) method with nonuniform grid nesting to simulate the numerical model, and obtain the relevant distribution of electric field under the formation of Langmuir turbulence in the ionosphere, compared with the traditional FDTD method with uniform fine grid, the time of uniform fine grid is nearly 5 times that of non-uniform nested grid. It is proved that compared with the traditional uniform fine grid method, the FDTD method using non-uniform nested grid can greatly reduce the computer running time and improve the computational efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Transmission control with a tunable chiral metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a tunable chiral metamaterial incorporated with active components of PIN diodes are proposed to dynamically control the asymmetric transmission performance of linearly polarized electromagnetic (EM) wave. With the change of working states of the PIN diodes, the chiral responses of the active metamaterial are tuned in real time. Experiments have been conducted to validate the design principle, which shows a flexible switching of the transmission amplitude at 6 GHz. The proposed method may provide an alternative way to facilitate the development of multi-functional EM device.

articleTitle: On Effective SNR Mapping based on Independent Subcarriers for Throughput Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Throughput is one of the most important performance indicators in wireless communication system. In this paper different signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) mapping methods are compared and an effective SNR mapping method based on independent subcarriers is selected that can facilitate throughput modeling of orthogonal frequency division multiplexing system. The effective SNR of the system is determined by using the independent subcarriers which can fully reflect the channel’s frequency selectivity using a small number of subcarriers. It can greatly reduce the complexity and time cost of throughput modeling. The accuracy of the throughput modeling method based on the effective SNR mapping method is demonstrated by the actual throughput measurements.

articleTitle: An Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) Generator Based on Fabry-Perot Resonator Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Here we propose an orbital angular momentum (OAM) generator that can generate high-gain OAM carrying beam. Based on the traditional Fabry-Perot resonant cavity antenna and a partially reflecting surface (PRS), the generator can modulate the amplitude and phase of transmitted and reflected waves simultaneously to generate high-gain OAM electromagnetic waves. The proposed OAM generator has a simple structure without any complex external networks. The feasibility of the proposed method is demonstrated by simulation results of two design examples, which generate OAM electromagnetic waves with realized gains of 12.7 dBi and 12.0 dBi, respectively.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Beamforming Method based on Steering Vector and Interference Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel robust beamforming method based on steering vector estimation and interference estimation under non-ideal conditions. First, the desired signal steering vector is estimated based on convex optimization while adding worst-case optimal constraints. Then, the interference power is estimated to obtain the noise and interfering covariance matrix. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves excellent performance and is robust to various types of mismatches.

articleTitle: Broadband external rejection miniaturized SIW filter based on C-shaped symmetric structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: To effectively improve the frequency selectivity of the filter, a substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) filter with miniaturization and out-of-band rejection was designed. To achieve the desired filter response, symmetrical C-shaped resonators are etched on the top and bottom layers of the SIW filter. The C-shaped resonator etched on the top layer of SIW achieves miniaturization and filtering characteristics. In order to improve the frequency response, a two-stage SIW filter and a SIW filter with coupled gap-ring defected ground structure (CGRDGS) are proposed, and an equivalent circuit is given to verify the transmission response. The simulation results show that the filter achieves miniaturization, out-of-band rejection and low insertion loss, which can be used in 5G wireless communication The simulation results show that the filter achieves miniaturization, out-of-band rejection and low insertion loss, which can be used in 5G wireless communication.

articleTitle: Approximation of Numerical Green’s Function Based on Deep Neural Network with Residual Blocks for Three-Dimensional Dielectric Objects
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we construct a deep neural network (DNN) model to approximate the three-dimensional numerical Green’s function. A space containing an inhomogeneous cube region is considered. The prediction of the converging DNN we trained is in good agreement with the results obtained by the method of moments (MoM), and it takes less CPU time and memory usage. Numerical examples are shown to illustrate the feasibility of the neural network we proposed.

articleTitle: Low-Cost 1-Bit Coding Array with Planar Phase-Delay-Line
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the analyses and designs of the 1-bit coding array with planar phase-delay-line (PDL) are presented. Firstly, the phenomenon of that the 1-bit coding array with spatial feed has no grating lobe while the 1-bit coding array with integrated feed has grating lobe are studied. The idea of using planar PDL to mitigate the grating lobe of the 1-bit coding array with integrated feed is proposed. The planar PDL, which can be integrated with the feeding structure, does not increase the profile of the array. Then, the planar PDL is applied to designs of the 1-bit linear coding array for ID scanning and the 1-bit planar coding array for 2D scanning. Grating lobes of the 1-bit coding array for ID and 2D scanning are mitigated which can show the feasibility of the planar PDL. The proposed 1-bit coding array with planar PDL has a low profile while its grating lobe is mitigated which is promising for practical applications.

articleTitle: Dual-Wideband Metasurface for Radar Cross Section Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a stacked metasurface has been developed to achieve dual-band radar cross section (RCS) reduction. Two subarrays with polarization conversion characteristic are designed to operate in two wide bands, respectively. By sandwiching the low-pass frequency selective surface (FSS) between two metasurface subarrays, the resultant subarray has the dual-band polarization conversion performance. With the arrangement of the dual-band subarray into a 2-by-2 array in a rotation way according to the polarization cancellation, the resultant metasurface structure has two −10dB RCS reduction bands covering 6.6~12.7 GHz and 27.8~38.1 GHz.

articleTitle: Landfill leakage detection method based on resistivity anomaly
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: At present, almost all the impermeable layers of landfills have leakage problems. Accurate detection of leakage points and monitoring of pollution plumes are of great significance to landfill pollution treatment and restoration. In this study, in-situ resistivity detection was used at the bottom of the landfill site, and Visual MODFLOW was used to establish a solute transport model of the landfill site. The results show that the specific location of the leakage point can be well detected by comparing resistivity anomalies before and after the leakage, and the groundwater model can be verified by converting resistivity data into concentration data. It verifies the feasibility of in-situ resistivity detection and realizes the prediction of pollution plume migration path, which can provide certain technical support for landfill leakage treatment and repair.

articleTitle: Development of a Chipless RFID Water Leakage Detecting Sensor Using Defected Ground Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a fully printable low-cost chipless RFID water leakage detecting sensor is presented. The sensor comprises of 3 λ/4 stubs to encode identity information. Each λ/4 stub represents a single data bit, thus 3 bits of data can be stored. The integration of pipeline water leakage sensing is performed by utilizing the resonant frequency of a bullet-slot DGS attached with a sponge. If the water pipe leaks because of cracks or failure of socket joint, the sponge absorbs water and affects the resonate characteristic of DGS. And the identity information of the sensor is guaranteed by the natural ground of λ/4 stubs. Experiment results show that the sensor has a high sensitivity to water, and has the advantages of independent control of sensing information and identity information.

articleTitle: Triple-band Hexagonal Loop Antenna with Capability of Beam Switching
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: There is an ever-increasing demand for multibeam and multi-band antenna systems. In this paper, a novel triple-band hexagonal loop antenna with capability of beam switching is designed. By properly designing the length and width of the hexagonal patch and the positions of the four feeding ports, the hexagonal loop antenna can work in three frequency bands with bandwidths of 3.80% (2.33-2.42 GHz), 3.32% (3.26-3.37 GHz) and 8.71% (4.25 - 4.64 GHz) respectively. The measured gains at resonant frequencies of 2.37, 3.31, and 4.48 GHz are about 6.08, 6.77 and 5.81 dBi, respectively. Furthermore, the hexagonal loop antenna can switch the beam in four quadrants by exciting different ports individually when working in the third band, which is applicable to smart communication systems.

articleTitle: A Wireless Communication System Based on Metasurfaces Supporting Frequency Hopping
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we use a digital coding metasurface to build a wireless communication system. The metasurface is loaded with PIN diodes controlled by the field-programmable gate array (FPGA). By changing the coding sequence in the FPGA, the status of the PIN diodes will switch between on and off, leading to the change of the metasurface’s reflection coefficient amplitude. When the carrier wave is incident on it, the modulated wave is produced. We use software to simulate the unit cell of the metasurface and the reflection amplitude can change by 0.86 at 2.1 GHz when the PIN diodes are on or off. Based on this, we fabricate a sample and try to use it to transmit a picture wirelessly. We convert the picture into a binary bitstream as the based signal in the FPGA, and then the metasurface can carry information through coding. When we use a signal source to send a sinusoidal signal with a frequency of 2.1 GHz as a carrier wave, it is modulated by the metasurface. At the receiving terminal, we use the GNU Radio software to process the data received by the universal software radio peripheral (USRP) to recover the picture information from the sending side. To verify the feasibility of the system, we send a picture to test. The result shows that we receive the pictures successfully. The experiment means that the coding metasurface has a good application prospect in the field of communication. Further, we have developed frequency hopping transmission based on the communication system to test the effectiveness of metasurface communication over a wide frequency range. The result shows that the frequency hopping is well supported.

articleTitle: Intelligent ultrasonic distance measurer system with temperature compensation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With regard to distance measurement in daily life, the traditional way is to measure the distance between objects through rulers. Nowadays, ultrasonic ranging, laser ranging, radar ranging, sonar ranging and other technologies have enriched the way of distance measurement. At the same time, it is possible to choose a suitable solution according to different actual environments. This paper design an intelligent ultrasonic ranging system through the research of ultrasonic characteristics and the application of existing ultrasonic ranging. The paper introduces the design ideas and process of the intelligent ultrasonic ranging system. Through the design of independent buttons, the normal mode ranging and the high-precision mode ranging are generated to achieve the division of the measurement range and accuracy. When the distance between the measured object and the intelligent ultrasonic ranging system is less than the preset value or exceeds the range of this mode, the buzzer will sound an alarm, so that the system can be used in more fields. The system detects the current ambient temperature in real time, so that the distance measurement can be compensated and modified by the temperature compensation algorithm in the system to achieve self-adaptation and reduce measurement errors.

articleTitle: Investigation on 650 GHz Sheet-Beam Staggered Double-Vane Traveling Wave Tube
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A 650 GHz staggered double-vane traveling wave tube (TWT) is designed in this paper. The high frequency, transmission characteristics of slow wave structures (SWS) at two different voltages are simulated and analyzed. The particle-in-cell (PIC) simulation is also calculated and the results indicate that the tube can produce 5.5 W output power at 650 GHz under the condition of 18.1 kV operating voltage, 15 mA current and 1 mW input power. The corresponding gain is more than 37 dB without an attenuator.

articleTitle: A Wideband Horn Antenna with Dielectric Lens Loaded
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper a wideband horn antenna with planar dielectric lens loaded is proposed. Traditional lens is the three-dimensional structure and fabricated with different materials, which has bulk size. This drawback limits the application of dielectric lens. To solve this problem, gradient index (GRIN) metamatetial has been used to planarize sphere lens in this paper. The proposed horn lens antenna has a gain above 27dBi in Ku band.

articleTitle: Broadband Wide-Angle Linear-to-Circular Polarization Converter Based on Metal Strips Loaded Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A transmissive broadband wide-angle linear-to-circular polarization converter based on metal strips loaded metasurface is proposed in this paper. The converter is composed of three metallic layers separated by dielectric substrates and the metal strips printed on each layer keep orthogonal to each other. To further investigate the operating mechanism of the design, equivalent circuit models are presented. Moreover, the converter is verified to be effective in polarization conversion through the full-wave simulation. With the insertion loss less than 2 dB and 3 dB, the simulation 3-dB axial ratio (AR) bandwidth keeps 67% and 76%, respectively. Furthermore, at an increased incident angle of 40°, the device can still maintain an AR bandwidth over 47% at 2 dB insertion loss, which manifests the validity and rationality of the converter design.

articleTitle: An Adaptive High-Order Time Integration Method for Discontinuous Galerkin Time-Domain Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Explicit Discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (DGTD) methods often suffer from tiny time-step sizes induced by the fine meshes for resolving electrically fine structures in multiscale scenarios. In this manuscript, an unconditionally stable time integration method with adaptive high order of accuracy is developed for DGTD methods. The essence of the proposed method is to project the matrix exponential of the time-stepping operators on Krylov subspace to realize model order reduction. The performance of the proposed method over explicit and implicit time integration methods is validated by numerical experiments.

articleTitle: Near-Field High-Speed Target InISAR Imaging Based on Wavenumber Domain Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a near-field high-speed target InISAR imaging method based on wavenumber domain interpolation is proposed. The focusing of the ISAR image is accomplished by performing Stolt interpolation on the echo signal in the wavenumber domain. Three-dimensional imaging is achieved by interferometric imaging algorithms. The algorithm simulation is carried out using the scattering point model generated by the electromagnetic simulation software, and the validity and stability of the algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: A 3-12GHz compact broadband circularly polarized Archimedean planar spiral antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A compact broadband circularly polarized Archimedean planar spiral antenna is proposed. The proposed antenna is consisted of a two-armed Archimedean spiral antenna. The current path is elongated by sinusoidal loading of Archimedes lines to miniaturize the size of proposed antenna. Two 100 Ω lumped resistors are loaded to improve the radiation performance of antenna in low frequency. Forward radiation and improved axial ratio performance are achieved through loading a metal back cavity with two orthogonal rectangular slots and a circular slot at the intersection of the rectangular slots at the bottom of antenna. The size of the proposed antenna is 44 × 44 × 30 mm<sup>3</sup>. The proposed antenna achieves a voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) of less than 1.5, an axial ratio performance of less than 3 dB, and a gain performance of more than 4 dBi in the range of 3-12 GHz.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual-band Waveform Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a waveform selective surface (WSS) with dual-band property. By combining a conventional frequency selective surface (FSS) with circuit components, different responses to continuous and pulsed waves in a specified frequency band are achieved. The waveform selectivity is achieved by using the rectification characteristic of the diode and the time-domain response characteristic of the capacitor/inductor circuit. By properly design of the unit structures, waveform selectivity is realized in two independent frequency band.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization Based on PSO for Equivalent Circuit Model of Injection Probe
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is applied to optimize equivalent circuit model parameters of the injection probe. Different optimization objectives are also given in this paper to suit for various needs. Numerical results showed that primary equivalence circuit as well as two parallel RLC branches make the frequency-dependent impedance close enough to the measured one below 300MHz, which is the frequency band of interest for High-altitude Electromagnetic Pulse (HEMP). Deviation of impedance at frequency higher than 300MHz and different optimization results for a given optimization objective are all due to the topology of the equivalence circuit.

articleTitle: Altitude Estimation for Forward-Looking Radar Based on Doppler Sharpening
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a new altitude estimation method for forward-looking radar based on Doppler sharpening, to enhance the azimuth measurement resolution of radar altimeter on missile-borne radar seeker. The method obtains the echo of beam center by Doppler sharpening, and estimates the range of beam center by a gravity method. The altitude is calculated by the estimated range and the beam angle. Doppler frequency interval in Doppler sharpening determines the azimuth resolution, and a certain azimuth measurement resolution can be realized by setting a certain azimuth accumulation pulse number for Doppler sharpening. Simulation results show that this method has high estimation accuracy and good following performance for rugged topography.

articleTitle: A Novel Dual-Functional Method for Wide-Angle Scanning Phased Array
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel method to enhance the wide-angle scanning capability (WASC) of the array antenna is introduced in this letter, where can reduce the inter-element mutual coupling of the array and broaden the beam-width of the element in the array. Because of the bent metal plates, the horizontal and vertical currents are produced in the element of the array, which can extend the beam-width of the element in the array. Meanwhile, the decoupling function can be realized by the converse vertical currents from the adjacent antenna elements. Two 1×8 linear arrays are fabricated and tested to demonstrate the proposed method. The measured antenna performance accords with the simulated performance. The proposed array can scan the coverage of ±60° with a realized gain variation under 3 dB and lower side lobe level (SLL) under -7.9dB within the operating band from 4.5 to 5.0 GHz. Therefore, the proposed method has been demonstrated in the linear array and can be promoted to apply in the planar array for wireless communication systems, especially in the large coverage communication system.

articleTitle: Wireless Channel Modeling in Complex Urban Environment Based on High Frequency Asymptotic Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the increasing development of wireless communication, the construction of mobile communication base stations is becoming more and more intensive, so the electromagnetic radiation safety problem brought by mobile communication base stations has become a focus of concern. Mechanism and characteristics of electromagnetic wave propagation (multiple reflection, diffraction and scattering) are comprehensively considered, and the electromagnetic distribution of mobile communication base stations in complex urban environment is simulated by using Ray Tracing method and Uniform Theory of Diffraction (UTD) for high frequency asymptotic method in this paper. The propagation path from the transmitter to the receiver is determined by using the Ray Tracing method, and the composite electric field of each propagation path is estimated by using the Uniform Theory of Diffraction. Taking a mobile communication base station in Xicheng District of Beijing as the research object, the antenna model and the scene model consistent with the actual channel scene are constructed. The radio propagation model is established based on the Ray Tracing method and Uniform Theory of Diffraction. The electromagnetic distribution of the ground and the outer surface of the building model in the study area are simulated and calculated, and the research content provides the basis for further wireless channel modeling and electromagnetic distribution research.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Information Characterizations for Information Metasurface Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Electromagnetic (EM) fields reflect the spatio-temporal characteristics of information as its carrier. Analyzing information parameters under EM theory to interpret spatial properties has received attention in recent years. In this paper, we proposed an approach for analyzing EM information characteristics of information metasurface systems by applying principles of electromagnetics. The designed system takes a coded information metasurface with a probability distribution of each coding pattern as the source. And the receiver measures far-fields in free space at given positions. A Fourier transform (FT) method is applied to evaluate the scattering far fields. The posterior probabilities under each receiving scattering field are obtained based on Bayes’ theorem. Parameters including entropy, non-average mutual information (NAMI) and average mutual information (AMI) are then obtained from the posterior probabilities. Channel capacity is then derived from AMI, and its influencing factors are analyzed. Furthermore, field correlation information parameters in the far fields are proposed to analyze the correlation degree, from which the mutual information of joint observation is then analyzed. The proposed method provides references for analyzing information metasurface systems like the emergent direct digital modulation (DDM) system with strong application potentials. This method can also be readily extended to other electromagnetic information systems.

articleTitle: 1-bit Coding Metasurface for Wideband RCS Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper achieve efficient RCS reduction over a wide frequency range by exploiting the reflection properties of the coding metasurface. The metasurface consists of “0” cells and “1” cells, and the reflection phase difference is close to 180° over a wide frequency range. By designing the spatial random coding arrangement of “0” units and “1” units, the electromagnetic waves incident on the metasurface form diffuse reflection, so as to achieve the purpose of broadband RCS reduction. The simulation results show that when the incident wave is irradiated vertically, the metasurface can basically achieve a RCS reduction of more than 10dB in a wide frequency band of 10-20.5GHz compared to a metal plate of the same size. In the case of oblique incidence, the RCS reduction still has a good effect, which is basically the same as the curve at normal incidence, and has the characteristics of wide-angle incidence RCS reduction. The reduced bandwidth of the broadband RCS of the coding metasurface is basically consistent with the 10 dB polarization bandwidth of the cell structure. The design of the metasurface is simple and efficient, so it has great application potential in stealth new technologies and new materials.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual-Polarized Printed Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper designed a dual-polarized printed dipole antenna which is composed of multiple layer substrates. Two printed radiators are located on different dielectric substrates, and they are placed orthogonally to each other to form two orthogonal radiator ports. For each polarization port, the coaxial line bottom feeding is used. The sizes of feeding structure and radiator of the two polarization ports are designed independently to meet the radiation performance of the antenna. The designed dual polarization antenna uses a metal via array to form a metal cavity. Under the condition of the array, it is convenient to improve the isolation between antenna elements. In order to reduce the size of the antenna, the dielectric embedding antenna technology is adopted, and a dielectric substrate with a certain thickness is placed above the surface of the dual polarization antenna to improve the equivalent dielectric constant. A dual polarization printed dipole antenna operating at 12.6GHz ~ 13.2GHz is designed and simulated. The antenna contains a five-layer dielectric substrate structure. The simulation results show that at the central frequency, the gains of the upper and lower polarization ports are about 2.34dB and 3.36dB respectively, the isolation of the two polarization ports is greater than 20dB, and the cross-polarization level is about 20dB in the main radiation pattern. The voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) of the two polarization ports is less than 2. At the same time, it can be observed that the two polarization ports have wide beam performance and are suitable for array applications.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Wideband Metal Vivaldi Array Antenna For SKA MFAA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The SKA (Square Kilometer Array) will be the world’s largest synthesis radio telescope, which contains the Dish, the Middle-frequency Aperture Array (MFAA) and the Low-frequency Aperture Array (LFAA). The needs of MFAA are independent orthogonal polarization, 0.4-1.4GHz, conical scanning 45°. Two kinds of ultra-wideband wide-angle scan dual-polarization array antennas are designed and manufactured for the SKA MFAA by the East China Research Institute of Electronic Engineering (ECRIEE), and the metal vivaldi array antenna are introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Dual-Mode Circular-Shape Microstrip Patch Antenna For The Millimeter-Wave Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A circular-shape microstrip patch antenna with dual-port for pattern diversity is described in this work. A conventional broadside pattern mode is radiated by a circular microstrip patch antenna, while a conical pattern is generated by a shorted annular ring which surrounds the circular patch. Pin probes are employed to feed the two radiators through substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) transmission lines on the bottom layer, and small-form factor SMP connectors which are connected to the SIW transmission lines through grounded coplanar waveguide (GCPW)-to-SIW transitions. The antenna has been designed for the 28 GHz frequency band, and numerical results show good agreement between theoretical and simulated patterns.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Accelerated GMRES Solution of Electromagnetic Scattering From Dielectric Objects
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The generalized minimal residual (GMRES) is accelerated by the deep learning (DL) netwowrk to solve electromagnetic scattering problems. Numerical results show that the DL accelerated GMRES outperforms the traditional GMRES in terms of computational speed under the comparable accuracy.

articleTitle: Real-Time Path Planning based on the Lock Loss Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A new method of aircraft low altitude penetration is proposed with temporal constraints that allow periods of high observability interspersed with periods of low observability. The aircraft’s RCS character is simplified into the “bow-tie” distribution, then the aircraft can dynamically adjust its yaw angle to minimize the risk from the radars. According to the modified Lock Loss model and the TWS(Track While Scan) radar work flow, and real-time evaluating model on the original path, a fast real-time path planning method is present on the situation that unexpected threats occur. An example of real-time path planning is given.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Enabled Inverse Design and Optimization of the Frequency Selective Surface (FSS)
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a neural network model is proposed to design and optimize the frequency selective surface (FSS) structure. The training set and testing set of several classic structures are obtained by High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) simulations. Using neural network, a targeted transmission coefficient curve (v. s. frequency) is firstly classified to select the most suitable type of classical structure as an initial template for design, and then further modification is carried out based on this template to match the targeted transmission coefficient in a more precise way. Subsequently, Bayesian optimization is used to adjust the hyper-parameters of the network. Through the proposed model, we can successfully design the FSS structural parameters corresponding to the required transmission coefficient $(S_{21})$. Compared to the traditional FSS design method using neural network, this proposed method greatly improves the accuracy of inverse design and can be used to design FSS structures corresponding to more types of S<inf>21</inf> curves.

articleTitle: AI-TCM-based Solver for Scattering Problems by Two-dimensional PEC Objects
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a strategy to solve 2D scattering problems using artificial intelligence (AI) and the theory of characteristic mode (TCM). Because the characteristic modes (CMs) are independent of incident waves, the artificial neural network (ANN) can focus on extracting the inherent features of the target, which in terms of CMs are the generalized characteristic values and wave coefficients. A combined convolutional neural network (CNN) and attention-based neural network is employed in this paper. Numerical results show that the proposed scheme can well predict the scattering field by 2D PEC targets with arbitrary incident direction.

articleTitle: Influence of clusters on radiation properties of Si3N4 particles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We analyze the radiation characteristics of $Si_{3}N_{4}$ elementary particles based on Mie theory, and $Si_{3}N_{4}$ cluster particles by GMM theory. The results show that the larger the $Si_{3}N_{4}$ cluster particles, the larger the extinction factor and scattering factor, which variation trend is similar to that of the elementary particles with the same scale, and the position of the scattering peak is also similar to that of the elementary particles. The influence of cluster particles on the amplitude of absorption factor is relatively small, but some absorption characteristic peaks disappear, which is very different from the elementary particles with the same scale.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Dual-Polarized Patch Antenna With Low Cross Polarization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a ±45° dual-polarized antenna is proposed, which mainly consists of a main radiator, a parasitic patch, a feed network and a box-type reflector plate. The miniaturization of the antenna is achieved by adding a dielectric between the main radiator and the reflector plate, and the size of the main radiator is $0.257\lambda_{0}\times 0.257\lambda_{0}$. The simulation results show that the antenna has the −14dB bandwidth of 2.42GHz~2.74GHz, the gain of 7.8dBi~8.3dBi, the half-power beamwidth of 67.2°~3.5°, the axial cross-polarization ratio greater than 33dB, and the ~60° cross-polarization ratio greater than 10dB.

articleTitle: Wideband Isolation Reconfigurable Technique for MIMO Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel wideband isolation reconfigurable technique (WIRT) is proposed for designing wideband high isolation MIMO array antenna.
