The WIRT is based on the microfluidic, pump and ethyl acetate, which is adopted to realize frequency shift of the max isolation. A wideband MIMO array antenna with high port isolation is selected as original antenna array (OAA). Measured results reveal that isolation lower than −35 dB can be stably scanned from 1.9 to 2.17 GHz by turning on the reconfigurable structure. And isolation lower than −25 dB can cover the whole operation frequency band that ranges from 1.83 to 2.17 GHz. Thus, this concept provides a new idea for designing wideband high isolation MIMO array antenna.

articleTitle: High-Rejection Compact Wideband Bandpass Filter Based on Bent Coupled Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A simple planar structure with high stopband rejection for bandpass filter (BPF) is proposed in this paper. The circuit structure consists of three groups of coupled lines (CLs), two short-circuit stubs (SCSs), and stepped-impedance stubs (SISs) to achieve high selectivity of six transmission poles (TPs) and four transmission zeros (TZs). For demonstration, a design prototype working at 2.32 GHz, with 3-dB fractional bandwidth (FBW) of 74.1% is simulated, manufactured, and measured. Moreover, the size of the prototype is successfully reduced using the proposed layout method with the performance not deteriorating. The simulation results are in good agreement with the measured results.

articleTitle: Asymmetric three-dimensional metamaterial absorber for microwave application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an asymmetric three-dimensional metamaterial absorber (3D-MA) for microwave application is presented. The designed 3D-MA is composed of a hollow vertical periodic crossed mesh array. Two metal split ring resonators (SRRs) of different sizes are printed on the substrate. The asymmetric mechanism is deeply analyzed and discussed from the perspective of the equivalent circuit. The final simulation results show that the designed 3D-MA can achieve broadband absorption with absorptivity over 80% in the frequency range of 1.84-2.8 GHz and 2.9-3.72 GHz when the electromagnetic wave is incident along the z direction. However, when the electromagnetic wave is incident from the reverse side, the incoming energy is near-total reflected. The calculated results of the equivalent circuit model agree well with the electromagnetic simulation results. The designed 3D-MA has great potential applications in the field of radar asymmetric recognition, detection, and stealth.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of repeater deceptive jamming to SAR based on shift-frequency
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the change of battlefield form, the pressure jamming requires the jammer to have large power, and the jamming efficiency is low, so the spoofing jamming comes into being. In this paper, the linear frequency modulation signal and fuzzy function are analyzed to verify the feasibility of using frequency shift forwarding to generate virtual images, and the two-dimensional frequency shift method is used to generate virtual images at specific locations to deceive local radar.

articleTitle: Study on direct optically controlled frequency selective surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Compared with traditional active frequency selective surface (AFSS), the direct optically controlled FSS (DOCFSS) has many advantages, but the research of DOCFSS is still in its infancy and faces many difficulties. This paper compares several semiconductor materials used in DOCFSS in the past, studies the corresponding semiconductor parameters, and determines that gallium arsenide (GaAs) is a potential semiconductor material for direct optically control. In addition, an important issue in DOCFSS is the design of the light-feeding system. This paper also discusses the LED light-feeding scheme including the focusing lens and the focusing plastic column, and the laser light-feeding scheme realized by optical fiber or micro lens array. Finally, the application of semiconductors in DOCFSS is studied.

articleTitle: Digital coding transmisive metasurface for dual-OAM-beam Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) is a phenomenon of vortex wavefront for electromagnetic wave which has the characteristics of infinite orthogonal modes. Here, a digital coding transmissive metasurface has been presented for dual-OAM-beam generation. The 3bit coding elements are designed based on Pancharatnam-Berry phase (PB phase) principle for 360deg phase shifting. By assembling the metausrface, the dual-beam with −1 mode OAM is emerged in free space. Afterwards, the simulated results illustrate the well performance of proposed metasurface, which are coincide with the theoretical results. The proposed digital coding transmissive metasurface has potential application in wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Design of High Performance Reed-Solomon Encoder Based on A Novel Half-multiplier
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the problem of high computation complexity in the hardware implementation of the Galois Field (GF) multiplier in commonly used Reed-Solomon (RS) coding algorithms, a half-multiplier based on this matrix method is redesigned and the RS coding module is also optimized. The simulated results are provided to show that the hardware resource of using the designed encoder can decrease by about 15% than that of using the Xilinx official encoder, while the accuracy of the coding keeps the same level.

articleTitle: EM Scattering of Land-sea Junction Area Based on DEM and SBR
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The electromagnetic scattering of land-sea junction area derived from digital elevation model (DEM) is studied by the method of shooting and bouncing ray (SBR) in this paper. The DEM is converted into a mesh model in *.stl format by Global Mapper firstly. And then the mesh model is translated to the center of the coordinate system by Rotate operation and Translate operation. Finally, the point cloud data needed in the computing electromagnetic scattering is generated. The basic idea and related formulations of SBR are presented in section II. The electromagnetic scattering of a land-sea junction area with the size of 500m*500m in Zhoushan Island is calculated and discussed.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Reconfigurable Backing Cavity Patch Antenna With Graphene-Loaded
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The duan-band reconfigurable backing cavity patch antenna with graphene-loaded has been proposed and demonstrated in this article. The proposed antenna consists of a backing cavity patch antenna and a rectangular slot is cut into the patch and filled with graphene. The performance is analyzed in terms of its directivity, S<inf>11</inf>, and bandwidth for different chemical potential. By applying different voltages on graphene stack, the antenna is frequency reconfigurable.

articleTitle: A Dual-band Inclined Polarized Hemispherical Luneberg-lens Antenna for Wide-angle Scanning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: According to the practical application, most electrical performances of a spherical Luneberg-lens antenna on its hemi-half space can be realized by a hemispherical Luneberg-lens antenna mounted on a mental reflector plane. A 45-degree inclined polarized hemispherical Luneberg-lens antenna working on both centimeter-wave band ($f_{1}\sim 3*f_{1}$, a relative bandwidth of 100%) and millimeter-wave band ($f_{\mathrm{L}}\sim f_{\mathrm{I}\mathrm{I}}$, a relative bandwidth of 25%) is introduced in this paper. With two feed horns fixed, the proposed antenna can realize a beam scanning from 20 degree to 90 degree in elevation by rotating the lens antennas around their center.

articleTitle: Bandpass Filter with Ultra-Wideband External Suppression Based on Half Mode Substrate Integrated Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an ultra-wideband and high out-band suppression filter based on half mode substrate integrated waveguide (HMSIW) structure is designed and measured. The coupling between filter cavities is realized by rectangular slot, then the coupling strength of the filter is adjusted by changing the size of the coupling slot. The coplanar waveguide (CPW) structure is used in the feeding part, which can greatly improves the out of band selectivity of the filter. Simulated results show that the bandwidth of the proposed filter is about 52.18% The characteristics of ultra-wideband and high out of band suppression are realized. The measured results are in good agreement with the simulated ones. The proposed HMSIW filter can be applied in communication systems.

articleTitle: Physical Mechanisms of Passive Intermodulation: A Short Review
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper describes the physical mechanisms of passive intermodulation generation, including nonlinearity in metal contacts and materials. The nonlinearity in metal contact considers the weakly nonlinear conduction mechanism under microscopic condition, surface roughness, mechanical stress and symmetry of contact interfaces. The nonlinearity in material considers the multiphysics coupling effects inside the transmission line, such as thermo-electricity coupling, nonlinear source scattering effects, and other structural factors. Finally, the future development direction is clarified according to the research trends.

articleTitle: Multi-Spatial-Harmonic Intensity Tailoring Based on Nonlinearly-Phased Reprogrammable Grating
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we report a nonlinearly-phased reprogrammable grating to reconstruct electromagnetic wavefronts dynamically. Each unit cell of such the grating integrates a varactor diode to enable large phase coverage of more than 305° with low reflection loss less than −2dB. By adjusting nonlinear phase distributions at the grating interface properly, reflection angles and reflection intensities of interested spatial harmonics can be modulated as desired, thereby reconstructing various electromagnetic wavefronts. As a proof of concept, two-spatial-harmonic intensity tailoring is presented and verified. Good agreement between simulation and experimental results shows that the proposed grating enables intensity tailoring of multiple spatial harmonics in an arbitrary and precise manner.

articleTitle: On the Phase Change of Electric Field in the Elliptical Polarization of Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The phase change of electric field in terms of time does not have a clear-cut form in the generalized elliptical polarization of antennas and it is clarified in this paper. Also, the comparison and analysis are made for the periodicity, monotonicity and slopes of the functions under two types of elliptical polarization by using the idea of limits and combining the properties of composite functions and basic elementary functions. Finally, the figures the electric field traces as a function of $\omega$t are obtained exactly and the basis for obtaining them is detailed. This paper solves the phase change of electric field in terms of time functions for elliptic polarization and can help the reader to better understand how the electric field traces as a function of time in the case of elliptical polarization.

articleTitle: A Novel Compact Dual Band-Notched Antenna Design Based on Semicircular Split Ring Resonator Electromagnetic-Bandgap Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Dual band-notched cup-shaped monopole antenna for ultra-wide band (UWB) applications is proposed in this paper. The proposed antenna utilizes one semicircular split ring resonator electromagnetic bandgap (SCSR-EBG) structure to achieve dual band notched design. The measured results show that the proposed antenna has ascendant dual band-notched features of the WiMAX and WLAN bands. At the same time, it has stable radiation characteristics in the operating frequency, which can be used in compact ultra-wideband communication system.

articleTitle: Modeling of Conducted Electromagnetic Interference in DC-DC Converters of Shipping Platforms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: When the high-power electrical equipment on the shipping platform works with the short-time work status, it will have a huge impact on the ship’s DC power grid. In order to reduce the impact, DC-DC converters are often used to charge large-capacity energy storage equipment first, and the energy storage equipment provides energy for other transient high-power electrical equipment. Since the impedance of the large-capacity energy storage equipment is time-varying when it is used as a load, the work status of the DC-DC converter is different from the previous work status. This paper proposes a time-domain theoretical modeling method of conducted electromagnetic interference (EMI) for a DC-DC converter-Buck circuit with short-time work status. The EMI theoretical calculation results are compared with the simulation simulated results of Simulink, and then it is used to analyze the EMI characteristics of the DC-DC converter.

articleTitle: A Compact, Low Profile Log-Periodic Monopole Array with an Ultra-Wideband Stripline Transition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A Compact, Low Profile Log-Periodic Monopole Array with an ultra-wideband stripline transition is proposed in this paper. It consists of 7 top hat loaded monopole elements, which ensures the whole structure to be compact and low profile. The ultra-wideband stripline transition is used to keep the consistence between feeding direction and antenna radiation direction. The proposed antenna has an extremely low profile of 0.043$\lambda_{L}$, and a compact size of 0.60 $\lambda_{L}$×0.16$\lambda_{L}$ in transverse dimension, ($\lambda_{L}$ is the free-space wavelength at the b west operating frequency). Simulation results shows that from 0.6-3.1 GHz (135%) in terms of VSWR <3 and max gain of 6.5dBi is obtained.

articleTitle: Finite Element Tearing and Interconnecting Modeling of Finite Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Numerical modeling and simulation plays an important role in the design and analysis of electromagnetic metasurfaces. However, finite periodic array structures often lead to high computational costs. In this paper, an accurate and efficient numerical modeling method based on a finite element tearing and interconnecting (FETI) is proposed to analyze the electromagnetic metasurfaces. For the finite periodic arrays of metasurfaces, the FETI method can significantly reduce the simulation costs by exploiting the structural repetitiveness. Numerical results show the effectiveness of the proposed method for the analysis of electromagnetic metasurfaces.

articleTitle: High order SF-SFDTD method for solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A high-order spatial filtering-symplectic finite difference time domain (SF-SFDTD) scheme with controllable stability condition is proposed to solve the time-dependent Schrödinger equation (TDSE). Firstly, the higher-order symplectic framework for the discretization of Schrödinger equation is described, and then the spatial filtering method is carried out to extend the stability of the standard SFDTD method. Finally, a numerical example is given to evaluate the correctness of the SF-SFDTD method in numerical solving Schrödinger equation.

articleTitle: Dynamically Tunable Power Divider Based on Graphene Flakes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel dynamically tunable power divider with high isolation is proposed in this paper. This power divider has the capacity to alter continuously the output power by using two graphene flakes and two open-ended microstrip stubs. In particular, the total length of the graphene flake and the open-ended microstrip stub is quarter-wavelength. Based on the traditional Wilkinson power divider, the output ports have been added with a combination of graphene flake and open-ended microstrip stub, respectively. Thus, a two-way dynamically tunable power divider is designed and analyzed, with the operating range from 2.682 to 3.278 GHz. Eventually, the microstrip tunable power divider is designed on a commercial substrate (RT/duroid 5880). The sheet resistance of graphene flake can be changed by different voltages, the simulated Sii is less than −10dB, the attenuation range is better than 3 dB, and the port-to-port isolation is better than 25 dB in the operating frequency. This power divider allows the attenuation of the output ports to be changed independently.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Monostatic and Bistatic RCS Scattering Characteristics for Corner Reflector
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The radar corner reflector stands as a typical passive jamming decoy in electronic countermeasures, which presents distinctive Radar Cross Section (RCS) features in monostatic or bistatic radar owing to its particular geometric structure. In this paper, the monostatic and bistatic RCS characteristics of a single octahedral corner reflector and octahedral corner reflector array are analyzed. The impact of different bistatic base angles on the RCS area of the corner reflector is also studied by contrasting the main lobe width and statistical parameters of the RCS, which provides theoretical analysis and data support for the effective identification of targets and corner reflector decoys.

articleTitle: High Gain End-fire Antenna Based on Spoof Surface Plasmon Polariton
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A high-gain end-fire antenna based on Spoof Surface Plasmon Polariton is proposed. The antenna consists of SSPP transmission line loaded with two G-shaped resonators and five SSPP arrays. Better impedance matching can be achieved by adjusting the length of the SSPP transmission line. The antenna gain can be improved by adjusting the number of SSPP arrays. The antenna has a broadband characteristic of 14.4% (8.52-9.85 GHz) with a peak gain of 8.84 dBi at 9.60 GHz. The proposed antenna structure has a high antenna gain compared to other end-fire antennas.

articleTitle: Research on Heterogeneous Parallel Algorithms for Radar Signal Processing in OpenCL Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An efficient radar signal processing parallel algorithm for Open Computing Language (OpenCL) is presented in this paper, which reveals a rational allocation schema of tasks between the central processing unit (CPU) and the graphics processing unit (GPU). The powerful parallel processing ability of GPU is used to replace the traditional serial processing method by the way of pipeline acceleration and algorithm parallel acceleration, and the real-time performance of the proposed algorithm is improved by the design idea of intra-module parallelism and inter-module flow processing. The algorithm is applied to CPU-GPU heterogeneous computing platform and has a good portability. The effectiveness and real-time performance of the algorithm are verified through simulation data.

articleTitle: FSS Design using Surface Susceptibility and Porosity Models
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Frequency selective surfaces (FSSs) are composed of an assembly of identical elements arranged in a two-dimensional lattice. The design of FSSs commonly involves tedious optimization and lacks of systematic way to choose the best compromise. Thus, this study proposes a new and systematic method of FSS design to avoid the tedious optimization. That is by establishing database of Surface Susceptibility Models (SSM) and Surface Porosity Models (SPM). We first explain the mathematical relations of SSM and SPM and their analogy to circuit quantities. After this, we present the procedure to design FSSs with the pre-established database and the well-developed microwave circuit theories. Finally, we illustrate an example of a three-order FSS design using the proposed method.

articleTitle: A passive RFID-based security detection sensor for doors and windows
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper designs a passive chipless RFID door and window security detection sensor operating at a fundamental frequency of $f_{0}=915$ MHz. The dielectric substrate of the sensor is a 1.5 mm thick FR_4 double-sided copper-clad board, and the overall structure includes a fundamental frequency receiving antenna, a frequency doubling circuit, a second harmonic filter, a magnetic induction switch, a magnet and a harmonic transmitting antenna, which has the features of simple structure, long detection distance, low cost and high robustness. The experimental results show that the working distance between the reader and the sensor can reach more than 4 m when the transmitting power is 20 dBm under the condition that the door or window is opened accidentally, which can realize the long-distance monitoring function.

articleTitle: Optimal imaging and semantic segmentation of the human body for passive THz security inspection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper studies the imaging of a passive terahertz imaging system of a one-dimensional antenna array rotary-scanning system of human body. After singular spectrum analysis, we extract the terahertz energy distribution in the target region for imaging. Then we use the Deeplabv3+ network to semantically segment the human body and carry-ons in the imaging results and use the cycle generative adversarial network to train the terahertz images with the simultaneously acquired optical images to improve the integrity and image resolution of the target contours in the terahertz images. The algorithm is experimentally validated by the passive terahertz imaging system, which can achieve an imaging speed of 4 frames per second and a minimum segmentation accuracy of 3 cm. The algorithm is suitable for passive terahertz imaging of low-sensitivity detectors.

articleTitle: Antenna Measurement in Outdoor Environment Based on a Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents an outdoor antenna measurement system based on a Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV). The hardware structure of the system and a data sampling method for the antenna radiation pattern are proposed. The path loss, pointing and polarization errors caused by position errors and attitude of UAV are calibrated through feedback loop. Through the outdoor experiment of measuring the radiation pattern of the S-band standard gain horn antenna at 3.7GHz, it is verified that the repeatability of the system is better than 0.28 dB (root mean square, RMS). This antenna measurement system could be used for over the air (OTA) radio frequency (RF) performance measurement in base station and radar.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Wideband Dual-Polarized Sinuous Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A sinuous antenna with ultra-wideband and dual-linear polarization is proposed in this paper. The proposed antenna consists of four radiation arms, two microstrip tapered baluns and an absorptive cavity. Four radiation arms are used to achieve wideband radiation characteristic. Feeding sections are realized by using microstrip tapered balun. To achieve the unidirectional radiation, the antenna is backed by a absorptive cavity. The simulated results show that the proposed antenna has a ultra-wideband from 1GHz to 13GHz for VSWR $\leq$3.0 and a relatively stable radiation characteristic.

articleTitle: Kalman Filter Algorithm in the Presence of Multipath
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: When radar is tracking and measuring a low altitude target, the result of antenna beam pointing and height measurement will seriously deviate from the target truth value due to the influence of multipath effect. For the target data obtained by monopulse or other angular measurement algorithms, after Kalman filtering processing, the measurement results of target height with smaller error and the beam pointing at the next moment of antenna can be obtained. Simulation results of one-dimensional linear array and two-dimensional motion plane show that the algorithm can obtain better data processing results, and can effectively reduce the Angle error even under severe multipath interference.

articleTitle: GPU Accelerated DGTD Method for Analyzing Electromagnetic Scattering Problems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an efficient method which use the GPU parallel technology to speed up the time iterative process of the time-domain discontinuous Galerkin method (DGTD). the parallelization strategy after introducing the Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA) devices is the focus of this paper. The numerical results prove that the DGTD not only has reliable accuracy but also has natural parallel advantages in the field of parallel technology.

articleTitle: Planar circularly polarization filter antenna design for the 2.4GHz Bluetooth band
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a planar microstrip circular polarized monopole antenna with filtering function is proposed, and circular polarization is achieved by cutting a triangular structure and a semicircular structure on a square monopole patch and loading two open stub lines with right angle bending. The choice of tapered gradient line between feeder and patch is more conducive to adjusting impedance matching; The filtering function is achieved by integrating a fifth-order microstrip hairpin filter loaded with multiple serrated edges directly into the microstrip feeder of the CP antenna. The center frequency of the designed filter antenna is 2.45GHz, and the simulation results show that the 3dB axial ratio bandwidth is 200MHz, the gain is 2.8 dB, and the omnidirectionality is better. It has good frequency selectivity and out-of-band rejection, and has good application value in the field of Bluetooth communication.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Scattering from 3D Magnetized Ferrite Media based on Padé-FCC-FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the Padé-FCC-FDTD (Finite Difference and Time Domain based on Face-Centered-Cube grid) method of electromagnetic scattering from magnetic anisotropic dispersive media is studied, the Padé-FCC-FDTD recursive expressions of magnetic anisotropic dispersive media are derived, and the correctness of the algorithm is verified by calculating the radar cross section (RCS) of ferrite spheres. At the same time, the relative error of FDTD method and FCC method in calculating the radar cross section of ferrite sphere is also calculated. The results show that the relative error of FCC method is significantly smaller in C-band and Ku band.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Response Analysis of Broadband Dipole Antenna Electric Performance under Wind Load
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an electromechanical coupling analysis method is proposed to analyze the nonlinear response of the Broadband dipole antenna under wind load. The structural analysis of the broadband dipole antenna under wind load is carried out by the nonlinear finite element method, and the electrical performance analysis of the antenna is carried out by the method of moments based on the geometric model of the deformed broadband dipole antenna.

articleTitle: Design of WIFI6 band hairpin filter using spur line and cross coupling
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a seven-order bandpass filter with a center frequency of 5.537GHz and a bandwidth of 5.155.925GHz. The passband insertion loss is about 2.5dB, and the out-of-band 250Mhz suppression reaches 50dB by adding cross coupling between resonators to form transmission zeros. Secondly, by introducing spur line into the coupling section, the parasitic passband effect caused by the inherent structure of the hairpin filter is greatly suppressed. The results show that the harmonic suppression can reach 55dB within 8.5GHz and 30dB within 14.2GHz. The filter has small size and good passband performance, and can be applied to WIFI6 frequency band communication.

articleTitle: Radiation Effect Analysis on Human Head Caused by Different Frequencies of Mobile Phone Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This article discusses the bio-electromagnetic effects of the human head who exposure to the different operation frequency of three kinds of mobile phones. Three kinds of exposure sources with microwave and millimeter-wave bands respectively, which include the dual-band PIFA antenna operating at 900 MHz and 1860 MHz, the patch antenna operating at 3.5 GHz and the dual-band millimeter-wave antenna operating at 27 GHz and 40 GHz. We take a three-layer ball head model as the human head, and use the COMSOL Multiphysics software to simulate the specific absorption rate (SAR) and the absorbed power density (Sab) and temperature rise performance in the human head. The maximum SAR in human head is 1.41 W/kg and 4.4 W/kg, when it exposed to the microwave antenna and millimeter-wave antenna respectively. The results show that the millimeter-wave antennas have higher radiation energy than the microwave antennas for the human head model. The radiation dose absorbed in the human tissues are all below the limit restriction.

articleTitle: Derivation of Hydrodynamic Equations for One-Dimensional Single Particle in Plasma
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Plasma is composed of charged particles such as electrons and ions as well as neutral particles (atoms, molecules, particles, etc.). It is a mixed fluid with quasi-neutral and collective effect at macro level. The wave phenomenon in plasma is the most fundamental physical phenomenon in the research of plasma physics. It’s necessary to specify the physical quantities before we explore the wave phenomenon in plasma. In this paper, starting from the hydrodynamic equations, we derive the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) iteration of one-dimensional (1-D) Maxwell’s equations for single particle in plasma. By integrating the continuity equation and momentum equation of the electron, we acquire 1-D hydrodynamic equations. Those electromagnetic distributions can be obtained by combining the FDTD iterations. The nonlinear interaction between electromagnetic wave and plasma is further understood. It provides a theoretical basis for electromagnetic propagation in plasma.

articleTitle: Wideband Unequal Filtering Power Divider Without Additional Impedance-matching Circuits at Outputs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel class of wideband filtering power divider with full port impedance 50 $\Omega$ and unequal power dividing ratio is presented. Different from the conventional wideband filtering power divider, the load impedances of the proposed power divider are converting to 50 $\Omega$ directly without introducing additional impedance-matching circuits. The power divider is comprised of shared transmission line sections and two impedance transformer sections. By synthesizing the two filtering transformers with load impedance 50 $\Omega$, the impedance transformer sections behind the power dividing junction of the power divider can be decided. The shared transmission line sections in front of the power dividingjunction are determined by synthesizing equivalent Chebyshev impedance transformers with source impedance 50 $\Omega$ at f<inf>0</inf>. Excellent power division and filtering performance are achieved by cascading the two parts. For verification, a wideband 3:1 filtering power divider is displayed with FBW$=$100% and RL=15dB at f<inf>0</inf>=2.4 GHz. The simulated and theoretical results are presented, and good agreements between them are observed.

articleTitle: Design of a switch-controlled multi-mode Doherty power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the background of the operating frequency of 2.4GHz, based on the designed Doherty power amplifier, an improved Doherty power amplifier with multi-mode switch control and envelope tracking modulation is designed. The tube used in this design is a GaAs transistor NE6510179A from Renesas. The power added efficiency of the designed Doherty peak output (32.0dBm) reaches 27.2%, and the power added efficiency of the back-off 6dB is 27.0%. After being improved in cascade with the built envelope tracking model, the new structure can improve the power added efficiency of low output power to a certain extent, and the linearity in the middle and high output power part has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: SNR Modeling and Analysis of Interrupted Transmitting and Receiving in Radar Radiation Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In radar radiation simulation, the limited size of microwave anechoic chamber causes a signal coupling difficulty. By alternately transmitting and receiving complete radar long pulses, interrupted transmitting and receiving (ITR) can effectively tackle this problem. However, due to the signal’s interrupted control, the ITR method causes a decrease of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Therefore, aiming at the radar radiation simulation problem of Linear Frequency Modulation (LFM) signal system radar, the difference of SNR before and after the ITR is modeled and analyzed in this paper. Based on this, a suitable compensation method is further proposed. Simulation results show that the proposed method can compensate SNR loss after ITR, providing theoretical basis for radar power equivalent simulation in radar radiation simulation.

articleTitle: 3D-Printed Pyramid Broadband Absorber Using Carbon black / Polypropylene Composite
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: 3D-printing technology has great advantages in manufacturing complex structures. It provides an efficient method for the preparation and verification of electromagnetic wave absorber, which has attracted extensive attention. In this paper, a pyramid periodic structure microwave absorber was proposed and fabricated by 3D-printing technology using self-made carbon black / polypropylene composite. The structural parameters were optimized by full-wave electromagnetic simulation, and the reflectivity and absorption bandwidth were improved. Finally, the reflectivity of 3D-printed sample was measured by arch method. The proposed absorber can absorb the incident microwave over 90% in the band of 2.1-40 GHz with a thickness of 16mm.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electromagnetic Scattering from Three-dimensional Time-varying Magnetized Plasma by Newton-ADE-FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, Newton’s equations of motion, which describe electron motion when electromagnetic wave propagates in magnetized plasma, are combined with the traditional auxiliary differential equation method (ADEFDTD). An iterative formula of finite difference time domain (FDTD) algorithm for the three dimensional time-varying magnetized plasma is derived, which is called Newton-ADEFDTD method. The correctness of the algorithm is verified by calculating the radar cross section (RCS) of the time-varying magnetized plasma sphere. At the same time, the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of metal spheres coated with plasma are calculated by using this algorithm. The results show that the metal spheres coated with magnetized plasma have better stealth effect than those coated with uncoated plasma and coated with non-magnetized plasma.

articleTitle: The Design of Isolator Based on Capacitive Loaded Coupler
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents the design of an isolator based on capacitive loaded coupler. The capacitive loaded coupler is proposed for tight coupling. With the even/odd mode analysis, the design equations for the coupler are given. By employing the proposed capacitive loaded coupler and transistor based phase shifter, a magnetless isolator is realized with center frequency of 1.9 GHz, insertion loss of 0.1dB, and isolation of 25 dB. With the EM simulation, the size of the isolator is 24 mm*20 mm.

articleTitle: Mixing Matrix Estimation based on Density Clustering for Blind Source Separation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In blind source separation (BSS), how to estimate the mixing matrix is very important. In order to solve the problem of the BSS for spatial dynamic group targets, an improved mixing matrix estimation method based on density clustering is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the dominant eigenvectors are extracted from each local covariance matrices of the mixing signal. Then, the eigenvectors are clustered by dividing high-density region into different clusters and dealing with outliers effectively. Finally, the mean value of each cluster is obtained to achieve the estimated mixing matrix. Numerical simulation results show that the error of the proposed algorithm is within a limited range, so the proposed algorithm can be used as an effective way to obtain higher accuracy of the mixing matrix.

articleTitle: Design of PSOAM Vortex Antenna Based on Spoof Surface Plasmon Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a vortex antenna capable of generating Planar Spiral Orbital Angular Momentum (PSOAM) electromagnetic waves based on spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs). By bending the SSPPs Leaky-wave antenna (LWA), a plane vortex beam is radiated. The near-field phase diagram of the resonant frequency shows the corresponding PSOAM modes which range from -2 to 1.

articleTitle: Flight Mode Identification of Multi-rotor UAVs Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are widely used in both military and civil fields, which poses a serious threat to the military bases and civilian facilities. If the behavior mode of UAVs can be accurately identified, the intention of UAVs will be figured out, which can provide a basis for formulating accurate response measures as early as possible. In this paper, the behavior modes of multi-rotor UAVs are modeled, and the echo characteristics under different modes are analyzed. Then the machine learning dataset based on the time-frequency distribution matrix of the echo is constructed, and the convolutional neural network (CNN) is used to classify and distinguish the flight modes. Finally, the dynamic echoes of electromagnetic computation are simulated and verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Stable Hybrid Implicit-Explicit FDTD Subgridding Method for TE Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A stable FDTD subgridding method combining the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method and the leapfrog alternately-direction-implicit finite-difference time-domain (ADI-FDTD) method is proposed to accurately and efficiently solve two-dimensional transverse electric (TE) problems. The FDTD method is used in the coarse meshes and the leapfrog ADI-FDTD method in local subgrid meshes, respectively. Spatial interpolation between interfaces of coarse and subgrid meshes are carefully designed. To avoid interpolation in temporal domain and improve the efficiency, one uniform large time step is used in the whole computational domain. Results show that its stability can be guaranteed, and the accuracy and efficiency are improved.

articleTitle: Efficient Suppression of Edge Effects in Ultrawideband Tightly Coupled Phased Arrays
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel and effective method is proposed for the suppression of edge effects by the technique of amplitude and phase optimization in finite ultrawideband tightly coupled phased arrays (TCPAs). Based on the scattering parameters of antenna ports and active element patterns, a non-convex optimization problem is established for the synthesis of TCPAs, where array gains at considered scanning angles and frequencies satisfying given maximum active VSWR and amplitude dynamic range ratio (DRR) are maximized. The non-convex problem is transformed into an iterative convex optimization problem by the use of iterative ways. The simulated results show that the active VSWR are suppressed to 3 over a 10:1 bandwidth by the proposed method.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic scattering from metal targets in half-space environment with three-dimensional spatial interpolation method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A new acceleration method is proposed for efficiently solving the electromagnetic scattering from metal targets in half-space. In order to further speed up the calculation efficiency, an efficient three-dimensional spatial interpolation method is introduced for half-space Green’s function. Tabulation and IDW interpolations are performed on the Sommerfeld integrals for the half-space Green’s function. The efficiency can be improved 20 times higher than that of the traditional combined field integral equation(CFIE). Numerical results show that this method can significantly reduce the filling time of impedance matrix and maintain high accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on an Automatic Design Method of Wearable Antenna based on Python
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to further improve the design efficiency of wearable flexible antennas, an automatic design method of wearable flexible antennas based on Python development tools is proposed in this paper. Different from the traditional design method, this method realizes the automatic and fast mapping of the antenna working parameters to the antenna structure size through the Python software, which greatly shortens the design time. This paper will first introduce the development theoretical basis of the design method, show the implementation process based on the Python development tool and its simulation results, and then this paper will discuss its subsequent development and optimization direction in depth. Finally, through the study of the design method, this paper provides a novel and efficient design method for the industry and academia related to wearable antennas.

articleTitle: Metallic Rings Loaded Dielectric Rod Antenna with Enhanced Gain and Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a dielectric rod antenna with embedded metallic rings fed by circular waveguide operating from 10.9 to 14 GHz is proposed. Different from the traditional dielectric rod antenna, the proposed antenna uses embedded metallic rings to improve the antenna gain. According to the simulation verification, the antenna gain can be greatly improved by embedding several metallic rings with a decreasing radius in the dielectric rod. The simulated results indicate that the proposed antenna can achieve a gain enhancement of 1.4-5.5 dB in the operating frequency band of 10.9-12.5 GHz. Besides, the proposed antenna can attain a symmetric radiation pattern over the entire operating bandwidth.

articleTitle: Kirigami-Inspired Reconfigurable Phase Gradient Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Reconfigurable metasurfaces have attracted great attention in the field of electromagnetic (EM) wave manipulations. Here, we present a series of kirigami-inspired reconfigurable phase gradient metasurfaces to efficiently control anomalous refraction of scattering wave through changing the folding angle $\beta$. A reconfigurable grating, a special case of phase gradient metasurfaces, is demonstrated in both numerical simulations and experiments based on the generalized Snell’s law. When the folding angle $\beta$ is changed within the range of 20°~70°, the anomalous refraction angle varies within 39°~70° under the normal incidence of transverse electric (TE) wave and 39°~72° under that of transverse magnetic (TM) wave. Compared with other metasurfaces, our reconfigurable strategy that uses maneuverable devices or structures to control the EM wave is more versatile and shows great potential in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Simulated analysis of PIN diode electro-thermal characteristics under electromagnetic pulse signal
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The electro-thermal characteristics of PIN diode under electromagnetic pulse signal are studied by simulation. The effects of temperature and electric field on the mobility and thermal conductivity of materials are considered in order to realize electro-thermal coupling analysis of PIN diode. The distribution of carriers, temperature and electric field inside the diode is obtained. The simulation results show that the peak electric field and temperature are concentrated near the P<sup>+</sup> N<sup>−</sup> junction and N<sup>−</sup> N<sup>+</sup> junction under electromagnetic pulse signal. The temperature increases faster with the increase of injection signal amplitude and the rising time of signal has little effect on rate of temperature rise inside PIN diode. The burn out time of diode is also affected by frequency of injected Sine signal. The simulation results are of great significance to the protection of PIN diode.

articleTitle: Modelling the honeycomb composite for multilayer structural absorbing composite design
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The honeycomb structure absorbing material, which has both load-bearing and absorbing functions, has an irreplaceable position in the field of modern absorbing materials. In order to realize the effective permittivity calculation of honeycomb absorbers for further multi-structure design. Here, firstly, the Maxwell-Garnett (MG) formula is derived to summarize the conditions of use and the scope of application. Secondly, a new effective medium model is constructed based on the MG formula and characteristics of honeycomb structured wave absorbing composites. Finally, Based on the MG formula, the equivalent calculation of an example using the model shows that the obtained permittivity is basically consistent with the measured permittivity, which proves that the model can predict the effective permittivity of the honeycomb absorbing composite precisely. This is of great guidance and use for the future design of multilayer honeycomb structures.

articleTitle: Circularly Polarized Tightly Coupled Quarter-Circle Truncated Patch Array
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a circularly polarized (CP) tightly coupled quarter-circle truncated patch array. By reasonably cutting off two symmetrical quarter circles from the rectangular patches and arranging them in a tightly coupled array (TCA) configuration, the antenna array can achieve good circular-polarization performance. The simulation results indicate that the impedance and axial ratio (AR) bandwidth of the tightly coupled unit cell have reached 59.2% (2.58-4.75 GHz) and 24.6% (3.71-4.75 GHz), respectively, which are much wider than that of conventional truncated patches. In addition, a 4 $\times$ 4 TCA based on the proposed unit cell is implemented to validate the design concept.

articleTitle: Metasurface Loaded Dual-Mode Wideband Dipole Antenna using Characteristic Mode Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A metasurface-loaded dual-mode wideband dipole antenna is proposed. Revealed by characteristic mode analysis (CMA), the metasurface (MTS) provides an additional loop mode in addition to the dipole mode, both of broadside radiation, hence improved bandwidth. With an overall size of 0.37$\lambda_{0} \times 0.72 \lambda_{0}$ (where $\lambda_{0}$ is the free-space wavelength at 2.53 GHz), the proposed antenna achieves a measured bandwidth of 54.9% (2.53–4.45 GHz) for $\vert S_{11} \vert \lt - 10$ dB, within which the broadside gain varies from 6.47 to 8.27 dBi. The proposed method of designing wideband dipole antennas provides an alternate solution to wideband base-station antennas.

articleTitle: Electric Field Calculation of Capacitor Element in Arc Section by Extrapolation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The capacitor element is the basic component of a high-voltage power capacitor. Its electrical properties have a great impact on the functionality and the safe operation of the apparatus. Considering the fact that the arc section is the weak portion of the element, where breakdowns frequently occur, we propose a calculation routine for the electrical fields there based on the extrapolation technique and the COMSOL solver, whose effectiveness and efficiency are confirmed by comparative study.

articleTitle: Intelligent Metasurface with Machine Learning for Non-contact Hand Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: we propose a non-contact hand gesture recognition method based on a transmissive metasurface combined with a machine learning technique. Compared with traditional passive antennas, the intelligent metasurface is programmable and has excellent dynamic electromagnetic (EM) focusing capabilities. The slight changes in the forearm muscles caused by finger and wrist movements are dynamically captured using the intelligent metasurface. A variety of common human hand gestures can be classified with high-precision through the EM echo data from five individual focusing spots in the hand and the support vector machine classification algorithm. It can be used for wireless and non-contact hand gesture recognition for people with hand disabilities.

articleTitle: The advantages of surface susceptibility model over surface impedance model in characterizing metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Surface Susceptibility Model (SSM) and Surface Impedance Model (SIM)) are two kinds of homogenization models of metasurfaces. This study provides the mathematical relations of SSM and SIM, followed by scattering parameter calculation of metasurfaces’ unit cells by using the two models. A numerical experiment compares the performance of the two models and shows that SSM is more efficient than SIM in terms of evaluating oblique incident situations and saving analyzing time.

articleTitle: Oscillation Reduction for ADI Method in Transient Thermal Simulation of IC packages
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an effective exponentially expanding sub-time steps approach is presented to reduce the numerical oscillations of the alternating-direction-implicit (ADI) method for transient thermal simulation. By this method, the oscillations resulting from the large time steps can be efficiently alleviated. The validity of the proposed method is verified by numerical results.

articleTitle: An innovative derivation for reflection and transmission of electromagnetic field in planar-stratified TI medium
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A innovative derivation of local and generalized reflection\transmission is presented to describe electromagnetic (EM) field propagation in planar-stratified transverse isotropic (TI) medium. Different with the classical derivation process widely used in geophysical exploration, the concept of generalized transmission coefficient is introduced and emphasized to solve the EM field. The recurrent formulation of field in each layer is respect with the upgoing or downgoing waves rather than the amplitude. The boundary position is introduced to the formulation to overcome the overflow problem in numerical calculation. This work can be widely used in the applications of geophysical exploration

articleTitle: UHF Wideband Dual-Polarized Tightly Coupled Dipole Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A dual-linear polarized wideband tightly coupled dipole array (TCDA) is presented in this paper. This dual-linear polarized array consists of close spacing dipole with overlapping pads printed on the back side of the circuit boards to improve the performance in low operation frequency band. The folded Marchand balun together with multi-sections stepped transformer were employed to realize broadband impedance matching. Specifically, the frequency selective surface (FSS) was designed to enable wide angular scanning. This work achieves 5.2:1 impedance bandwidth with broadside VSWR <3 across 0.33 GHz to 1.73 GHz while scanning to 70 ° and 45 ° in the E-plane and H-plane respectively.

articleTitle: In-Orbit Ka Band Multibeam Antenna Pattern Tests of High Throughput Satellite
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The antenna pattern of a satellite must be measured in the early stages after a launch to confirm whether if the antenna performance is degraded by the launch vibration. This paper presents the in-orbit test methodology and test results for Ka band multibeam antenna pattern of the first China high throughput satellite (Chinasat-16). The in-orbit test results agree well with those in ground measurement, which means that Ka-band multibeam antenna has withstood launch environments and also performances are not degraded in space environments.

articleTitle: An Improved Rasorber based on Frequency Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An improved rasorber based on frequency selective surface (FSS)has been proposed in this paper. The present structure comprises the top absorbing layer, the bottom transmitting layer and the air separation layer between the absorbing layer and transmitting layer. The lumped resistors applied in the adjoining semicircular metallic patch on the top absorbing layer to increase the bandwidth. The simulation results show that the improved rasorber can be afforded the absorption frequency band9.67–14.36GHz and the transmission band 20.06–24.41 GHz and it is polarization insensitivity because of the symmetrical structure. The proposed rasorber structure has the low insertion loss, the polarization insensitivity and lower profile.

articleTitle: Single-and Dual-band Bandpass Filters Design Based on Spoof Surface Plasmon Polariton
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel spoof surface plasmon polariton (SSPP) unit structure is presented in this paper. The proposed unit structure consists of two parallel coupled open stubs, which has good dispersion characteristics. Compared with the conventional rectangular SSPP structure, it may be used to reduce the size of a component. A novel single-band and a dual-band wideband bandpass filter (BPF) with good insertion loss, high rejection level, strong electric field binding ability, and simple structure are designed.

articleTitle: The Effects of Base Shape on Cone Scattering Feature
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Recent days, radar cross section reduction(RCSR) of objects have attracted much interest as more and more wideband radar were used to detect low observable weapon platforms. Among the low observation technologies, shaping plays an important role. This paper focused on the effect of basement shape on the scattering of a cone-like object, and some basement shape better for low radar cross section design for around tip incident angle were analyzed.

articleTitle: A Millimeter Wave 3-way Power Divider based on Buried Resistance Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A 3-way power divider in Ka-band is designed in this paper, it adopts the buried resistance technology to reduce the parasitic effects caused by discrete resistors, and adopts the metallized via-holes to reduce energy leakage and loss during transmission. By optimizing the parameters such as the line-width of the power arms and the size of the buried resistors, good performances are ensured. The final measured results show that the bandwidth of the power divider is 23.5%, the transmission loss is less than 2dB, the isolation is better than - 16dB; the amplitude consistency is within ± 0.55dB and the phase consistency is within ±6.6°.

articleTitle: A Radiation Pattern-Reconfigurable Patch Antenna with Tunable CSRR based on Liquid Metal and 3-D Printed Microfluidics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this article, a radiation patternreconfigurable patch antenna with tunable complementary split-ring resonators (CSRR) based on liquid metal (LM) and 3-D printed microfluidics is presented. The antenna is composed of three layers, a top coaxial fed rectangular patch, a middle ground plane with two CSRRs etched symmetrically, and two bottom microfluidics channels each adhered underneath the corresponding CSRR. Pattern reconfiguration is achieved by filling the microfluidic channels with the liquid metal plugs to change the physical parameters of the CSRR structure. By adjusting the length of the slot stubs in CSRRs, the main beam of the double CSRR-loaded antenna can be continuously scanned from -46° to 46° in elevation plane.

articleTitle: Physics-Informed Neural Networks For the Solution of Electromagnetic Scattering by Integral Equations
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The physics-informed neural network approach is applied to the integral equation to solve 2D electromagnetic scattering problems. Numerical results indicate that the integral equation can be accurately solved by a simple FCN with the PINN.

articleTitle: Simulation of Ionospheric Higher Order Effects in Navigation Signals Based on Ray Tracing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The ionosphere is an important error source for GNSS. In this paper, in order to study the effect of ionospheric higher-order effects on the extraction of ionospheric tilted total electron content, the dual-frequency and tri-frequency differential extraction STEC methods are simulated based on the simulated data of navigation signals. Firstly, the propagation process of the navigation signal in the ionosphere is simulated by ray tracing method, and then the simulations of dual-frequency and tri-frequency differential extraction of STEC are carried out under the Nequick ionospheric model, respectively. The simulation results show that the ray-tracing method can simulate the propagation process of navigation signals in the ionosphere more realistically. Compared with the dual-frequency differential STEC extraction method, the triple-frequency differential STEC extraction method can eliminate the ionospheric second-order effect more effectively and improve the STEC extraction accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Broadband Electromagnetic Scattering based on RFG-FFT with Cube Polynomial Inter/Extrapolation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: To analyze the broadband scattering problem, an efficient RFG-FFT with cube polynomial inter/extrapolation method is presented. Due to its great performance for accelerating the matrix vector product, RFG-FFT is applied to solve electrically large problems. To overcome bottleneck of repeatedly constructing the impedance matrix at each frequency, the combined cube polynomial inter/extrapolation method is incorporated into the filling process of the impedance matrix. The high efficiency and accuracy of the proposed method are verified by a comparison with the numerical method.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation Algorithm of Street View Image Via Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Real-time semantic segmentation of street view images can be used as a visual aid system during autonomous driving. This paper proposes a multi-branch cross-layer fusion network (MCFNet). The model uses a multi-branch network to extract features, fuses the features of different stages of multiple branches for prediction, and uses a lightweight depthwise separable convolution to reduce the amount of computation. We use the Cityscapes dataset to train and evaluate the algorithm and get 61.6% mIoU and 115.3 fps.

articleTitle: Fast three-dimension imaging simulation based on scattering center model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents an approach for fast three-dimension (3D) imaging simulation by using scattering center (SC) model. It is found that distributed scattering centers (DSC) and sliding scattering centers (SSC) are important characteristics of 3D images, and the accuracy of these SCs determines the accuracy of 3D imaging simulation. In this work, the models of DSC and SSC are built according to the real geometry of the target to assure the accuracy of 3D image simulation. In order to verify the feasibility of this approach, the 3D imaging result of a tank simulated by the SC models is compared with that obtained by high-frequency method, and results show good agreement in 3D image signatures and this method is of higher simulation efficiency than the high frequency method in terms of computation time and memory consumption.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Random Chessboard Structure for Broadband Radar Cross Section Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel random chessboard structure with broadband backward RCS reduction and bistatic stealth characteristics is proposed in this paper. The simulated results show that the proposed random chessboard can be optimized, has ultra-wide frequency band with backscatter RCS reduction higher than 10 dB spanning from 10.8 GHz to 19.8 GHz (Relative bandwidth is 58.8%) and good bistatic stealth characteristic.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Shielding Effectiveness of Chassis Based on DGTD Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An electromagnetic simulation method is proposed for shielding effectiveness (SE) of chassis in this paper. The discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (DGTD) equation is established based on Maxwell’s equation. The uniaxial perfectly matched layer (UPML) is used as an absorbing boundary condition to simulate an open space. At last, the method is applied to analyze the effect of the aspect ratios of rectangular apertures on shielding effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Flexible Microwave Sensor Based on Spoof Surface Plasmon Polaritons and Spoof Localized Surface Plasmons
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A flexible microwave sensor based on spoof surface plasmon polaritons and spoof localized surface plasmons was presented in this paper. The microwave sensor can be attached to the human body to detect the tumor of skin. The sensitivity of the sensor is high due to the surface wave characteristics of spoof localized surface plasmons. The microwave sensor works from 2.5GHz to 3.5GHz. The sensor was processed and the experiment results are consistent with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Study on the Cylindrical Bending Effects of a Ku-Band Antenna Array Feeding Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A feeding structure enables the power delivery from source to individual elements in an antenna array. For an array feeding structure conformal to a curved surface, the transmission characteristics of each feeding port changes compared to its planar state. In this paper, we analyze the performance variation of a feeding network for a Ku-band 4 by 4 antenna array when cylindrical bending is applied. A Ku-band feeding structure is designed with uniform and in-phase transmission characteristics. The bending effects, in particular, the excitation non-uniformity among the ports has been studied by simulating the transmission parameters of the feeding structure that are bent towards two orthogonal directions by different angles.

articleTitle: Adaptive Track Fusion Method Based on Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the complex battlefield environment, the radar is subject to multiple types of interference, and the measurement accuracy fluctuates and changes abruptly. Because of the instability of radar measurement ability in the actual environment, an adaptive track fusion method based on uncertainty is proposed, which uses the measurement wave gate to judge the current measurement ability of each radar. When the radar accuracy decreases due to interference, the uncertainty is proposed to measure the real-time error level of the track, and the uncertainty is used as the weight to participate in the fusion, to effectively resist the interference in the complex environment. Simulation results show that the algorithm has good scene adaptability and can always maintain high track fusion accuracy in different interference environments.

articleTitle: A design of GUI tool software for phased array antenna beamforming
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: this paper, a tool software for beamforming of phased array antenna is designed. The tool has a clear GUI, visualizes the antenna radiation pattern, supports direct adjustment of the radiation pattern for beamforming, provides an effective solution for the shortcomings of optimization algorithm for beamforming, and can be used as a new beamforming solution.

articleTitle: Application of Clustering Technology and Gerchberg-Papoulis Algorithm for Spherical Near Field Antenna Measurements
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents an optimized interpolation and extrapolation scheme for spherical near-field antenna testing. The method starts with a small amount of initial sampling data, and uses the optimization method combining partition cluster classification and Gerchberg-Papoulis algorithm to interpolate and extrapolate randomly sampled data. This optimization scheme effectively reduces the number of samples, and achieves near-far-field conversion results with the same accuracy as triple oversampling. The results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A Switchable Linear-to-linear Polarization Converter with Broadband Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A reflective metasurface enabling linear-to-linear polarization conversion or co-polarization reflection is proposed based on the p-i-n diodes. The active design achieved the conversion function in the frequencies range from 3.27 to 7.78 GHz with 82% relative bandwidth when p-i-ns are on and co-polarization reflection over -1 dB from 1.53 to 6.78 GHz when p-i-ns are OFF.

articleTitle: Dual-Polarization High-Gain Array Antenna without Power Division Network for 5G Base Station
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A dual-polarization high-gain array antenna without power division network is proposed. A crossed dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) is applied as a driven element. A coupled rectangular metal patch is placed above the DRA radiating as a three-unit antenna array. In order to improve the isolation between the two dual polarized ports, tree shorted pins are designed across the dielectric resonator. Otherwise, the slots with different sizes is etched on the metal patch to suppress the cross polarization. A ±45° dual-polarization antenna array with high gain upper than 11dBi and beamwidth of 23° at vertical plane (V-plane) and 65° at horizontal plane (H-plane) in the frequency of 3.4Ghz - 3.6Ghz have been achieved. The proposed design have promising applications for 5G base station with simpler architecture and lower feeding loss.

articleTitle: Analysis of Plasmonic Optical Trapping via Electromagnetic Numerical Computational Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Surface plasmon (SP) enables the optical trapping of nanoparticles since it can break through the diffraction limits. The design of plasmonic optical tweezers usually requires many experiments to determine the structures and materials as well as the frequency of incident light wave. Numerical simulation becomes an important auxiliary method. In this paper, an efficient electromagnetic numerical computational method based on vector finite element method (FEM) and Maxwell stress tensor (MST) is proposed, to analyze the optical trapping excited by Gaussian beam. Numerical results show the effectiveness of the proposed method for the analysis of plasmonic optical force and trapping.

articleTitle: A circularly polarized hybrid liquid antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A circularly polarized hybrid liquid antenna is presented in this paper. The antenna mainly consists of a semi cylindrical container and two liquids contained in the container. The liquids are saline water and pure water. The impedance bandwidth of the antenna is 2.72GHz-3.68 GHz and the gain is 4.5dBi-5.3dBi. The antenna is fed by an L-shaped probe that deviates from the center. In all impedance bandwidth, it is a circular polarization antenna.

articleTitle: A Fast Design Method for Ultra Broadband Absorbers Using RC Equivalent Circuit Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An accuracy and efficient approach is proposed to fast design ultra-wideband microwave absorbers. The RC equivalent circuit model of absorbers is established according to impedance matching and transmission line theory. The model is suitable for low and high-frequency absorbers composed of multilayer square high impendence surface (HIS) and air layers of impendence matching. Absorbers with different parameters can be fast designed by utilizing the proposed model and genetic algorithm. The reflection coefficient of RC circuit and full-simulation are in good agreement, both of them are lower than -10 dB within 2-18 GHz or 4-50 GHz (fractional bandwidth of 160% or 170.37%), with the total thickness close to the Rozanov limit. An absorber is fabricated and measured to further verify the accuracy of the model. The measured results have a good agreement with the RC circuit model, which indicates the proposed method is an efficient way for fast designing ultra-broadband thin absorbers using double-layer (or multilayer) square HIS.

articleTitle: MT Inversion Based On U_Net Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: magnetotelluric method (MT) is an important electromagnetic geophysical method. This paper proposed a deep learning inversion framework for MT data. The U-Net network structure is used to learning the model of mapping from geophysical data to subsurface rock-mineral properties. The training data set is generated by MT forward computation with the finite element method. The numerical examples show that our approach gives accurate prediction results about the location and shape of underground abnormal bodies.

articleTitle: Spaceborne SAR Image Simulation and Analysis of Dynamic Oceanic Eddies
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Oceanic eddy is a highly common marine phenomenon. Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) plays an important role in the observation of oceanic eddies with its unique advantages of all-day and all-weather. The simulation of oceanic eddy SAR image is of great significance for its identification and interpretation, as well as for the design and evaluation of marine SAR systems. In this paper, a spaceborne SAR image simulation method for dynamic oceanic eddies is proposed, which is realized by simulating the raw SAR echo signal. We conducted experiments on eddy data selected from the numerical forecast ocean products provided by the Copernicus Marine Environment Monitoring Service (CMEMS). We verify the effectiveness of the simulated SAR images through the distribution characteristics of the actual SAR images. In addition, we explore the differences in the characteristics of oceanic eddies reflected on SAR images under different input parameters.

articleTitle: RCS Simulation of Small Multi-Rotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper studies radar cross section (RCS) of small-target at low altitude and slow velocity. Choosing civil small multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), research on its monostatic RCS simulation was carried out based on theory and commercial software. In the research, 10GHz, 30GHz and 60GHz electromagnetic waves were used to incident on 4-axis and 8-axis multi-rotor UAVs with different polarizations, and the model of blended wing body (BWB) and the model of all physical components as target were built. By choosing a simulation scheme based on combination of theoretical analysis and bottom algorithm of commercial software, the simulation results of monostatic co-polarization RCS were obtained.

articleTitle: Plasma Checkerboard Electromagnetic Surfaces for Wideband Radar Cross Section Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel plasma checkerboard electromagnetic surface is proposed for wideband radar cross section (RCS) reduction. The different units of the plasma checkerboard produce a proper reflection phase gradient and can reduce the backscattered wave. We designed a plasma checkerboard that can reduce RCS by more than 80%, from 5.4GHz to 12.6GHz.

articleTitle: A wide beam dipole antenna in the E- and H-plane with a novel structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A wide beam dipole antenna in the E- and H-plane with a novel structure is presented in this letter. The proposed antenna consists of a U-shape dipole and two conducting walls. By adjusting the size of them, a wide beam dipole antenna in the E- and H-plane is realized. The measured impendence bandwidth for $\mathrm{S}11 \lt -10$dB at the working bandwidth is 37.4% (5.0-7.3GHz). The wide beam bandwidth is 19.7% (5.5-6.7 GHz). The half-power beam-width (HPBW) is more than 150° in the E-plane and 135° in the H-plane. With its wide beam advantages, the proposed antenna can be widely applied for modern wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Study on Broadband and Wide-angle Scanning of Circular Array
