publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a circular array with broadband and wide-angle scanning characteristics is designed. The energy is coupled to multiple patches through microstrip strips to realize the multi frequency resonance of antenna elements, so as to broaden the bandwidth. The working frequency band of the antenna is 27.70 GHz-35.12 GHz, and the relative bandwidth reaches 23.62%. The circular array can realize omni-directional scanning of $0^{\circ}- 360^{\circ}$ in azimuth at different frequency points, and the gain is stable at about 13 dBi. Three elements of the array are taken for physical processing, and the test results are in good agreement with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Scattering Manipulation and Imaging Based on Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Based on the Generalized Laws of Reflection and Refraction, a specific metasurface array is designed. By using the designed metasurface and comparing it with a metal sheet of the same size, the deflection effect of electromagnetic reflection beam and the attenuation of monostatic RCS are verified through simulation. In addition, one-dimension cross range image of the metasurface is given in the paper, and the attenuation of backscattered field intensity near the center was observed.

articleTitle: A dual-polarized and reconfigurable metasurface for manipulation of electromagnetic waves
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A dual-polarized and reconfigurable metasurface incorporated voltage-controlled varactor diode for manipulation of electromagnetic waves is proposed. Two varactor diodes are embedded along x- and y-directions, respectively, thus the dispersion response has distinct behavior for different polarizations. Exploiting the anisotropic characteristic, the x- and y-polarized waves can be independently diffused in three dimensions, and the required phase profiles are optimized by the genetic algorithm. Additionally, the functionalities like beam splitting and beam deflection are also presented. All functions can be switched in real time by adjusting the voltage applied on the metasurface from 8.3 GHz to 8.9 GHz. The proposed metasurface has great potential in intelligent stealth missions and wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: A Compact Millimeter-Wave Multibeam Folded Transmitarray Antenna Based on Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a compact multibeam circularly polarized folded transmitarray antenna (FTA) with low profile, high aperture efficiency, high polarization purity, and wide scanning range is presented. The proposed FTA consists of a polarization-selective metasurface (MS) and a bottom metallic surface integrated with an array of identical planar feed antennas. The MS is designed with co-polarized focusing transmission for left-handed circular polarization (LCP) incidence and co-polarized specular reflection for right-handed circular polarization (RCP) incidence. The designed FTA has a height of only 1.07$\lambda$, with an H/D of 0.14. The finally configurated multibeam FTA can realize a beam scanning range of ±31° by switching the feed sources. The boresight beam shows a peak gain of 22.8 dBi at 26 GHz with the peak aperture efficiency of 31.7%, a3 dB gain bandwidth of 19.6%, and a3 dB axial-ratio bandwidth of 30.6%.

articleTitle: Design of Compact Dual-band Filter Based on Quarter Wavelength SIRs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a dual-band bandpass filter based on $\lambda$/4 stepped impedance resonator (SIR), and the principle is introduced in detail. Each passband frequency and bandwidth of the filter can be designed flexibly. In order to verify the effectiveness of this design, a dual-band bandpass filter with center frequencies of 0.85 and 1.65 GHz is designed. The simulation results show that The insertion loss at the center frequency of 0.85 GHz is 0.43 dB and the return loss is 34.2 dB,-3dB fractional bandwidth (FBW) of 16.4 %. The insertion loss at the center frequency of 1.65 GHz is 0.6 dB and the return loss is about 30. SdB, -3dB FBW of 9.1 %. Due to the use of tap feeding and hybrid coupling, the coupling phase changes, and two transmission zeros (TZs) are generated on both sides of the second passband, which greatly increases the out-of-band suppression performance of the filter.

articleTitle: Compact MIMO Monopolar Patch Antenna for 4G and Full Band of 5G Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) antenna system for fourth generation (4G) and full band of fifth generation (5G) wireless applications is presented in this paper. The MIMO system consists four identical monopolar patch antennas (MPAs), each MPA acts as a single 4G/5G antenna element and adopted a folded structure for size reduction. Defective ground structure and a kind of folded plane inverted F-shaped (PIF) grounding branch are designed to reduce the surface wave coupling and the near field coupling, port isolation better than -14 dB is achieved within the whole operating bandwidth. The measured results show that the antenna exhibits a quasi-omnidirectional radiation characteristic and the impedance bandwidth (VSWR<3) covering the band 1.57-9GHz. Moreover, the envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) of each-two antenna elements is less than 0.018, which means that the proposed antenna system has good diversity performance.

articleTitle: Increasing Electric Field Uniformity in Insulator Under Pulse Excitation by Varying Its Conductivity
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, how the electrical conductivity affects electric field distribution uniformity in a cylindrical insulator under double exponential pulse excitation is investigated. The underlying basis is the vectorial-scalar potential equations and the mathematical model is developed in COMSOL and solved with its internal solver. It is found that by regulating the inhomogeneous conductivity of the insulator, the purpose of controlling the conduction current of the material and thus improving the electric field distribution uniformity in the interior and along the surface can be achieved.

articleTitle: Double Split-rings Cross Polarization Converter with Ultrawideband and High-Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel metasurfaces double split-rings structure is proposed for converting linear polarization to cross-polarization of electromagnetic waves in a wide frequency band. The simulation results show that the proposed super surface is able to convert linearly polarized waves into cross-polarized waves from 9.23 to 25.17 GHz with a polarization conversion ratio (PCR) of 90%. The proposed metasurface has a larger bandwidth compared to the traditional polarization converter, and it can be used in many significant applications.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Off-focus Multi-feed Compact Range for 5G Over-the-Air Test
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a multi-feed compact range system for 5G Over-the-Air (OTA) test. There are 4 different feed antennas arranged around the focus of the compact antenna test range (CATR) which cover 6 to 90 GHz frequency band. The efficiency of out-of-band spurious emission test is improved 3 times as a minimum. In addition, the two optimized off-focus 24-50GHz in-band feed antennas are introduced enable the whole system supports 3-channel in-band measurement simultaneously. The antenna under test (AUT) is measured both using the focus and off-focus feed antennas, it is observed that the inconsistency of the main lobes is less than 0.1dB.

articleTitle: A Design of Reflective Metasurface for Microwave Power Transmission with Focusing Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A phase-compensated metasurface is proposed in this paper. The phase compensation range is more than 360° in the 5-8 GHZ frequency range by using the new double-ring metamaterial. By changing the arm length of metamaterial cell structure, the phase compensation value changes linearly with the arm length, realizing the regulation of any phase. A reflective antenna array consisting of 20 $\times $ 20 elements is designed based on this metasurface. Simulation results show that 75.64% of the power is received by the receiving surface 1m away from the reflection array, and the maximum power density of the receiving plane is 27.87W/m<sup>2</sup>. The far-field gain of reflection array antenna is 22.23dB and HPBW is 20°, which can effectively suppress sidelobe and improve power transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of an Ultra-Wideband Vivaldi Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An improved Vivaldi antenna is proposed in this paper. The ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna is realized by adopting a mixed gradient line method of exponent and triangle. The antenna is fed by a microstrip tapered line. A small UWB balun is integrated with the antenna through a rectangular coplanar strip line impedance converter, then an ultra-wide operating band from 1.6 GHz to 30 GHz is obtained. The simulation results show that in the operating band, the VSWR of the antenna is less than 2, and the maximum gain of the antenna is 10 dBi. Moreover, its radiation performance is stable across the whole operating band.

articleTitle: Experimental verification of polarization reconfigurable optomechanical metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an optomechanical metasurface composed of $30 \times 30$ ELC metal resonant ring units is proposed for polarization reconfigurable function which works at 2527GHz with excellent circular polarization purity. The experimental results verify the nonlinear effect of the coupling between the electric field potential energy and the mechanical potential energy within the optomechanical metasurface. By using this nonlinear effect, optomechanical metasurface changes in the electromagnetic properties, and the high polarization conversion effect are achieved accordingly.

articleTitle: Fast Solution of Wideband RCS Using UCBFM and Compressive Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the ultra-wide band characteristic basis function method (UCBFM) for the wideband electromagnetic scattering problems of electrically large objects, the impedance matrix calculation efficiency at single frequency point is low. A novel method combining UCBFM and compressive sensing (CS) is proposed in this paper to solve this problem. This method randomly extracts several rows of the original impedance matrix for filling as the measurement matrix, and the corresponding excitation vector as measured value. Therefore, the calculation speed of the impedance matrix can be improved. Then the wideband RCS can be constructed quickly and accurately with fewer measurements by the recovery algorithm. Numerical simulation results show that compared with UCBFM, the computational efficiency of target wideband RCS can be further improved.

articleTitle: Polarization Conversion Metasurface with Ultra-high Transmission for Arbitrary Polarization Angle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The effective reception of electromagnetic wave is the premise of wireless communication, but the receiving efficiency for linear polarized(LP) wave is often deteriorated due to the oblique polarization angle. We developed a polarization conversion metasurface(PCM), which can convert the polarization of LP wave from arbitrary angle into specific angle, meanwhile, the transmittance is higher than -3dB within 4.12-4.89 GHz. The magnitude fluctuations of transmission which are caused by the polarization angle rotating among ±180° are less than 3 dB. The proposed PCM can not only significantly improve the reception for oblique LP waves, but also generate circular polarized waves. It has the application prospect in radar and satellite communication.

articleTitle: On the Use of Skeletonization Technique to Accelerate the Solution of the Radome-Antenna System in Receiving Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The skeletonization technique based on the interpolation decomposition (ID) technique is extended to the evaluation of receiving patterns of antenna and antenna-radome system (ARS) which are with multiple right-hand side (RHS) vectors during the moment method solution. The ID exploits the rank-deficiency property to Figure out the skeleton vectors and accelerate the solution of the RHS matrix. Numerical experiments are conducted on the antenna array enclosed in a radome to validate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Substrate Influence for the WPT Efficiency of Metasurface-Inspired Domino-Coil System and Its CM-Based Physical Explanation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A metasurface-inspired domino-coil wireless power transfer (WPT) system is studied. The relaying component of the WPT system is constituted by two 4-element coplanar metallic coil arrays printed on the two sides of a dielectric substrate. An interesting experimental phenomenon, that the WPT efficiency can be influenced by the dielectric permittivity of the substrate, is reported. A scattering characteristic mode (CM)-based physical explanation is provided to the experimental phenomenon. Based on the CM-based physical explanation, some further optimization methods and engineering applications will be proposed in the future studies.

articleTitle: A Beam-Steering Antenna Using Characteristic Mode Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A beam-steering antenna based on characteristic mode analysis (CMA) is presented in this paper. The radiation of the square patch is stimulated by the coupling feed. The antenna presented in this paper consists of three layers. I-shaped parasitic patches are placed in four horizontal orthogonal radiation directions to optimize the radiation of the antenna in X and Y directions. The size of the radiation patch is about 0.7λ<inf>0</inf> × 0.7λ<inf>0</inf>, where λ<inf>0</inf> is the spatial wavelength at 5.5 GHz. The antenna proposed in this paper can switch radiation direction between X-axis and Y-axis by feeding different ports. The simulation results show that the impedance bandwidth of the antenna is 14.3% (5.2-6 GHz), and the total efficiency and the peak gain of the antenna in the operating bandwidth can reach 90% and 8.2 dBi, respectively. Due to the good directional radiation characteristic of the antenna, the antenna has potential applications in wireless communication systems and radar systems.

articleTitle: Highly Squinted Spotlight SAR Imaging Based On Four DSPs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Highly squinted spotlight SAR has played an important role in military and civilian fields, with its fine two-dimensional resolution and the possibility of day and night operation in all weather. This paper proposes the architecture of four DSPs for real-time imaging, which includes the modified polar format algorithm imaging, phase gradient autofocus, geometric distortion correction, and image quantization. In the final experiment verification part, an image of 2048*2048 pixels can be processed within 0.62s, proving its validity and efficient handling.

articleTitle: The Diagnosis of Linear Array Antenna with Unknown Mutual Coupling
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an iterative optimization algorithms proposed for the diagnosis of uniform linear array with unknown mutual coupling. The excitation coefficients of the array follow Taylor distribution, and the mutual coupling matrix is modeled by a symmetric Toeplitz structure. Based on the relationship between the mutual coupling matrix and the excitation coefficient, an iterative algorithm was proposed to solve the two unknowns by continuously optimizing them alternately. Finally, the failure elements can be diagnosed by the obtained excitation coefficient. Simulations show that the algorithm proposed in this paper has good reliability.

articleTitle: Study on 2D Plasma Photonic Crystals with Defect Modes Using FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a typical uniform unmagnetized two-dimensional plasma photonic crystal with a single linear defect mode is simulated based on the finite difference time domain method, and the effects of defect mode position and size on its photonic band gaps characteristics are explored respectively. the research can provide an idea for tuning the electromagnetic properties of two-dimensional plasma photonic crystals.

articleTitle: Design of 10-dB Symmetric Broadband Multi-Sectional Directional Coupler
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A 10-dB symmetric broadband multi-sectional directional coupler applied to the 0. 7-3.7 GHz band is introduced to address the high bandwidth requirement of directional couplers for microwave systems. The coupler is designed with a double-layer parallel stripline structure and extends the bandwidth of the coupler by using a three-section coupling line. Higher directionality is also achieved by adding branches at the coupling line connections. The simulation is optimized by HFSS simulation software. The simulation results show that the isolation (S<inf>41</inf>) of the coupler is greater than 35 dB, the return loss (S<inf>11</inf>) is greater than 27 dB, and the in-band fluctuation of coupling (S<inf>31</inf>) is less than ± 1dB in the range of 0.7 -3.7 GHz, which meets the design requirements of 10-db coupler.

articleTitle: Design of Frequency Selective Rasorber with Absorption and Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A frequency selective rasorber (FSR) with absorption and transmission is proposed in this paper. The novel structure is consisted of the top absorbing layer, the intermediate air layer and the bottom transmitting layer. The resistors load between the semicircular metal patch on the top absorbing layer to enlarge the resonant bandwidth band. The simulated results demonstrate that the presented FSR can be realized the absorption frequency range 8.32-12.12GHz and the transmission band 17.41-23.01 GHz with the polarization insensitivity property. The performances suggest that the proposed structure is good candidate for stealth equipment and radome designs.

articleTitle: Study of Conductor Surface Roughness Effects on Signal Propagation for High-Speed PCB Traces
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Conductor surface roughness cannot be negligible for high-speed digital products, such as in DDR5, which results in the signal line per-unit-length parameters (RCGL) modified again. Therefore, extra loss and signal attenuation is brought into that affects transmission performance including return loss, insertion loss and far-end crosstalk (FEXT) of signal line. This paper investigates the impact of conductor surface roughness on signal propagation for high-speed PCB traces. The associated simulation results are provided to demonstrate that increasing the conductor surface roughness deteriorates the propagation performance of signal line in PCB traces.

articleTitle: A Wearable RF Energy Harvester Based on Spoof Surface Plasmonic Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a wearable RF energy harvester based on spoof surface plasmonic (SSP) antenna array. Four separate antennas are connected by the four bending SSP waveguides, and the SSP antenna array is formed. The loop is applied to excite the SSP structure to generate surface waves and converted to the radiative wave into the space. The rectify circuit is integrated with loop to output DC power and fabricated by the polyimide so that it can conform with different sensing modules. The proposed harvester is fabricated by the conductive and nylon fabrics in a compact and low-profile structure to be easily integrated with clothing. The maximum harvested RF-DC power is 126.24 $\mu W$ under a power density of $2.75 \mu W/cm^{2}$ when the proposed structure is worn on phantom. The simulation and measurement results demonstrate that the wearable RF energy harvester has the potential to power body sensor network.

articleTitle: Design of a Pulse Transformer for X-band Klystron
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Future linear accelerator requires klystrons with higher RF frequency to driving higher gradient accelerating structure. This study presents a high-voltage pulse transformer used for a 50MWx-band pulsed klystron at Shanghai Advanced Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences (SARI, CAS). Typical specifications of the pulse transformer are peak pulse voltage 420kV, peak pulse current 300A, 50 Hz repetition rate and 1.5us flat-top pulse width. Design and optimization of pulse transformer are achieved by using equivalent circuit methods. The relevant experiments show that this pulse transformer can meet the requirements of 50MWx-band klystron.

articleTitle: An Efficient Measurement Method for Scattering Pattern of Individual Meta-Atom in the Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a fast and accurate technique for measuring the scattering pattern of the meta-atoms on metasurfaces by using orthogonal coding matrixes. In general, the scattering patterns of the meta-atoms are always assumed to be consistent in all directions. However, for some particular scenarios, such as beamforming, that assumption will introduce extra errors. Hence, acquiring exact scattering patterns of the meta-atoms is essential. The traditional methods for measuring the scattering pattern only extract and probe one single meta-atom, neglecting the mutual coupling among the meta-atoms Distinguishing from that, the technique presented here can acquire the scattering pattern of the meta-atoms while the whole metasurface is working. Specifically, in this method, we sequentially apply a set of orthogonal codes to the meta-atoms, measure the far-field of the whole metasurface, and eventually acquire the scattering pattern of the meta-atom through a matrix operation. To demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed technique, we carry out some simulations. The results indicate that the pro-posed method may be useful for future applications of metasurface in radars and wireless communications.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Wave Manipulations via Liquid-metal-based Coding Metamaterial System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: For decades, metamaterials have been widely investigated for their excellent feature of fashioning the spatial electromagnetic (EM) waves. Moreover, to control the EM waves in a digitally discretized manner, the concepts of the digital coding metamaterial and programmable metamaterial were proposed in 2014. However, most time, the reconfigurable function of the coding metamaterials is realized by electricity through active elements, such as PIN diodes. Here, we introduce another driving manner, liquid-metal-based mechanical driving, to the coding metamaterial system. In general, liquid-metal-based coding metamaterials have two main distinguishing features: 1) they can implement reconfigurable states continuously owing to the fluidity; 2) they can get rid of the mechanical fatigue and damage due to the flexibility of liquid metal and its containers. In the paper, we begin by designing a liquid-metal-based meta-atom with the characteristics of broadband reconfiguration, multi-bit coding and wide-angle incidence. Then, the designed meta-atoms are spatially arranged to realize the applications of broadband beam-steering and broadband RCS reduction.

articleTitle: Amplitude Adjustable Balanced Bandpass Filter Based On Graphene Nanoplates
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel class of amplitude adjustable balanced bandpass filter (BPF) is proposed through the comprehensive design of graphene nanoplates and microstrip balanced BPF. The graphene nanoplates are loaded on the open ends of $\lambda$/4 stepped-impedance resonators (SIRs) to reduce resonance intensity. The hybrid electromagnetic coupling is utilized to produce a transmission zero on each side of the passband to improve the selectivity of the differential-mode (DM) circuit. By changing the bias voltage on the graphene nanoplates, a controllable attenuation from 1.6 dB to 10.5 dB can be achieved over the operating bandwidth centering at 2.7 GHz for the DM circuit without breaking common-mode (CM) rejection.

articleTitle: All-optical modulation of polarization-entangled quantum states based on nonlinear metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Dynamic manipulation of quantum states is essential for realizing compact quantum information systems. Metasurfaces have shown excellent advances in quantum state generations, manipulations, and detections at the nanoscale. However, quantum metasurfaces are mostly static currently.

articleTitle: An Phase Compensation Method Based On Time Delay for Secondary Channels of Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The adaptive active power filter based on LMS algorithm has limited compensation ability for the phase difference caused by the secondary channel, which makes its suppression function of harmonic current invalid, and may enhance the harmonics in serious cases. Based on time delay, this paper proposed a phase compensation method of secondary channel, which can effectively compensate the phase difference caused by secondary channel and realize the interference of any frequency point in the target frequency band.

articleTitle: A New Numerical Flux for the DGTD-GSTC Method in Simulation of Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Over the past decade, metasurfaces have demonstrated their unique properties and potential in electromagnetics ranging from microwave to optical frequencies. Having the advantages in complex geometry modeling and broadband/nonlinear analysis response analysis, the discontinuous Galerkin time-domain method incorporating generalized sheet transition conditions (DGTD-GSTC) is particularly suited for simulating practical metasurfaces. Different from the ‘virtual edge’ approach in the previous work, this paper proposes a new rigorous numerical flux for DGTD-GSTC method, which makes the algorithm more concise and easy to implement.

articleTitle: Wide-Passband Reconfigurable Frequency Selective Rasorber design based on Fluidity of EGaIn
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a wide-passband reconfigurable frequency selective rasorber(FSR) design based on fluidity of liquid metal is proposed. The proposed FSR is implemented via combining two lossy layers with a reconfigurable frequency selective surface(FSS). Firstly, a third-order broadband FSS with reconfigurable properties is presented, whose bandpass state can be switched to perfect reflection state by controlling the injection and the extraction of liquid metal in microchannels. Secondly, the upper lossy layer is a symmetrical split-ring resonator(SSRR) structure composed of a screen-printed resistive film, and the lower lossy layer is a square loop, each side of which is inserted with a circular spiral resonator(CSR) in the center, thereby introducing a wide transmission window in the broad absorption band. Then, by cascading the lossy layers and the lossless layer through an air layer with a thickness of about a quarter wavelength, the design can realize the reconstruction of absorption-transmission-absorption(ATA) mode and absorption-reflection-absorption(ARA) mode. It is shown by full-wave simulation that the structure has a wide-passband filtering performance with a fractional 3dB bandwidth reach up to 41.6%, the minimum insertion loss in the passband is 0.98dB at 12.4GHz, and the relative bandwidth of 110.6% with reflectivity less than −10dB in ATA mode. In ARA mode, it has a good absorption band from 4.8GHz to 10.4GHz and15.1GHz to 19.6GHz and the 3dB transmission bandwidth is 12.8%. The proposal has significance to be used to design switchable stealth radome for wide-band antennas.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Substrate Integrated Waveguide Cavity-Backed Antenna Based on LTCC in D-Band
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a D-band dual-band substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) cavity-backed antenna based on low temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) fed by standard Flange of WR-6.5 rectangular waveguide (RWG) has been proposed. The dual-band cavity-backed antenna operates at its two high-order radiation modes through the four radiating slots etched on the top of its surface coupled by an hourglass-shaped inductive window. In addition, the design of SIW-RWG vertical transition is in order to transmit the power from the waveguide to the SIW cavity-backed antenna efficiently. The 10-dB impedance bandwidths of the proposed antenna are over 3% at both radiation frequencies of 146.6 and 167.2 GHz, while the maximum realized gains are 8.73 and 9.29 dBi, respectively. According to the LTCC process, the structure of the antenna is able to be stable and well performed.

articleTitle: Analysis of electromagnetic fields in air radiated by towed antenna in seawater
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The performance of the towed antenna is important for undersea to air communication. In order to determine the optimal antenna parameters such as working frequency and type of antenna, an electromagnetic fields theoretical model of a horizontal electric monopole in seawater is presented at first. Then, influence of fluctuating sea surface and antenna attitude on electromagnetic field above sea surface radiated by the towed antenna are considered, and the radiated electromagnetic fields of the towed antenna with open/short ends at different frequency are compared. At last, an undersea electromagnetic wave transmitting and receiving experiment is carried out to verify the results of theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: W-Band Circularly-Polarized Antenna Based on Glass Substrate
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A circularly-polarized antenna based on glass substrate, consisting of a microstrip feed line, a I-shaped coupling gap and an ellipse cavity, is presented in this paper. The electromagnetic wave can achieve circularly-polarized radiation by the perturbation of ellipse cavity. According to the simulated results, the designed antenna can achieve a 3% AR bandwidth and a 10% impendence bandwidth. To validate the feasibility of processing technology, a prototype of the proposed (a) antenna is manufactured and measured. The experimental results are reasonably consistent with the simulated results.

articleTitle: Interior Penalty DGTD Method for Anisotropic Magnetized Plasma
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An interior penalty discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (DGTD) method is proposed in this paper to simulate electromagnetic waves in magnetized plasma. The anisotropic and dispersive properties of magnetized plasma are expressed by the current density equation. The fourth-order explicit Runge-Kutta strategy is employed for time integration. The accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method are demonstrated by analyzing the RCS of a magnetized plasma-coated PEC sphere.

articleTitle: Topological rainbow trapping based on non-Hermitian twisted piecing photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Topological rainbow trapping, which can separate and trap different frequencies of topological states into different positions, plays a key role in topological photonic devices. However, few schemes have been proposed to realize topological rainbow trapping effects in lossy photonic crystal systems, which has restricted its practical applications, since loss is ubiquitous in nanophotonic devices.

articleTitle: High-precision vibration detection based on nano-cavity optomechanical accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The principle of optical-mechanical coupling system in cavity optomechanical system is analyzed, and the design of a micro-accelerometer with uniaxial straight beam differential structure is presented in this paper for the vibration detection in the wide frequency band. The micro-accelerometer consists of a movable detection mass, four straight beams connected to the top layer of the SOI wafer, two fixed masses and two air slot loading line defect nano photonic crystal cavity. The chip is designed and fabricated, and the experimental test platforms in atmosphere and vacuum are built respectively. The stability, optical resonance, mechanical resonance, optical-mechanical coupling rate, sensitivity, resolution and noise characteristics of the micro-accelerometer are tested and analyzed. Finally, when the input laser intensity is 9 dBm, the vibration detection sensitivity of the micro accelerometer with single axis straight beam differential structure reaches 73.99 mV/g, the AC resolution is 2.1 mg/Hz<sup>1/2</sup>, and the theoretical detection resolution limit is 399.2 μg/Hz<sup>1/2</sup>. The results show that the designed cavity optomechanical system micro-accelerometer has excellent performance and can be applied to the application areas with high requirements for acceleration detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband stealth antenna system based on multilayer wave-absorbing structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the paper, an ultrawideband low-profile miniaturized stealth antenna system built on a multilayer absorbing structure is proposed. Firstly, an ultra-wideband tight dipole (TCA) is selected as the antenna unit in this paper, based on which the steganographic effect is simulated for the free-space infinite array using the master-slave boundary conditions and Floquet port excitation of ANSYS HFSS software After that, a frequency-selective absorption super surface was loaded in the system to achieve an antenna operating band of 2-18 GHz with RCS reduction of 10 dB at 8.5-18 GHz and 5 dB at 18-26 GHz, with an average antenna efficiency of 56.7% (including antenna standing wave loss).

articleTitle: A SISL Coupler using Two Layers of Coupled Line Structure with Dense Interconnecting Vias
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, A substrate integrated suspended Line(SISL) coupler using two layers of coupled line structure with dense interconnecting vias has been proposed. SISL technology can realize low loss, light weight, and self-packaging. Two layers of coupled line structure with dense interconnecting vias can achieve coupling enhancement for the coupler. This coupler has been designed, fabricated, and measured at 3.05GHz.

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Measurement and Analysis of Thin Septum for Diffraction Limited Storage Ring
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Fast kickers such as strip-lines along with lambertson magnet or thin septum magnet could support onaxis injection for Diffraction Limited Storage Ring (DLSR), in which traditional off-axis injection becomes inadequate. This paper focuses on the theoretical simulation and field measurement of thin septum magnet. The scheme of eddy-current type thin septum magnet (the thinnest portion is with the thickness of 0.9mm) was adopted with laminated silicon steel sheets as magnet core. The simulation of main field and leakage field along the beam trajectory, the stray field decayed over 1millisecond time had been carried out within Opera 2D/3D. Field measurement and analysis of thin septum magnet also has been conducted comprehensively. The results meet requirement that the integral leakage field is less than 0.1% with respect to the main one. The work laid a foundation for injection technology of advanced light source.

articleTitle: Dual-Beam Metasurface with Abitrary Power Allocations Based on Anisotropic Modulation of Complex Reflection Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We propose a metasurface to achieve anisotropic modulations of both amplitude and phase for two linearly co-polarized reflections. A unit cell based on variation of cross-shaped structure is designed. By loading lumped resistors and assigning different geometric parameters for x- and y-arms, the complex reflection coefficients of x- and y-polarizations can be controlled independently. For verification, the metasurface is constructed using the proposed unit cells. When illuminated under a 45 °-linearly-polarized incident wave, it can produce dual-beam radiations of different power allocations. Simulated radiation angles and power ratios of the two beams show good agreements with the pre-designed values.

articleTitle: Broadband RCS Reduction Using Single Layer Random Coding Polarization Conversion Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel broadband metasurface has been proposed to realize radar cross-section (RCS) reduction based on single-layer random 1-bit coding polarization conversion metasurface (PCM). The unit cell consists of double C-shaped resonates and a ring resonator, which can produce three resonance points to improve the bandwidth of RCS reduction. The structure has a wideband linear polarization conversion efficiency with at least a 90% polarization conversion ratio (PCR). Using two supercells to constitute a $6 \times 6$ random coding metasurface, wideband 10 dB RCS reduction is realized from 8 - 23.65 GHz.

articleTitle: The Influence of Transmitting Antennas on the E-Field Distribution in Boundary deformation Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The boundary deformation reverberation chamber is a new reverberation chamber technology. By changing the boundary position of the chamber, a statistically uniform, isotropic and randomly polarized electromagnetic environment can be obtained. This paper proposes a method to realize the boundary deformation of the reverberation chamber. The influence of the number and configuration of transmitting antennas on the uniformity of the electric field in space was explored. The results show that the uniformity of electric field in reverberation chamber does not show a strict positive correlation with the number of antennas. In order to improve the statistical uniformity of space electric field, the position and number of transmitting antennas need to be optimized.

articleTitle: Design of a Multi Band Slot Coupled Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, electronic communication system has been widely used in the field of ships. The operation of these equipment is mostly accompanied by the conversion of current and energy, and the antenna is the bridge of transmitting and receiving signals. When the high-frequency electromagnetic signals fill the space around the ship and form a complex electromagnetic environment, electromagnetic compatibility technology is very important. From the perspective of electromagnetic compatibility technology, a multi band antenna with cross aperture coupling feed is designed in the antenna field. Through a feeding port, microstrip side feeding and slot coupling feeding are realized. It has the characteristics of four working frequency bands, high gain and low profile, and is more suitable for multi terminal communication environment. The antenna has four resonance points, which are 3.2GHz, 4.7 GHz, 5.9 GHz and 6.9 GHz respectively. The return loss at these frequencies is less than - 15dBi. At 3.2 GHz and 5.9 GHz, the antenna has strong directivity and opposite directivity. It can be applied to multi terminal directional antenna system to avoid antenna opposite radiation loss. At 4.7 GHz and 6.9 GHz, it shows omnidirectivity.

articleTitle: Measurement Uncertainty Analysis of Measurement Grid Reduction for 5G IoT OTA Testing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: For Over-the-air (OTA) testing of 5G Internet of Things (IoT) devices, test time reduction is of great significance. Among all potential methods, measurement grid reduction is a more direct one. This paper evaluates the effect of different measurement grid configuration on OTA performance of IoT devices. The determination of associated measurement uncertainty (MU) term is proposed and analyzed based on statistical distribution simulation. Finally, it can be observed that reduction of measurement grid resolution from current 30/30 (Δθ/ɸΔ) to 45/36 (Δθ/ɸΔ) could achieve a roughly 50% grid point reduction while requiring an uncertainty relaxation of less than 0.2 dB, which is considered to be acceptable for OTA testing of IoT devices.

articleTitle: Linear PolarizationConverter Basedon V-bar-Shaped Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a V-bar-shaped metasurface that can convert linear polarizations of electromagnetic waves to cross polarization. Based on the electromagnetic resonant of the cell, resonances are generated leading to cross-polarized reflections. The simulation results by CST studio show that the proposed metasurface is able to convert linearly polarized waves into cross polarized waves from 13.5 to 28.5 GHz, with an average polarization conversionration (PCR) of 90%.

articleTitle: A Compact Model for Electro-Thermal Co-Simulation of One Diode-One Resistor Random Access Resistive Memory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A Verilog-A compact model for electro-thermal co-simulation of one diode-one resistor (1D1R) resistive random access memory (RRAM) is developed. The compact model contains two parts. One part is the electrical circuit model for the RRAM and the diode with temperature-dependent parameters; the other part is the equivalent thermal circuit model with thermal resistance and thermal capacitance calculated from the geometry and material parameters of 1D1R cell. The electro-thermal compact model can capture both the IV characteristics and temperature distribution of the memory cell. The simulation results reveal that the rising temperature of conductive filament in RRAM is much higher than that of the diode during the reset process of the memory cell. The validity of our compact model is verified by comparing it with other’s experiment data.

articleTitle: Coplanar waveguide multiband antenna based on open resonant ring
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A compact coplanar waveguide multiband antenna based on an open resonant ring is proposed in this paper. The proposed antenna is fabricated on FR-4 substrate with a dielectric constant of 4.4 and a small size of 23 × 23 × 1.6mm<sup>3</sup>. In the design process of the antenna, the deformed circular split ring metamaterial (RSRR) is introduced to realize the broadband and multi frequency characteristics of the antenna. The two frequency bands of the antenna are 2.91-3.63GHz (relative bandwidth 22%), 4.19-9.32GHz (relative bandwidth 75.9%), covering WiMax (3.4/5.5GHz), lower C-band (4.41GHz), upper C-band (6.9GHz), WLAN (5.4/5.8GHz), lower X-band (8.7GHz) wireless standards, S11 ≤ -10dB. High frequency structure simulator (HFSS) is used to simulate the antenna structure, which has uniform radiation characteristics.

articleTitle: Analysis of infrared radiation properties of SiC particles with different microstructures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to control the infrared radiation properties by adjusting the micro morphology of SiC particles, we analyze the radiation characteristics of solid and hollow SiC particles with different scales. The results show that the particle size has a great influence on the radiation characteristics of SiC spherical solid particles, and the particle thickness directly affects the amplitude changes of extinction and scattering absorption peaks of SiC spherical hollow particles with small scale (d=100nm).

articleTitle: SAR image shadow effect simulation by target facet model and parameterized scattering model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a fast method to simulate the shadow effect in SAR images by using target facet model and parameterized scattering model of rough surface. The shadow region of each incident angle is calculated through the projection of the target facet model on the background plane. The large-scale facet model of target is used in projection calculation to reduce computation burden. To verify the accuracy of the proposed method, the SAR result of a cube located above a rough surface is compared with the result of PO method, the similarity is 70%. And to prove the feasibility of the proposed method, SAR image of the low-flying target above the sea surface are obtained.

articleTitle: Accurate Integration Strategy of the Magnetic Field Integral Equation in Layered Medium
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the layered medium background, a computation strategy of the quasi-singular terms of the Magnetic Field Integral Equation (MFIE) is proposed, where the normal vector is set in the inner integral. Meanwhile, by this strategy, better accuracy is obtained in the Method of Moments (MoM), when the weak form is discretized by not only the divergence-conforming (RWG) but also the curl-conforming (nxRWG) low-order basis functions. As to the discretization of the RWG basis functions, the symmetric propagation factors in layered medium Green’s function (LMGF) ensures that transferring the normal vector into the inner integral is feasible. However, discretized by nxRWG basis functions, the inner product is naturally with the normal vector in the inner integral. A numerical result is presented to show the better behavior gained by this strategy in accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Adaptive Electromagnetic Power Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Aiming at the application mode of electromagnetic wave in phased array radar, combined with different target detection scenes, this paper proposes a design scheme of electromagnetic wave control that adaptively changes with radar detection scenes. In this scheme, the radar antenna units are controlled by software instruction, and real-time feedback can be given according to the detection results, so as to realize the purpose of efficient utilization of electromagnetic wave power.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-Band 5G Millimeter-wave Fan-shaped Antenna Based on Characteristic Mode Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A dual-band 5G millimeter-wave microstrip antenna is proposed based on characteristic mode analysis (CMA), which consists of a $2 \times 2$ fan-shaped patch array open circular slot. The CMA is used to discuss the characteristic of the antenna, and two resonant modes are optimized at the frequency of 28.0 GHz and 38.0 GHz. According to the characteristic current distribution, the selected mode is excited by using the substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) slot to achieve multi-mode resonance, thus obtaining dual-band characteristics. Simulated results show that the impedance bandwidths are 27.5-29.4 GHz and 36.2-40.2 GHz, with realized gains of 6.9 dBi and 5.6 dBi, respectively. The proposed dual-band antenna is suitable for application in 5G millimeter-wave (MMW) communications system.

articleTitle: High-precision rotation angle detection based on optomechanical microscale HRGs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Gyroscope is a kind of very important inertial sensor, which is widely used in automobile, aerospace, inertial navigation, strategic guidance and other fields. The traditional micro-gyroscope generally has some disadvantages such as high noise and low performance, but the cavity optomechanical system technology provides a new scheme for the realization of micro-gyroscope with high sensitivity, high precision and high resolution. In this work, we present a new method for the high-precision rotation angle detection based on optomechanical microscale hemispherical resonator gyroscopes (HRGs). FEM simulations have been performed to analyze the features of hemispheric shell resonator.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband and Wide-Scanning Dual-Linear Polarized Phased Array with High Polarization Isolation and Low Cross-Polarization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: High performance ultra-wideband phase array antennas are critical to the success of future multifunction communication. This paper presents a novel dual-linear polarized phased array with low profile and 7:1 bandwidth. The overall geometry consists of orthogonal oriented tightly coupled dipoles with overlapping patch in order to reinforce the mutual couple between the adjacent elements. Notably, feeding Marchand balun is optimized not only for better impedance transformation, but also providing feedline with excellent electrical shielding. Double layers of dielectric are placed above the dipoles to achieve wide-scanning in each principle plane across the working band. Finally, the proposed antenna array, with total height less than $\lambda_{1\mathrm{o}\mathrm{w}}/10$ can realizes VSWR< 2.5 across operating band (2.5-18GHz) at broadside. Simulation for infinite array indicates the design can achieve Tx/Rx isolation around 50dB at broadside, isolation better than 30 dB can be achieved when scan to $45^{\mathrm{o}}\mathrm{i}\mathrm{n}$ E-/H-planes. Due to the low profile, the dual polarized array is demonstrated to have good polarization isolation of -50dB for most of the band at broadside, below -30dB when scan to scan to 45° in E-/H-planes. With outstanding features above, the proposed antenna array can find its application in wideband simultaneous transmit and receive (STAR) monostatic systems and those wireless electronic systems with multiple functions.

articleTitle: Robot-Type Miniaturized Planar Ultra-Wideband Triple-Notch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the article, the introduction of the robot-type three-notch antenna will be discussed. The antenna is printed on a dielectric substrate made of FR-4. The electromagnetic simulation software HFSS is used for modeling and analysis. and other methods to expand the bandwidth, the use of slotting and the introduction of branches. The bandwidth of the antenna is 3.5GHz-21GHz, and the maximum gain of the antenna is 5.78dB. The three notches are 5GHz-WLAN, 7/8GHz X-band uplink and downlink, and 12-14GHz of satellite communication Ku-band. The antenna has achieved the trend of miniaturization in the current era, and the size of the antenna is only $24.4\ast23.38\ast1.6mm^{3}$.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Method for Antenna Radiation with Parameters Variation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a scheme combining frequency- and material-independent response (FMIR), mode order reduction (MOR), and tangential equivalence principle algorithm (T-EPA) is proposed to analyze the radiation problem of antenna array near a large PEC plate with parameters variation. The wave input-output relationship of the scatterers can be encapsulated into a reduced-order model (ROM). The ROM can be pre-calculated and re-used when the location of the radiator is changed. By expanding the Taylor series of the Green’s function exponent, the calculation of impedance matrix with frequency sweep can be accelerated by FMIR. Finally, the T-EPA is used to reduce the number of unknowns and improve the convergence of the integral equation.

articleTitle: Design of A Square Metasurface Antenna Based on Characteristic Mode Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Based on characteristic mode analysis, a simple square metasurface antenna is proposed in this paper. The antenna structure is symmetrical, consisting of four square patches in the center and eight modified triangular patches distributed around after two modifications. The antenna is fed by coupling, the slot is etched on the floor where it is to be excited, and a low-frequency radiation mode is introduced at the same time. The modified antenna enhances the radiation of the required mode and weakens the current intensity of other modes. The antenna has compact structure and low profile height. The overall size of the antenna overall size of 42mm $\times 42$ mm $\times 3$ mm. The simulation results show that the antenna can achieve -10 dB bandwidth at 4.95-5.94 GHz, with a relative bandwidth of 18.1%. The antenna has uniform radiation, and the gain is greater than 7 dB in the working range.

articleTitle: Wideband Frequency-selective Rasorber based on 2.5-D Circuit Analog Absorber
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we present a frequency-selective rasorber (FSR) which achieves a wide low-scattering fequency band with a transmission window in the middle band for arbitrary polarization incident polarizations. The structure is composed of a multilayer bandpass FSS with diffuse scattering and two absorbing metasurfaces. The samples are fabricated employing the printed circuit board (PCB) technique. Two foam layers are filled into the three PCB layers as supporting structure, whose thickness are properly chosen to realize good impedance matching in the whole operation band. This design has introduced multiple design methods of expanding bandwidth and reducing radar cross section (RCS), such as 2.5-dimension circuit analog absorber design, the higher-order passband FSSs design, and phase cancellation design. The proposed FSR shows a desired wide-band transmission window from 8.5 to 13.3 GHz, and wide low-backscattering frequency band defined by -10 dB ranges from 1 to 17.6 GHz.

articleTitle: Research on Data Augmentation for Garbage Classification with Target Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Garbage classification is an essential work in daily life. With the development of artificial intelligence (AI), we have begun to use object detection to achieve garbage classification. However, the stacking and occlusion of garbage often make the detection performance unsatisfactory. In this paper, YOLOv5 algorithm is used for garbage detection and classification. YOLOv5 has three detection heads, which can detect objects at multiple scales. At the same time, Mosaic and Coarse Dropout image augmentation techniques are used to process our private data set of garbage, which improves the diversity of images. In this way, the target classification accuracy of the detection model can reach 75.7%, which is significantly improved compared with 69.9% without data augmentation. This paper provides a new technical support for the scene classification of stacked garbage based on deep learning.

articleTitle: Design of Reflectarray Antenna Based on Amplitude-Phase Metasurface and Convex Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper synthesizes and designs reflectarray antennas based on numerical optimization and amplitude-phase metasurface. Techniques including convex approximation, low rank solution, eigenvalue decomposition and C-shaped metasurface are adopted to realize the reflectarray antennas that induce cosecant and flat top beams. Effectiveness of the designs are verified by numerical and full-wave simulations, and the work has practical significance for the design of array antenna.

articleTitle: Tapered Fed Compact MIMO Antenna for 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A tapered fed Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) antenna for 5G wireless communication applications with a compact size of $24 mm \times 30 mm$ is proposed in this paper. The operation band of the antenna covers from 3.2 GHz to 6.9 GHz. The introduction of tapered microstrip line significantly enhances the impedance matching of the antenna in the range of 5.0$\sim$6.9 GHz. A T-shaped isolator is introduced at the ground to guarantee isolation better than 15 dB. In this paper, S-parameters, radiation pattern and diversity performances such as ECC and DG are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Multipath Exploitation Based on Subspace Detector
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Multipath propagation leads to signal distortion and challenges our traditional signal processing algorithms. In order to cope with signal distortion, a few robust detection performance algorithms were developed. The subspace detector was originally used to improve the robustness of multipath signal detection. However, with the development of environmental information acquisition technology such as lidar, the subspace corresponding to the multipath signal can be accurately predicted. We can jointly detect the multipath signal, and the subspace detector obtains better multipath utilization performance. In this paper, data simulation has verified that the SD(subspace detector)has good multipath utilization performance, and the performance attenuation is small in the case of weak multipath signals or signal model mismatching (inaccurate prior information).

articleTitle: Electromagnetic-Thermal Characterization of Microstrip Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The lossy dielectric materials in antenna arrays will generate thermal effects that significantly degrade the electromagnetic performance and reliability of antenna arrays. Therefore, the coupled analysis of the electromagnetic-thermal effect of the antenna array is necessary. In this paper, a numerical analysis approach based on finite element method is proposed for the electromagnetic-thermal effect of microstrip antenna arrays, showing the electric field and temperature distributions. Numerical results of an array verify the accuracy of the method.

articleTitle: A Broadband Dielectric Resonator Antenna Array with High Gain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A broadband dielectric resonator antenna array is proposed in this communication. The antenna is composed of two antenna units and a feed network. The two antenna units are arranged at 0.5$\lambda$, where $\lambda$ is the free-space wavelength at the centre frequency. It is excited by a microstrip feed printed on the opposite side of the substrate having a dielectric constant of 2.25 and thickness of 0.7mm. A parametric study is performed for providing practical design guidelines. The simulation results indicate that an impedance bandwidth for VSWR $\le$ 2.0 from 7.8GHz to 14.1GHz is covered. Stable radiation pattern with high gain is maintained among the working frequencies. In addition, a flexural structure is devised to reduce the size of the antenna. Compared with the traditional broadband antenna, the antenna has a wide band and high gain. The results indicate that the electric characteristics of the antenna meet the application requirements in working frequency

articleTitle: Scattering by a buried anisotropic cylinder
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Based on the image method and the addition theorem of Bessel functions, an analytical solution of the multiple-scattering by a buried anisotropic cylinder is obtained in this paper. Some numerical results are given in the end.

articleTitle: A flexible and efficient approach for computing electromagnetic scattering by honeycomb radar absorbing structures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A flexible and efficient numerical modeling approach is presented for simulating electromagnetic scattering from honeycomb radar absorbing structures (RAS). In the proposed approach, the original honeycomb structure is divided into the homogenization-based and the resistive sheet boundary condition approximation-based two subregions. The former is homogenized as a diagonal anisotropic medium in local coordinate system by using the Hashin-Shtrikman variational theory and a Euler rotation matrix for describing its orientation in the global coordinate system, while the latter is approximated by reducing each unit cell wall as a zero-thickness resistive sheet by using the resistive sheet boundary condition (RSBC). The hybrid model is then simulated by using the hybrid finite element-boundary integral-multilevel fast multipole algorithm (FE-BI-MLFMA). Numerical results show that the proposed approach exhibits high accuracy and flexibility of the RSBC based numerical modeling approach, and efficiency of homogenization-based approach.

articleTitle: An Optimal Design of a Flat-top Beam Pattern of the OAM Wave Emitting Through a Concentric Sequentially Rotating Circular-Polarization Array
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Currently, radio OAM waves have broad applications because they have natural orthogonality. In the present paper, we proposed an optimal design of a concentric circular array with multiple rings for generating OAM beams with flat top characteristics. Firstly, we introduced a compact OAM antenna using a sequentially rotated configuration and a cost function of the flat-top pattern. Then, an optimization process is designed and conducted, including three independent simulations of sub-arrays, and rooting of excitation coefficients and rotation angles for individual rings. Simulation results show that the optimized antenna can generate an OAM beam with a ripple coefficient of less than 0.6dB on the torus from -55 to 55 degrees, which meets the requirements of flat-top beams.

articleTitle: Fast Analysis of dynamic scattering for Group Targets based on CM-FMA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a fast analysis method based on characteristic mode accelerated by fast multipole algorithm (CM-FMA) is proposed for dynamic scattering analysis of group targets. CMs are taken and reused as a global basis functions to reduce the unknowns. The reduced coupling matrix is expanded by the FMA and tabulated in advance, so that it can be filled quickly by table lookup or interpolation during dynamic calculation. It greatly enhances the efficiency and realizes a quasi-real-time evaluation for dynamic scattering of group targets.

articleTitle: A beam deflector with polarization independence double-sector units
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The metasurface has drawn the attention for the potential applications in manipulating light and transmitting information. In this work, a symmetric metasurface is designed with a double-sector structure. The metasurface element is arrayed at the angle of 45 ° between the axis of symmetry and the horizontal direction. The metasurface is insensitive to the polarization of the incident light in vertical or horizontal direction, and the propagation phase can be tuned from 0 to $2\pi$ by controlling the central angle. The simulations show that the transmission efficiency is higher than 0.15 for the incident light with cross polarization and 656 nm wavelength. A beam deflector is constructed by eight double-sector elements with propagation phases, and shows an excellent polarization independent characteristics with incident of the X-, Y-, Left- and Right-polarized light, respectively. Furtherly, a metalens with a focal length of 10 m and a numerical aperture of 0.45 is designed based on the beam deflector and Fermat principle. This work expands the application of metasurface and provides the simulation basis for the application.

articleTitle: Periodic Structures and Its Interaction to EM Wave Spectrum, Ideas From X-Ray to MW Wave
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: X-ray is an important tool for characterizing materials, which is based on the idea that all crystals are composed of atoms or molecules stacking in a particular type, basically expressing as unit cell, diffracting the incident ray with a proper type. In analogue, the periodic structures which are mostly constructed artificially show special desired properties, such as the properties of grating, frequency selective surfaces, metamaterials and metasurface. In this paper, A study was done on the insight of the relation of wave interaction with periodic structures based on X-ray diffraction and control of electromagnetic waves.

articleTitle: A Novel Wideband FSS Radome with Loaded Inductors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a low profile frequency selective surface (FSS) by loading lumped inductors is proposed to exhibit wideband property. Firstly, according to the equivalent circuit parameters of multi-layer FSS with non-resonant elements, the necessity of loading the lumped inductors under the condition of limited size is analyzed. Then, the complete design procedure that combining lumped inductors and multilayer FSS is given. It is found from the results of full-wave simulation and equivalent circuit simulation that the designed FSS has a transmission pole and multiple transmission zeros, thus showing wide bandwidth FSS characteristics.

articleTitle: Accurate Sub-Structure Characteristic Mode Analysis for Yagi-Uda Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The theory of characteristic modes (TCM) provides a method to compute the inherent modal behaviors of various electromagnetic objects, thus the characteristic mode analysis (CMA) is becoming a popular tool to analyze the working mechanism of radiation and scattering problems. We present a CMA for Yagi-Uda antennas in this paper. Numerical results show that the sub-structure CMs can provide more accurate modal results than full-structure CMs for the considered Yagi-Uda antennas.

articleTitle: Analysis of Magnetoelectric Antenna Radiation Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a new mechanism of magnetoelectric antenna based on electric-acoustic-magnetic energy conversion is studied. Firstly, a NPR rectangular structure magneto-electric antenna with the size of $50\times 11\mu \mathrm{m}^{2}$ and the thickness of $2\mu \mathrm{m}$ is established. Secondly, it verifies that the radiation model of magneto-electric antenna is similar to magnetic dipole. The antenna resonates at 11. 26MHz and the gain is -16.2dB. This chip antenna is a good candidate for communication system.

articleTitle: A Novel Radar Waveform Based on Frequency-Phase Joint Coding
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Due to the limited modulation manner and the simple construction, the conventional radar signal is usually easy to be intercepted, sorted, identified and forwarded by digital radio frequency memory (DRFM) jammer. This paper proposes a novel radar waveform based on frequency-phase joint coding to increase the ability of low probability of intercept. Firstly, the frequency-phase coded waveform model is constructed and its ambiguity function is analyzed. Secondly, an optimization problem with respect to the continuous phase coded sequence is proposed, to suppress the autocorrelation sidelobe and cross-correlation peak. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate that the optimized frequency-phase code is compatible with autocorrelation and cross-correlation, ensuring the compatible ability of target detection performance and interference countermeasure performance.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of a Dual Pass-band FSS Based on Curve Fitting and PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a dual pass-band frequency selective surface (FSS) is proposed, and its performance is predicted and optimized using curve fitting and optimization algorithms. The research work in this paper is divided into three main stages: first, the FSS model is simulated using CST software to obtain the data required for curve fitting. Then, the curve fitting technique is used to establish the analytical equations for the design parameters. Finally, a particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to solve the target parameters according to the fitting function. The results show that by this method, we can quickly and accurately optimize the FSS structural parameters and obtain the frequency response that meets the design objectives.

articleTitle: Predicting Ground Penetrating Radar A-Scan Signal Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The forward calculation of Ground penetrating radar (GPR) is very important for the analysis and interpretation of its echo signal. The gprMax software is widely used for forward electromagnetic simulation. However, it is still time-consuming to obtain a large amount of simulation echo data. In this paper, the ResNet-18 convolutional neural networks (CNN) is used to fast generate the A-scan echo of given detection scene. The dielectric constant of spatial grids is normalized to obtain the coding matrix as the input data of the network, and the output is the A-Scan signal. When the scene changes, only one forward propagation of the network is needed to obtain the new A-Scan signal. Several groups of experiments for different detection scenes demonstrate that this method can efficiently and accurately generate the echo signal, with the root mean square error are less than 0.0005.

articleTitle: A S-Band Orbital Angular Momentum Antenna with Frequency Reconfigurable
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a S-Band frequency reconfigurable Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) antenna array is proposed. The radiation element utilizes p-i-n diode to control the short-circuit probe and realize the current interference to the radiation patch. Thus, the switching of the antenna frequency from 2.61GHz to 3.55GHz is feasible. In order to realize the bandwidth expansion of two different frequencies, a double resonant square ring is added. The OAM mode l = +1 and mode l = +2 are realized by feeding the excitation with the adjacent incremental phase of 45° or 90°. The relative bandwidth of the antenna reaches 9%. The gain reaches 11dBi at 2.61GHz and 14dBi at 3.55GHz, which can be effectively used for vortex wave communication.

articleTitle: A Multi-Layer Cross-Shaped Unit Cells Antenna Based on CMA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Metasurface is a hot topic in today’s era and an important direction of wireless development. In the paper, a multi-layer antenna with a 4<sup>*</sup> 4 cell structure meeting 5.8 GHz is designed. The characteristic mode analysis method and three-step method are used in the paper, and the coupling of the antenna at various frequencies is analyzed. According to the current intensity of the antenna surface, the corresponding mode is excited by multi-layer substrate pore feed, and the various characteristics of the antenna are analyzed. The bandwidth of the antenna is 5-6.7 GHz, and the maximum gain is 8.02 dB. The area of each cell is 106 mm<sup>2</sup>, which is in line with the trend of antenna miniaturization.

articleTitle: Compressed Sensing for Solving Electromagnetic Scattering Problems of Multi-scale Complex Structures over a Wide Range of Incident Angle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Investigation on the electromagnetic characteristics of muti-scale complex structures over a wide range of incident angle is carried outed in this paper. A new scheme based on compressed sensing (CS) theory is proposed and introduced into the method of moments (MOM). This technique need to form several new excitation sources that including various spatial information to obtain several measurements. With the help of proper sparse representation, induced currents of any incident angles can be calculated by reconstructed techniques. To demonstrate the efficiency and the accuracy of the proposed method, numerical simulations of the axial mode helical antenna with a cup ground is accomplished by the new scheme, and the pattern and RCS of the antennas are accurately reconstructed.

Author Keywords: a wide range of incident angle

articleTitle: A New Broadband Horn Antenna With Enhanced Gain for 1-18 GHz EMC Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Dual ridged waveguide horn antennas (DRGH) are widely used in antennas and EMC testing systems as feeder and standard antennas respectively. However, traditional 1-18 GHz DRGH antennas have beam splitting above 12 GHz. In this paper, not only the waveguide section and the ridge curve are optimized, and the higher order modes is eliminated, but also the ridge width is further optimized to improving the antenna aperture efficiency. The final design of the DRGH antenna size is 242mm $\times$ 136 mm $\times$ 189 mm, the gain is 6.53 dBi at 1 GHz, 14.1 dBi at 9.5 GHz, 16.5 dBi at 18 GHz.

articleTitle: Electrothermal coupling solver based on cascaded Fourier network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, a deep learning framework based on cascaded Fourier network is proposed to solve steady state electrothermal coupling problems. Compared to classical algorithms such as the finite element method, a well-trained framework can obtain the coupled fields from the explicit boundary conditions accurately within several milliseconds. As a result, the proposed framework can realize real-time predictions, hence can be applied in various practical scenarios.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-Wideband Terahertz Wavelength Division Multiplexer Based on Inverse Design Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Integrated photonic gadgets play a key function in lots of fields. The process of designing silicon optical devices mostly relies on experience to manually adjust the subtle parameters, which is laborious and ineffective. The proposed inverse design algorithms can simplify the design process of silicon optical devices, improve the design efficiency, and realize multifunctional compact devices. In this paper, two inverse design based methods are proposed to design terahertz band wavelength division multiplexer(WDM).
