One is based on topology optimization to design a 4-channel ultra-wideband WDM and the other employs a direct binary search technique to create a 3-channel ultra-wideband terahertz WDM, both of which have high transmission, low interference and high integration. Multifunctional photonics devices are predicted to be increasingly used in modern photonic integrated circuits due to these advantages.

articleTitle: A mode and frequency reconfigurable liquid antenna for wifi&wimax band
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A mode and frequency reconfigurable liquid antenna for wifi/ Wimax band is proposed in this paper. We realised TM<inf>01δ</inf> and HEM<inf>11δ</inf> mode radiation in one cylindrical DRA by feeding the DRA in diffirent location with two ports. Therefore, a frequency reconfigurable antenna based on wifi/wimax band was realised. Due to the transparent ionic liquid adopted in the antenna, it has advantages in base station antenna applications to dispell public concerns on radiation.

articleTitle: A Compact Portable Programmable Array Antenna with Beam Scanning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a programmable element with low reflection loss and relative bandwidth of 25% in the X band. A PIN diode is integrated on each element. The 180° reflection phase difference can be realized through switching the diode working states. A compact portable programmable array antenna containing $8 \times8$ reconfigurable elements is designed to realize dynamic beam scanning. The beam scanning range of the proposed array antenna is ±30°, which has a good scanning accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Modeling of the Negative Capacitance Converter for Capacitance Cancellation Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Negative capacitance cancellation technique is widely used to cancel the influences of parasitic capacitances, e.g., those in power converters and inductors. The operation amplifier based one is particularly promising due to the flexibility in capacitance tuning. However, the performance of such negative capacitance converters is influenced by the un-ideal performance of the op-amp. This paper proposes an improved model to predict the frequency-dependent behavior of the negative capacitance converter. The proposed method is validated by both SPICE simulation and measurement up to 30MHz.

articleTitle: Parametric Scattering Center Modeling Multi-targets Considering Near Couplings
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, by considering the electromagnetic coupling relationship, the extraction method of multi-target scattering centers is improved. Moreover, the extraction of coupled scattering center parameters is proposed, which shows the feasibility and reliability of obtaining the coupling scattering center through the scattering center model. Based on the scattering center model and considering the electromagnetic coupling relationship between adjacent targets, this paper improves the extraction method of multi-target coupled scattering centers. This paper proposes the extraction of coupled scattering center parameters based on time-frequency matching.

articleTitle: A Wideband Circularly Polarized Planar Array for Millimeter-wave Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband circularly polarized (CP) magneto-electric (ME) dipole antenna array is proposed. The design of CP element is based on linearly polarized ME-dipole that consists of four patches and four metallic vias. To achieve circular polarization, two rotationally symmetric F-shaped strips are attached to one pair of diagonally arranged patches, and the other pair of patches is widened and partially truncated to enhance AR bandwidth. A T-shaped microstrip line is implemented to excite the designed element through an H-shaped coupling slot. The proposed CP element achieves an AR bandwidth of 32% and impedance bandwidth of 50%. Furthermore, An $8\times 8$ elements array is designed, fabricated and measured. The measured results show that the array prototype has an impedance bandwidth of 50% from 25 to 42 GHz, a 3 dB AR bandwidth of 31.2% covering 30.2 to 41.4 GHz, and the radiation efficiency higher than 60%. The experimental results verify the good performance of proposed CP array.

articleTitle: 5.8GHz Channel Characteristics of a Real Arm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: As the frequency increases in the development of Body Area Network (BAN), the investigation of real human body becomes necessary. Thus, this paper studies the corresponding electromagnetic channel characteristics at 5.8GHz for a real Chinese male arm. The patch and monopole antennas whose substrates are based on the 100% cotton are considered in order to analyze both the surface wave and line-of-sight (LOS) propagations, respectively. Here, two uniform antennas of each type are placed on the wrist and the upper arm, and study the corresponding electromagnetic channel characteristics by means of their transmission coefficients. The simulated results show that the transmission coefficients on the arm for both antenna types are about 2.5dB higher than those of air due to the existence of surface wave, and the transmission coefficient of the patch antenna is more sensitive than that of the monopole if the antenna separates the arm in the certain distance range.

articleTitle: An Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering Imaging Method Based on U-net Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents an inversion model based on deep learning to solve electromagnetic inverse scattering (EMIS) problems. The traditional methods have poor accuracy and high computational cost in solving EMIS. In order to solve these issues, a high-precision imaging model is proposed based on U-net structure. This model includes two parts: the down-sampling area and the up-sampling area. The up-sampling area first extracts the corresponding feature fragments from the measured scattering field, and compresses these features. Then, these features are retrieved and expanded by the up-sampling area. Finally, the dielectric parameters of unknown scatterers are reconstructed. The numerical test results show that this method is effective and feasible for solving EMIS problems.

articleTitle: Study of difference scattering from a target located above a rough surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The difference scattering from a target located above a rough surface is studied. The method of moments (MoM) and the iterative physical optics method (PO-PO) are applied to simulate the difference scattering.

articleTitle: An Absorptive/Transmissive Frequency Selective Surface with Wide Transmission Band and Low Insertion Loss
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The Absorptive/transmissive Frequency Selective Surface (ATFSS) is a multi-layer composite periodic structure with out-of-band absorption and in-band transmission characteristics, usually composed of a lossy resistive sheet (RS) and a lossless bandpass FSS. In this paper, an equivalent circuit method based on transmission line theory was used to design the ATFSS with idea of higher frequencies for transmission and lower frequencies for absorption, as well as the impedance conditions for satisfying wave transmission and absorption. Furthermore, the S-parameters was fitted, which verifies the design concept. Finally, the simulation was performed with numerical method. It is shown from the simulation that the broadband absorption of the ATFSS ranges from 2.00 GHz to 6.29 GHz, and the broadband transmission ranges from 8.46 GHz to 11.32 GHz with an insertion loss of less than 1 dB.

articleTitle: A Method for Designing Single-Layer Broadband High-Gain Metasurface Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel design strategy for broadband high-gain metasurface antenna. Metallized vias are installed in the middle of the parasitic patches to change the modal behavior, and two slots are etched in the middle of the main driven patch to improve impedance matching. The characteristic mode analysis shows the high gain behavior of the proposed antenna. The impedance bandwidth for -10 dB is 15.2% (4.98-5.8 GHz) with a gain of 6.84-8.88 dBi over the operating bandwidth.

articleTitle: Suppression of Microwave Leakage by Photonic Crystals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The idea of using photonic crystal band gap to suppress the leakage of industrial microwave equipment is proposed, and its feasibility is proved by simulation experiments. The band structure of photonic crystal is adjusted to control the electromagnetic wave. Compared with the traditional microwave suppressor, this method has better suppression performance and lower manufacturing cost, and its application range is wider than the traditional suppressor.

articleTitle: Design of Regular Subarray Tiling with Maximum Aperiodicity and Structural Repetitiveness
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the state-of-the-art literatures, irregular subarray tiling configurations (irRSTCs) without periodicity are mainly adopted to eliminate grating lobes. However, it leads to high design complexity due to the lack of structural repetitiveness. Different from the traditional idea, a regular subarray tiling configuration (RSTC) is proposed in this paper, which is obtained by replication and flipping of a regular subarray with asymmetrical feeding phase. In this way, the structural repetitiveness is achieved, while the periodicity of the RSTC is broken. To enhance the beam scanning ability, the aperiodicity of the RSTC is maximized with a predictability minimization model. Numerical results show that compared with the irRSTC, the proposed RSTC expands the beam scanning range by 10° and improves the directivity of larger angle scanning by 2.9 dB only at an expense of 1.9 dB reduction at the boresight. Moreover, the design complexity is reduced to 1/64 of the original one for a $16\times 16$ array.

articleTitle: Efficient Transient Thermal Simulation of Interconnects under ESD Stress by Laguerre-Based Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, a Laguerre-based finite-element method (LBFEM) combined with the data filtering technique is presented for transient thermal simulation of multilevel interconnects under electrostatic discharge (ESD) stress. By employing the data filtering technique, much fewer basis functions are required to achieve the same accuracy compared with the original LBFEM, which significantly speed up the simulation time. The accuracy and efficiency of this method are validated by a representative example.

articleTitle: A Broadband and Highly Efficient Power Amplifier based on Simplified Real Frequency Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel synthesis method for designing broadband and highly efficient power amplifier (PA) based on optimal impedance analysis and simplified real frequency technique (SRFT) is presented. After determining the impedances for highly efficiency across the bandwidth of interest, the optimal matching topology and element values are obtained utilizing the SRFT. The effectiveness of this design technique is illustrated using a commercially available 10W GaN device. The designed PA achieved an average power-added efficiency (PAE) of 62% from 1.0 GHz to 3.0 GHz (100%) with an average output power of 40.5 dBm and gain of 12.5 dB.

articleTitle: Application of Graphic Electromagnetic Computing in Electrically Large Scale Composite Target Scattering
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The radar cross section(RCS) calculation model of electrically large-scale composite target is established by combining graphic electromagnetic computing(GRECO) with high-frequency optical approximation and physical diffraction. Using different illumination modes, the normal vector at each point on the target surface is obtained, and the total scattering field of the target is acquired by the coherent superposition of the scattering field and the diffraction field at each point on the target surface.

articleTitle: 3D Microwave Imaging as Point Cloud with Continous Normalizing Flows
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Point cloud is a 3D representation with accurate location information, which can be applied to multi visual and graphic tasks. If the microwave can be imaged as a point cloud, the accurate position information of the target in the 3D solid space can be obtained, which is of great significance and great challenge. In this paper, a model of learning two-level distribution is designed for microwave imaging with point cloud as the target, that is, different kinds of targets are modeled into shape distribution, different individuals in the same kind are modeled into point distribution, and reversible continuous normalizing flow is used in each level. The visualization of experimental results shows that this method can produce impressive results.

articleTitle: Adaptive-Correlation Back-Projection Imaging Algorithm for Ground Penetrating Radar in Complex Scenes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The current correlation back-projection algorithm can only deal with the imaging of objects at the same buried depth. However, for objects with different depths and different relative permittivity, the electromagnetic wave echo composition is complicated, there is no strong correlation between the time delays of the reflected echoes, the echo signal in the center of the detection area is used as a reference signal to perform consistent correlation processing, which will cause serious suppression. In this paper, an improved adaptive correlation algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the algorithm of maximum variance between clusters (OSTU) is used to extract the horizontal position and number of buried objects, and then the relevant parameters are adaptively adjusted according to the reflected energy and horizontal position of different targets. Finally, back-projection algorithm imaging is performed. Simulation experiments showed that the algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively improve the imaging effect, improve the detection probability of buried objects, and adapt to the variability of detection scenes.

articleTitle: 3D LOD-FDTD for the Multi-Pole Debye Dispersive Media Using Z-Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper introduces the application of unconditionally stable locally one-dimensional finite-difference time-domain(LOD-FDTD) method to 3D multi-pole Debye dispersive media model. Compared with other methods for dispersive media, the Z-transform method does not need to retain the electromagnetic values of the previous moments, has less memory footprint, and its numerical implementation is more straightforward. Through numerical examples, ZT-LOD-FDTD shows the advantages of accuracy and high computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on a fast multi-channel time-domain measurement method for low-frequency electromagnetic interference
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: For complex large-scale systems with many electromagnetic interference measurement items, measurement points and measurement conditions, the traditional sweeping frequency-domain measurement method has practical problems such as high cost and long period. In this paper, a multi-channel time-domain fast measurement method for low-frequency electromagnetic interference is proposed, and a multi-channel time-domain low-frequency electromagnetic interference measurement system is developed. The experiment verify shows that the proposed measurement method and the developed measurement system can accurately obtain the low-frequency electromagnetic interference characteristics of complex large-scale systems, and the measurement speed is fast and the cost is low.

articleTitle: RCS Reduction of an FP antenna through both in-band scattering and out-of-band absorption
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: By loading a randomly arranged coding metasurface as a partially reflective surface, an Fabry-Perot antenna with broadband RCS reduction is designed. The coding unit consists of two metal square patches printed on both sides of the dielectric plate for in band scattering and a frequency selective absorber (FSA) for out-of-band absorption. By loading the coding metasurface with dual properties, not only broadband RCS reduction in 5.6-18.6GHz is achieved, but also the gain of the FP antenna is increased to 14.4dBi.

articleTitle: Broadband Radar Cross Section Reduction Realized by Complicated Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a complicated metasurface for radar cross section (RCS) reduction is proposed. The nonuniform metasurface elements occupy anisotropic property. The adjacent metasurface elements are arranged orthogonally. Therefore, the reflected waves form the adjacent elements will generate different phase for a linearly polarized incident wave. Based on the phase cancellation principle, a broadband RCS reduction are achieved. Simulated results show that the proposed nonuniform metasurface achieves 6 dB RCS reduction from 6.6 GHz to 24.1 GHz under normal incidence.

articleTitle: Effect of Radiation Pattern of Transmitting Antenna on Radio Wave Propagation in Rectangular Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, effect of the radiation pattern of transmitting antenna on radio wave propagation in rectangular tunnel is studied. Ray tracing method was used for calculating field distributions generated by half-wave dipole, patch antenna, and beamforming antenna in the tunnel. The results show that under a certain transmission power, the radio wave coverages given by the three antennas in the tunnel are similar to each other, but within a certain range in the tunnel, the beamforming antenna can give the best radio wave coverage among three cases.

articleTitle: MIMO Channel Characterization Through Electromagnetic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) is a key technology in 5G, which enhances the spectral efficiency and enlarges the capacity of MIMO by adopting orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM). In this paper, we proposed a simple MIMO model, which consists of point sources and point receivers. Then, we introduce the scalar Green’s function and dyadic Green’s function and derive the channel matrix H from the scalar Green’s function and the dyadic Green’s function, respectively. Furthermore, we calculate the capacity of MIMO system through channel matrix H with a water injection method and compare it with a traditional equal power method. The water injection method achieves the maximum channel capacity by optimizing power distribution. Finally, the effects of the distance, SNR and permittivity on capacity of MIMO are derived. In all cases studied, the capacity derives from water injection method is better than equal power method.

articleTitle: Contrastive Research on Performance of Face Detection based on Classical and Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Face detection technology has always been hot in the field of computer vision. However, current face detection algorithms are difficult to be applied to any scene with both high speed and accuracy. At present, there are few comparative studies between classical algorithm and deep learning algorithm. In this paper, our motivation is to study different types of face detection algorithm and make a comparison. We compare the average precision and receiver operating characteristic curve of RetinaFace with Mobilenet and Resnet. We also compare the performance of classical algorithm Viola-Jones with RetinaFace and deep neural network module in OpenCV library. We compare their detection performance in terms of computation time, frame rate, detection accuracy and model size under the conditions of multiple faces, high exposure and pose change. This study provides guidance and basis for researchers and developers to choose or design face detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on the Scattering and Imaging Characteristics by the Focused EM Vortex Beams
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The scattering and imaging property by the focused electromagnetic (EM) vortex beam is studied in this paper. Considering the special wave front of the EM vortex beam, it is potential in the application of radar detection and recognition. However, the traditional vortex beam is limited by the ring shaped beam. It is more practical to study the focused vortex beams. The generation of the focused EM vortex beam is briefly reviewed and the back scattered echo model for linear structure is established using the traditional scattering point model. The scattered field and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging are simulated which indicate that the scattering by the focused vortex beams are different compared with plane wave and the imaging results can be used to improve radar target recognition.

articleTitle: Revers Time Migration Method of Ground Penetrating Radar Based on gprMax
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Reverse time migration (RTM) technology has been widely used in seismic imaging measurement of complex structures because it is not affected by the changes of formation structure and lithology. This paper expanded it to the Ground penetrating radar (GPR) imaging of unknown subsurface detection scenes. The gprMax tool based on the finite difference time domain method (FDTD) is used to calculate the forward and backward extrapolation of the electromagnetic wave field, and the 2D and 3D RTM is realized based on the zero-time imaging condition of the explosion reflector principle. Multiple 2D and 3D simulation experiments show that the RTM algorithm can restore the characteristics of underground structures very accurately, even if the underground structure is complex, such as multiple buried target or nonparallel layered structure.

articleTitle: A Simple Equivalent Circuit Model for Metasurface Based Reflection-Type Polarization Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A simple equivalent circuit model (ECM) is proposed to characterize reflection-type polarization converters comprising anisotropic metasurfaces. The impedance matrix of the metasurface in the xy coordinate system is obtained by multiplying the impedance matrix in the diagonal axis with a rotated matrix. The diagonal impedance matrix can be calculated by a simple LC series-parallel circuit. Some typical polarization converters with different metasurface shapes are demonstrated to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Subgrid Surface Impedance Absorbing Boundary Condition for FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Previously, we designed an effective SIABC, which significantly reduces the thickness of the absorption boundary compared with the traditional PML boundary condition. The use of SIABC requires a long distance between the scatterer and the boundary, which increases the memory and running time of the program to a certain extent. The sub grid technology alleviates this problem by setting the area near the scatterer as a fine grid area and other areas as a coarse grid area, so as to reduce the number of grids to be calculated in the whole area. We build a simple two-dimensional model and apply sub grid technology for simulation. The simulated results are compared with those of different grid sizes. It is found that the simulation accuracy is basically the same as that of full fine grid, and the calculation time is greatly shortened. The results show that the combination of sub grid technology and SIABC is a promising FDTD simulation method.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic-Thermal Co-simulation of Microstrip Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An electromagnetic-thermal co-simulation method is proposed for microstrip filter in this paper. The Maxwell equation is solved by discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (DGTD) method, while thermal simulation is carried out based on finite-element time-domain (FETD) method. Electromagnetic and thermal simulations are coupled by power loss and temperature-dependent conductivity. At last, the method is applied to analyze the microstrip low-pass filter.

articleTitle: Development of an Integrative Electromagnetic Simulation Software
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A software for calculating electromagnetic scattering and radiation for arbitrary complex targets is developed based on several self-developed algorithms such as method of moment (MoM), fast multipole method (FMM), physical optics (PO) algorithm, shooting bouncing ray (SBR) and MoM-PO hybrid method. The complete and diverse built-in optional algorithms ensure that the software has superior computing performance and strong universality. Not only providing comprehensive and diversified multiple components geometry modeling, mesh processing and other pre-processing functions, it also provides rich post-processing functions such as 2D display and 3D visualization of RCS or ISAR results. Moreover, the convenient open interface supports secondary development to extend software functions. In this paper, the developed software programmed by C++ has been introduced with some simulation examples to demonstrate the accuracy.(Abstract)

articleTitle: Design of Reflective Time-Modulation Metasurfaces for Generating Multiple Doppler Shifts
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We propose a design method of electromagnetic (EM) metasurfaces composed of time-varying coding reconfigurable elements for multiple Doppler shifts. Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is used to load the time-domain voltage signals to the varactor diodes. Multiple Doppler shifts are realized by dynamic control of reflection phase. The results of the preliminary experiments have demonstrated the ability of the metasurfaces to modulate the Doppler shifts with the voltage signals applied on the varactor diodes. The proposed method is easy to implement, and have potential applications in radar imaging and wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Design of A Quadrature Signal Generator with Filtering Response Using Stub-Loaded Resonators
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a new filtering quadrature signal generator, which can realize the conversion from single-ended signal to four quadrature signals with filtering response. Two different coupled-line topologies, i.e., parallel coupled-line and anti-parallel coupled-line with short-circuited end are discussed to achieve the desired 90° phase difference. Moreover, with resorting to the electric field distribution of a $\lambda$/2 open-circuited transmission line, the inherent out-of-phase characteristic can be obtained. Based on the above discussion, a four-way quadrature signal generator with filtering response can then be realized using coupled stub-loaded resonators. Measured results show that the designed four-way filtering quadrature signal generator operates at 2.0 GHz with 0.5 dB magnitude imbalance and $90 \pm 5^{\circ}$ phase difference.

articleTitle: Design Concept and Implementation of Weighted-Polarization Antennas for Body-Centric Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper summarized the design concept as well as implementation of weighted-polarization antenna for body-centric network applications. The feature of the antenna is to overcome the polarization mismatch caused by the variation in the cross-polarization power ratio (XPR) of incoming wave and the tilt angle of the antenna mounted on dynamic part of human body by adjusting the appropriate weight function and phase difference. For the dynamic channels of both off-body and on-body, improvement of wireless performance such as MIMO channel capacity, has been validated by over-the-air (OTA) testing using a spatial fading emulator and an arm-swinging human phantom. The content is based on existing published work, and some extensions of the design concepts for future applications are also introduced.

articleTitle: A Water-based Switchable Frequency Selective Rasorber
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A water-based switchable frequency-selective rasorber is proposed in this paper. The proposed structure consists of an optimized-cross-shaped microchannel by polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) and a bandpass frequency selective surface (FSS) at the bottom layer of the structure. The novel structure achieved a switchable absorption/reflection property by controlling the injection and discharge of pure water, where the transmission passband at 4.2 GHz and 4.8 GHz with the low insertion loss. Furthermore, the proposed design had a good transmission/absorption/reflection performance under different polarization.

articleTitle: An Electromagnetic Compatibility Prediction Method Based on the Transmitter Spectrum and Receiver Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the electromagnetic compatibility design stage of a large electronic platform, it is hard to complete the spectrum allocation due to the difficulty in predicting the electromagnetic frequency interference of transmitters and receivers. In real scenarios, there are few prediction methods and appropriate analysis and it is difficult to show the frequency compatibility in the system, commonly because of data missing and the abstract EMC design specifications. To solve this problem, we propose an electromagnetic compatibility prediction method based on the transmitter spectrum and receiver sensitivity, with which the frequency compatibility of multiple transmitters and receivers working simultaneously can be predicted using some frequency parameters of transmitters and receivers. The predicted outcome is about the existence of the interference between these devices when they work simultaneously and the exact frequency bands where the interference occurs.

articleTitle: Optically Transparent Broadband All-Dielectric Water-Based Metasurface Microwave Absorber Based on Composited Cylindrical Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Controlling the absorptivity and transmissivity at different frequency bands has great importance in microwave and optical camouflage for both civil and military applications. In this paper, the ultra-broadband water-based metasurface absorber is designed with all-dielectric design, which is fabricated with optically transparent materials polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) and structured water. The high absorption over 90 % of this ground-free structure is achieved from 12.8 to 33.8 GHz with a relative bandwidth of 90 %. This easy-to-fabricate design can be obtained by stacking the PMMA substrate after laser cutting method. The design offers a simpler and available promising way to achieve optically transparent and ultra-broadband microwave absorption for metamaterial absorbers.

articleTitle: Characteristic analysis and test evaluation of ship lightning effect
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Lightning poses a serious hazard to ships navigating on the sea. Due to the large scale and complex structure of the platform, the lightning effect and experiment of the platform are special and complex. In order to obtain lightning strike attachment characteristics, attachment probability and electromagnetic environment in different areas of warship, the total differential lightning attachment analysis method based on zoning and layering was used to modify the additional areas and zoning of lightning attachment on warship. The characteristics of lightning strike attachment effect, lightning attachment probability and electromagnetic field strength on the whole surface of warship platform in different directions were obtained by simulation. Using lightning scaling model test of warship, the test validation and comparative analysis are carried out to verify the accuracy of the method and data, and to provide technical support for the protection and test of warship in lightning strong electromagnetic environment.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband Low-profile Antenna Loaded With Matching Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Ultra-wideband low-profile antenna loaded with matching circuit is presented in this paper, which is buried in a specific cavity. The proposed antenna is fed through coaxial directly to achieve a low-profile characteristic. The designed antenna is proposed to achieves a $4:1$ bandwidth $(f_{L^{-}}-f_{L})$ with VSWR <3, while the antenna without loaded with matching circuit only reaches a $2.5:1$ bandwidth $(1.6f_{L}-4f_{L})$. The maximum size is only about $0.17\lambda_{lll}$, and the profile height is only $0.055\lambda_{lll}$, which makes the antenna suitable for the application of airborne platforms. The special cavity’s maximum length is $0.33\lambda_{1lw}$, the profile height is the same as the antenna, and the angle of inclination is 15°.

articleTitle: Contrastive learning of visual representations-based DDTF for geophysical data denoising and interpolation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A new artificial intelligence denoising and interpolation algorithm is proposed for geophysical data processing. The contrastive learning of visual representations (CLR) and the data-driven tight frame (DDTF) are incorporated in this new algorithm to achieve a accurate patch selection and direction learning for complex datasets with low amplitudes and high noise levels. Three cases are shown to test the effectiveness of this new method.

articleTitle: A Full-link SAR Simulator for Ocean Remote Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: It is challenging to accurately interpret the ocean wave on SAR images, which is mainly because the scattering of moving waves is the synthesis of various complex mechanisms, and SAR imaging is a unique nonlinear mapping relationship. In this paper, we present a full-link simulation method to simulate the main parts of ocean surface scattering, ocean surface motion, platform motion, echo generation and acquisition, SAR imaging and so on. This method reflects the dynamic characteristics of ocean surface by simulating the movement and the decoherence effect of scattering points within each radar pulse. Therefore, the main modulation mechanism and nonlinear phenomena on the SAR imaging of moving ocean surface can be described more accurately. Sentinel-1 wave mode SAR images and buoy data of corresponding region and time were used for the experiment. The satellite platform data and buoy wave spectrum were input into the simulator, and it was found that the simulated SAR image spectrum was in good agreement with the real SAR image spectrum.

articleTitle: Broadband circularly polarized wearable metasurface antenna based on flexible material
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to achieve a more stable effect of the wearable antenna, broadband, high-gain, circularly polarized, and low specific absorption rate (SAR) wearable metasurface wearable antenna is designed based on the flexible material polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS). A new non-uniform mountain-shaped metasurface unit is proposed to realize the radiation of circularly polarized waves, and the conversion from linear polarization to circular polarization is realized by using slot coupling feeding. By using the human body simulation model to analyze whether the proposed wearable antenna is harmful to the human body, the SAR results show that it is harmless. The proposed wearable antenna can be used in 5 GHz wearable wireless communication devices due to its broadband and circular polarization and has excellent performance.

articleTitle: Decoupling of MIMO Antenna With Dummy Antennas for 5G Mobile Terminals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An efficient decoupling method with a dummy antenna for multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) in fifth-generation (5G) mobile terminals is proposed in this paper. This dummy antenna not only decoupled a pair of antennas at higher band, but also operated at lower band. A pair of antennas is working at N78 (high band) and dummy antenna is working at Wi-Fi 2.4G (low band). Then, they are deployed at the side-frames of the smartphone in normal. With the T-shape dummy monopole antenna, two close coupled antennas show great improvements of isolation from 9dB to more than 20dB at operating band. Moreover, the proposed method that using low band antenna decouples the high band antennas is also suitable for other frequency band combinations.

articleTitle: Fast Scattering Compuation of Group Targets Based on Current Iteration
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: this paper proposes a fast method to compute the scattering field of group targets through current iteration. The initial induced currents of the target are computed by full wave numerical method. To validate the feasibility of this method, the scattering field of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm targets computed by this method are compared with the results of full wave numerical method. The comparison results show good agreement between the two results, and the calculation time and memory consumption of this method are obviously lower than the full wave numerical method.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of an Ultra-compact Magnetoelectric Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A simplified three-dimensional simulation model of the magnetoelectric (ME) antenna based on thin-film bulk acoustic wave resonator (FBAR) is proposed in this paper. Based on this model, the effect of the radius ratio of the magnetostrictive layer to the piezoelectric layer on the performance of the FBAR ME antenna is studied. When the radius ratio is 0.8, the ME antenna has the optimal comprehensive performance. The ME antenna resonates at the frequency of 1.6 GHz while providing a peak return loss of 22.22 dB and 10 dB-bandwidth of 6.2 MHz. Based on the ME antenna, the influence of the substrate clamping effect on the radiation performance is studied. The resonant cavity induction increases the radiation efficiency of the ME antenna by 461 times. The ME antenna’s radiation pattern is similar to that of a magnetic dipole.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Antenna with Sum and Difference Patterns Based on Liquid Metal
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A microstrip antenna with sum and difference beam capabilities using liquid metal is presented. Firstly, the performance of a transmission structure that the liquid metal contacts the microstrip transmission line indirectly is studied. Then a power divider using this structure is proposed. By injecting the liquid metal into different regions, the path of the energy transfer is changed, thus changing the phase of the output ports. Finally, a microstrip antenna using this power divider to achieve sum and difference beams is designed. The simulation results show that the antenna operates at 1.6GHz with gain of 9.99dB and 7.3dB in sum and difference beam states respectively.

articleTitle: Broadband Conformal TCDA Antenna for Wide-angle Scanning with a Compact Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: According to the application of limited space, a vertically polarized cylindrically conformal TCDA array antenna with wide bandwidth is demonstrated in this paper. The array antenna takes a tightly coupled dipole array (TCDA) with double-layer frequency selective surfaces (FSS) superstrate and performs well at a band of 6GHz ~ 18GHz. And the array antenna adopts a beam forming in the radial direction of cylinder while realizing a beam scanning to ±45 degree in axial direction. Besides, a compact architecture is built to deal with the troubles caused by cylindrically conformal structure. The proposed array antenna has a great engineering significance in situations like cramped space and abnormal area.

articleTitle: A Quad-band Meta-hologram Based on Reflective Metasurface with Complex-amplitude Control
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Metasurface has been widely used to manipulate electromagnetic wave. To achieve better performance, it is essential to achieve multi-band metasurface with both phase and amplitude controls. In this work, a quad-band reflective meta-atom is proposed with independent complex-amplitude controls at four operation frequencies. In addition, a quad-band meta-hologram is demonstrated to reconstruct the circularly polarized incident wave into different images. The proposed method shows great potential in multifunctional meta-devices with enhanced performance.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method of Echo Reconstruction in Radio Frequency Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The interrupted transmitting and receiving (ITR) has been used for target probing with pulse signal in radio frequency simulation (RFS). Recent studies show that the echo reconstruction process based on frequency domain filtering can avoid the distortion of the target range profile caused by ITR. However, this reconstruction method may fail under some parameters. To solve this problem, the optimized ITR and echo reconstruction method are proposed in this letter. Firstly, the theoretical derivation of the optimized ITR parameters is given. Secondly, the simplified echo reconstruction method based on frequency domain filtering is presented. Experiments show that optimized ITR and echo reconstruction method can significantly improve the reconstruction accuracy and obtain the target range profile compared to the traditional ITR.

articleTitle: 1D scattering center extraction based on electromagnetic simulation data by improved TLS-ESPRIT algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An improved LTS-ESPRIT algorithm is used to study the extraction of one-dimensional scattering center, in which the Hankel matrix is introduced to construct the measurement matrix to improve the accuracy of the method. The proposed method is used to extract target scattered echoes obtained by SBR technique, and the simulation results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of this method. Compared with the classical IFFT method, this method has a higher resolution unit, which can effectively identify dense scattering centers.

articleTitle: The enhancement of second harmonic generation with the double resonance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a three-fold symmetry Nano-antenna, the nonlinear optical effects, such as the enhancement of the second harmonic generation, can be achieved by double resonance, and at the same time the polarization of the second harmonic wave can be effectively regulated and boosted, so that when the incident wave is a left-handed circularly polarized wave, the wave emitted at the second harmonic frequency is a right-handed circularly polarized wave; when the incident wave is a right-handed circularly polarized wave, the wave emitted at the second harmonic frequency is a left-handed circularly polarized wave..

articleTitle: Jamming of Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging using Time-modulated Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a method for inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) imaging jamming using time-modulated metasurfaces is proposed. This method interferes with ISAR imaging by temporally modulating the metasurface to achieve phase modulation of the incident wave in the fast time or slow time direction. The effectiveness of the time-modulated metasurface in jamming of ISAR imaging is verified by electromagnetic simulations for the first time, taking a square metal plate covered with a time-modulated metasurface as an example.

articleTitle: A High Isolation MIMO Monopole Antenna Realized by a Rectangular Parasitic Patch with I-shaped Slots
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A multiple input multiple output (MIMO) antenna covering sub-6GHz band in 5G is proposed in this paper. The antenna consists of two C-shaped monopole antenna elements and a decoupling structure which is a rectangular parasitic patch engraved with three I-shaped slots and deposited between two antenna elements to achieve high isolation. The antenna size of this design is $35mm\times 60mm\times 1.6mm$, the simulation impedance matching bandwidth is 4.4-5GHz, and the isolation in the working frequency band is less than −40dB. Simulation results show that the antenna has good impedance matching and high isolation performance.

articleTitle: Near-field Measurement Method for Electromagnetic Scattering of Electrically Large-scale Plasma
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the near-field test environment of 01500×3300mm vacuum vessel with low electromagnetic scattering, the relative measurement method is used, that is, the results of electrically large-scale plasma radar cross section (RCS) are extrapolated by measuring the ratio of standard volume echo energy to plasma echo energy.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Pixelized Forward Simulator and Inverse Designer of the Frequency Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, two deep learning frameworks based on Wideresnet40×2 and Reverse-CNN are proposed to serve as the forward simulator and inverse designer of the pixelated frequency selective surface (FSS). Compared to the classical parametric modeling, the proposed framework can realize the pixelized design with high degrees of freedom. Besides, a fully trained network can achieve considerable precision with tiny time cost, which has potential to be used in various real-time FSS designs.

articleTitle: On the design method of the transition section of GTEM cell
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The design method of transition section of GTEM cell is presented. The method is based on double-steps operation. The first step is transforming the circle to rectangle and the second step is transforming between two rectangles. The GTEM cell’s cross section impedance must remain unchanged to ensure the low VSWR. The simulation results verify that the design method is efficient.

articleTitle: 0.1 THz Linear Group-Delay Engineered Transmission Line All-Pass Network with LTCC Substrate
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A linear group delay engineered non-commensurate transmission line all-pass network using only two lengths coupled-line and low temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) material as substrate for analog signal processing applications is presented. The structure is obtained by interconnecting adjacent coupled-line to form two-port network with stripline technology. The non-commensurate structure can realized arbitrary linear group delay with a slope of 0.2 ns/GHz around 0.1 THz, which can be applied to time dilation and Fourier transforming. The research results of this paper are of great significance.

articleTitle: A approximate method for evaluating common-mode voltage frequency spectrum of a twelve-phase generator rectifier system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A voltage state model of common-mode of the twelve-phase generator rectifier system is proposed according to the time-domain analysis. Based on the state model with step function approximation, an analytical method in frequency-domain for the purpose of prediction and evaluation of common-mode voltage is presented. The effectiveness and accuracy of the method in frequency domain is verified by comparison to the simulation results.

articleTitle: Substrate Integrated Waveguide Leaky-Wave Antenna Featuring Complete Backward Scanning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) leaky-wave antenna (LWA) is presented, which has the capability of complete backward scanning with stable backfire radiation. The proposed SIW-based LWA consists of periodic structures, in which each double-layer slotted unit is shaped by duplicating the upper nonidentical slots to the bottom layer with the same offset d<inf>y</inf> with respect to the transversal axis. By properly manipulating the dispersion diagram of the unit cell, continuous frequency scanning characteristic from backfire to broadside is realized. Within the operating band from 12.6 GHz to 18.2 GHz, the antenna works in the fast-wave band, accomplishing beam scanning from −90° to 0° with the average realized gain and radiation efficiency of 10.39 dBi and 84%.

articleTitle: A reconfigurable switched notchband UWB antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper mainly proposes a reconfigurable switched notchband UWB antenna, which is designed and modified on the basis of the traditional microstrip patch antenna. By cutting the radiation patch of the circular monopole without changing the radiation performance of the antenna, two circular branches are added above the radiation patch, and the circular branches are connected with the radiation patch through diodes, By controlling the conduction and disconnection of the diode, it can control whether the current flows to the circular branch, and then control the presence or absence of notchband. The antenna is fed through the microstrip line, and the input impedance at the bottom of the microstrip line is 50 ohms, which is well matched with the SMA connector. The radiation patch and microstrip line are located above the dielectric substrate, which is made of F4B material with a dielectric constant of 2.94. On the other hand, the bottom of the substrate is the ground. Circular corner cutting at the two corners of the top of the ground and rectangular slotting in the middle of the rectangular metal ground can improve the impedance matching of the antenna and improve the radiation performance of the antenna. The bandwidth of the antenna is 1.27 GHz - 10.6 GHz. When the switch is on, a notchband can be generated at the frequency from 2.18 GHz – 2.56GHz, and when the switch is off, the notchband disappears to form an UWB antenna. The antenna proposed in this paper can be used in many fields, such as wireless communication system, Internet of things and so on.

articleTitle: Reflector-Based Dual-Polarized Multi-Beam Antenna for X-Band
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A dual-polarized multi-beam antenna based on a reflector in the X-band is presented. The traditional horn antenna is replaced by a dual-polarized microstrip antenna to form the feed array of the reflector. Offset beams in different directions can be generated when feeds at different positions illuminate the reflector. The microstrip antenna realizes the miniaturization and lightweight of the feed array, thanks to its small size and light weight. Simulation results show that the antenna can radiate both horizontally polarized waves and vertically polarized waves in the X-band, and in both polarization modes, it can realize a nine-beam scanning in the range of ± 5° at the frequency of 9.65GHz.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized UWB Monopole Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, A novel miniaturized Ultrawideband(UWB) monopole microstrip antenna has been proposed. It consists of semicircle ring-like radiating patch, microstrip feeding line and partial ground plane structure(PGPS). The simulated results have demonstrated that the antenna have provided extremely wide operating frequency band from 1.4GHz to 27.4GHz(S<inf>11</inf>< -10dB) by etching multi gourd-shaped slots on the PGPS. The total electrical length of the proposed antenna structure is only $0.28\lambda \times 0.2 \lambda$ at 1.4GHz. It is believed that the antenna has many applications in Internet of Things(IoT), Wireless Body Area Network(WBAN) and so on.

articleTitle: A beamforming microstrip array antenna for K-band applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A beamforming microstrip array antenna for K-band is proposed. The antenna array is a 4*4 array, the array elements are composed of slotted rectangular microstrip antennas, and the feed network is a combination of series and parallel connections. The beamforming is achieved by using a microstrip phase shift network. The design results show that the VSWR of the antenna array is less than 1.8dB in the operating frequency bandwidth of 24.0 GHz-24.5 GHz. This antenna array can achieve a gain of more than 7.6dB in the beam range of 22.5° azimuth and 30^° pitch.

articleTitle: The Application of the ADI-FDTD method in the 3D hybrid subgrid technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A hybrid subgrid scheme based on the conventional finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) schemes are proposed. The alternating-direction-implicit FDTD (ADI-FDTD) is used to calculate electromagnetic fields in fine grid regions subgrids and the FDTD method is applied to the coarse grid regions. Numerical results demonstrate that the drastically reduced computation time and memory can be achieved by using the proposed 3D hybrid algorithm.

articleTitle: An Wideband Orthogonal Dipole Antenna for LTE Base Station Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a wideband and dual-polarized antenna for LTE $(1700 \sim 2700$ MHz) base station applications. For the sake of structural simplicity, the proposed antenna only consists of a pair of crisscrossed dipoles, a reflector and two Y-shaped microstrip feeders. The crisscrossed dipoles are designed to achieve wideband and dual-polarized characteristics. Each dipole is excited by a microstrip coupling. And the reflector is used to reflect energy and obtain the ideal front-to-rear ratio. The simulated results show that the antenna has an impedance bandwidth of 53.2% (RL$\gt 10$ dB) from 1670 MHz to 2840MHz. In addition, the isolation between two polarizations input ports is higher than 30dB.

articleTitle: A Dual-Port Microstrip Patch Antenna with Improved Isolation for Wide-Angle Phased Scanning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A dual-port microstrip patch antenna (MPA) with wide beamwidth for phased array is proposed in this paper, which realizes good isolation between two ports. Firstly, a shorting wall is loaded along the x-axis between the two ports to improve the isolation between the two ports. Then, a pair of shorting walls are loaded along the y-axis to further improve the isolation and broaden the beamwidth of the MPA. Finally, the MPA is arranged as an 8-element phased array, and its simulated results show that the scanning angle of the phased array can be ranged from $-60^{\circ} \sim + 60^{\circ}$. Most importantly, it keeps a low profile of about $0.07\lambda _{{0}}$.

articleTitle: Analysis of Boresight Error for an Ablating Radome with Full Wave MLFMA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The boresight error of an ablating radome is analyzed in this paper. A highly optimized program of multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA) for volume integral equation (VIE) was developed to deal with the problem with millions of unknows. Results show that the influences of ablation on the boresight error (BSE) and boresight error slope (BSES) could be very significant compared to without ablation.

articleTitle: SAR Echo Cancellation Using Azimuth Interrupted Sampling Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Echo cancellation is an ingenious method that protects the target of interest (TOI) by cancelling target echo at radar receiver with an active source. In this paper, a synthetic aperture radar (SAR) echo cancellation method using azimuth interrupted sampling modulation is proposed. The proposed method can not only cancel the target echo, but also generate false targets along the azimuth direction, which will protect the TOI more efficiently. Measured SAR data simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Simulation of Rain Attenuation to Electromagnetic Wave Propagation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper applies computation method of rain attenuation and simulates the effect of rain attenuation to electromagnetic wave propagation. This paper provides attenuation features of different rain strength to different frequency electromagnetic wave, analyses the regulation of attenuation features, and draws the conclusions.

articleTitle: Design of Broadband Asymmetric Multisection Directional Coupler
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The multi-section coupled transmission line is equivalent to the cascade of multi-section ladder impedance filters, which provides a basis for the research of broadband directional couplers and meets the needs of microwave systems. Using this method, a multi-section -15 dB stripline directional coupler was designed in the application frequency range of 0.7-3.7 GHz, and the directional coupler was improved by loading the branch compensation capacitor. And through the electromagnetic simulation software HFSS for simulation optimization. The simulation results show that the coupling degree of the coupler is about -15 dB in 0.7-3.7 GHz, the return loss is greater than 20 dB and the isolation is greater than 30 dB, the insertion loss is less than 0.33 dB, the in-band fluctuation is less than 1 dB, and the physical size is 38mm $\times 6$ mm, which meets the design requirements of the -15 dB coupler.

articleTitle: A dual-band antenna designed for 5G communication based on a self-decoupled antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-band antenna for 5G communication based on an antenna design with self-decoupling properties is introduced.The antenna is composed of a self-decoupled antenna unit vertically placed on an 30×80 mm<sup>2</sup> ground plane and printed on 0.8 mm thick FR-4(εr = 4.4, tanδ = 0.02) substrate,and then added a pair of L-shaped coupling feeder structures on this basis.Simulation shows that the antenna has two operating frequency bands of 3.3-4.2GHz and 4.8-5GHz, and has good transmission and isolation in the above two operating frequency bands.Besides,it also has the advantages of small size, self-decoupling,high isolation,simple structure and easy processing.The antenna can be used as 5G mobile phone communication antenna unit.

articleTitle: Efficient Electromagnetic Simulation of Large Antenna Array with Non-conformal FE-BI-DDM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the characteristic subdomains approach is used to deal with the radiation and scattering problems of large-scale periodic antenna arrays. In periodic structures, such as large-scale antenna periodic arrays above $10 \times 10$, 9 feature elements can be extracted. Using nine feature elements, the original periodic structure can be obtained, and the grid processing time during the early stage of the simulation can also be greatly reduced. The algorithm for solving the radiation and scattering problem of a periodic antenna array is a non-conformal domain decomposition method (DDM) based on the hybrid finite element method (FEM) and the boundary integral method (BI). Several numerical examples validate the efficacy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Ballistic Target Micro-motion Parameters Identification with CNN Denoiser Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to identify micromotion parameters of radar echo with noise based on deep learning. The radar echo database is constructed from the point scattering model and the micro-Doppler spectrogram dataset is obtained then. The convolutional neural network is constructed to denoise radar echo with three kind of noises with different SNR, and target micro-motion parameters are identified.

articleTitle: Folded C-Type SIW Slot Array Antenna with Sidelobe Suppression for mm-wave Application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this article, a millimeter wave (mm-wave) multibeam array antenna based on folded C-type substrate integrated waveguide (FCSIW) is proposed, which can suppress the sidelobe level of the E-plane and H-plane radiation patterns. By adjusting the size of the slot element, the excitation amplitude of the slot element can be regulated. So that the excitation amplitude of the slot element presents the Chebyshev distribution, and the sidelobe level with −25 dB of the H-plane radiation pattern can be achieved. In addition, the $4 \times 8$ butler matrix (BM) based on FCSIW is used to excite the $8\times 4$ slot array antenna, which can make the excitation amplitude of the slot array antenna present an approximate Chebyshev distribution along the E-plane, and the sidelobe level with −17dB of the E-plane radiation pattern can be obtained. Finally, the mm-wave multibeam array antenna with sidelobe suppression is designed, which can be used as one of the candidates for 5G mm-wave communication in the future.

articleTitle: A Handle-like Antenna for Narrow Band Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a handle-like antenna for narrowband internet of things (NB-IoT) is presented. The proposed antenna holds two roles, which means it works as a structural handle while transmitting signals simultaneously. The impedance bandwidth with $S_{11} < -15$ dB ranging from 866 to 918 MHz and a peak gain not less than 4.5 dBi are achieved. The proposed antenna has good omnidirectional radiation performance with a pattern roundness less than 0.65 dB.

articleTitle: Four Dimensional Antenna Arrays for Reduced Scattering Cross Section
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This work presents an investigation on the application of scattering cross section (SCS) reduction by four-dimensional (4-D) antenna arrays. The scattering fields of 4-D arrays are approximately deduced based on the scattering pattern multiplication theory. In addition, the definition of SCS of 4-D arrays is also formulated in consideration of the hostile receiver bandwidth. Finally, a 32-element microstrip patch linear array is utilized to access the practicality for scattering reduction by 4-D arrays combined with the optimization algorithm. Numerical examples confirm that the bistatic SCS of the 4-D array is considerably reduced as compared to that of the reference array by optimizing time sequences.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Broadband Power Division Phase Shifter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A 4-way power division feed network with 90° phase-shifting function is introduced in this paper. It works in Ku full frequency band and is cascaded by Wilkinson power divider and broadband phase shifter. The phase differences of the four outputs are 90°, 180° and 270° respectively. HFSS software is used for simulation design, and then machining is carried out. The measured results are basically consistent with the simulation results: the standing wave of each port is less than 2, the phase-shifting error is within ± 10°, and the insertion loss is within 8dB.

articleTitle: Wideband polarization reconfigurable antenna based on double C-shaped radiators
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An enhancing bandwidth tri-polarization reconfigurable antenna based on double C-shaped radiators is proposed. The antenna consists of a modified ground plane, double C-shaped radiators, and a feedline with a simple parasitic stub. The modified ground plane and the parasitic stub can improve the impedance matching, meanwhile, adjust the axial ratio performance. Two PIN diodes are embedded between the C-shaped radiator and the feedline. Three polarization reconfigurable modes can be achieved caused by switching two PIN diodes state, linear polarization (LP), left-hand circular polarization (LHCP), and right-hand circular polarization (RHCP). As the simulated results show, the −10-dB impedance bandwidth reaches 126.6% (1.76-7.83 GHz) in LP mode and 78.4% (2.96-6.78 GHz) in CP modes. And the proposed antenna has a 3-dB axial ratio (AR) bandwidth of 84% (2.6-6.4 GHz) in two CP modes. Therefore, the proposed antenna can meet the requirement of the modern wireless and satellite communication system.

articleTitle: Broadband infrared absorber based on metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to obtain an absorber with high absorption efficiency and wide absorption band, a metamaterial structure by Metal-ENZ-Insulator-Metal (MEIM) is designed, and its absorption in the 130-230 THz band is calculated using the simulation software frequency-domain solver. By rotating the upper metal layer and the lower hollow layer, the simulation results can be slightly disturbed. In addition, the introduction of the epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) media will also affect the bandwidth and absorption of the absorber. Therefore, the high absorption and wide bandwidth of the absorber are achieved by the size of the structure, the rotation angle of the corresponding structure,and the clever application of the ITO layer.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual-Polarized Antenna Based on DRA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper researches a kind of dual-polarized antenna array which is used in the field of passive guidance radar. In order to receive the incident signal with polarization information of the radar, the dual-polarized antenna scheme based on dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) and printed monopole is designed. The DRA and printed monopole are taken as the vertical polarization port and horizontal polarization port, respectively. A dual-polarized antenna array with four elements is mounted on a metal ground plane and the dual-polarized patterns are formed. The center frequency of the designed antenna is 3.5GHz. The frequency range is 3.35GHz ~ 3.56 GHz. The gains of the two polarization ports are about 7dB and 5.8dB, respectively at the center frequency, the polarization port isolation is greater than 25dB, the isolation between two elements is greater than about 19dB, the axial ratio (AR) of DRA port is greater than 39dB, and the AR of monopole port is greater than 18dB. Within the angle range of ±30°, it meets the requirements of beam coverage. Due to the electromagnetic coupling between the elements, the radiation patterns of the two polarization ports have a certain jitter, and the error correction should be carried out. The designed dual polarization antenna array is composed of asymmetric polarization ports. The designed antenna has a simple structure, and it can provide a certain technical reference for practical engineering.

articleTitle: The Effect of a Reflecting Cylinder in Two-Dimensional Inverse Source Problem for Circumference Geometries
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The inverse source problem with a perfect electric conducting (PEC) reflecting cylinder in two-dimensional plane is discussed in this paper. The reflecting cylinder is placed coaxially with the observation domain. The induction currents on the reflecting cylinder are analyzed by applying the boundary condition. A new operator is defined for calculating the electric field of observation domain. The rebuilding currents are then computed using the singular value decomposition (SVD) of this new operator. The numerical experiments verify that the reflecting cylinder enhances the accuracy in rebuilding currents.

articleTitle: A Compact mm-Wave Bandpass Filter Based on Transversal Signal Interference Concept in IPD Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A compact mm-wave bandpass filter (BPF) based on the transversal signal interference concept in integrated passive-device (IPD) technology is proposed and designed in this paper. The proposed structure transmits signals through two paths. In Path 1, a $\pi$-shaped structure consisting of coupled lines, shorted stubs, and a transmission line is achieved. Path 2 is composed of a cascade of coupled lines and transmission lines. By using the IPD technology, the center frequency of the designed BPF is set to 28 GHz. A wideband BPF with multiple transmission poles and transmission zeros is implemented. In the final electromagnetic (EM) simulated results, good performances with the fractional bandwidth of 83.07% of the designed BPF are implemented.

articleTitle: Study on Electromagnetic Scattering from Sea Surface in Limited Depth Sea Area Using Finite Difference Time Domain Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of radar detection and remote sensing of sea surface and nearby targets in the limited depth area, the Venn sea spectrum and Monte Carlo method are adopted to simulate the sea surface in the limited depth area, Debye model is selected to calculate the dielectric constant of sea water. The electromagnetics scattering from sea surface at finite depth are studied using the finite difference time domain method, and the angular distribution curve of scattering coefficient is obtained. The simulation results show that the scattering coefficient oscillates with the scattering angle, and the scattering enhancement effect occurs at the reflection direction of the mirror. Although the depth of sea water has little influence on the scattering coefficient, there are still laws to follow, the greater the depth of sea water, the smaller the scattering coefficient. Sea surface wind speed, incident angle and wind area have great influence on scattering coefficient. The larger the wind speed is, the smaller the scattering coefficient is, the larger the incident angle is, the smaller the scattering coefficient is, the larger the wind area is, the smaller the scattering coefficient is.

Author Keywords: Sea surface in limited depth sea area

articleTitle: Research on Ionospheric Es Characteristics in Qinghai-Tibet Region
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The Sporadic E layer of the ionosphere is a space area that exists within 90km-130km above the ground. The electron density in the layer is high, which can be 100 times greater than that of the normal E layer. The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, also known as the roof of the world, has a unique geographical location. It is significant to research on the Es characteristics of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and its surrounding areas. According to the different value ranges of the critical frequency of the Es layer, the occurrence frequency of Es and the variation law of the critical frequency in the Qinghai-Tibet region of China are analyzed statistically and studied. Then some conclusions were drawn.

articleTitle: Radome time-domain far-field measurement and analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The time-domain Ultra-Wide Band(UWB) radome system can be used for radome transmission efficiency measurements by obtaining information in an ultra-wide frequency band in a single experiment. This paper describes the working principle of the system in measuring the radome, measures the effect of the radome on the antenna performance under different time-window conditions in the time-domain, and compares the results with the frequency domain measurements. The comparison results show that the time-domain test and frequency-domain test in the radome performance of good frequency band test results match. In this paper, the validity of the system for radome transmission efficiency measurement results is verified by measurement and analysis.

articleTitle: Design of a Wideband Circularly Polarized Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband circularly polarized printed antenna is designed. The circularly polarized radiation of the antenna is realized by S-shaped semicircle splicing structure and L-shaped feeder. At the same time, by designing a convex branch near the feeder on the floor and slotting on the floor below the feeder to broaden the circular polarization bandwidth. On this basis, the third-order impedance converter is used to realize broadband impedance matching. The 10-dB impedance bandwidth and 3-dB bandwidth of the antenna are 68.1 % (3.35GHz, 1.80 GHz -3.66GHz) and 71.5 % (3.10GHz, 1.95 GHz -4.12GHz), respectively. The antenna has simple structure and good circular polarization characteristics.

articleTitle: The Design of Active Metasurface For Non-reciprocal Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The design of an active metasurface for non-reciprocal transmission is proposed in this paper. The proposed metasurface is designed based on the integration of the power amplifier and wideband E-shaped antennas in the unit of the metasurface, which enables the unit to have wideband non-reciprocal transmission characteristics, through which the metasurface achieves capabilities of one-way transmission. The unit cell of the metasurface mainly consists of cascaded textures including the receiving antenna, circuit layer, and the transmitting antenna. The feasibility of the presented design is verified by full-wave simulations, and the overall structure achieves good non-reciprocal performance over the whole X band with a forward transmission of more than 9dB and a backward transmission of less than -19dB.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Frequency-Selective Rasorber Based on Square-Loop Using Circular Spiral Inductor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
