abstract: A novel broadband lower-frequency absorption and higher-frequency transmission frequency-selective rasorber (FSR) is proposed in this paper and the physical mechanism of the resistive sheet is analyzed based on the equivalent circuit method. The simulated results show that the proposed FSR has a transmission band with transmissivity higher than 80% spanning from 11.46 GHz to 14.93 GHz and a 10 dB absorption bandwidth spanning from 2.9 GHz to 9.2 GHz.

articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave Slot-Coupled SIW Metasurface Antenna with Wide Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) metasurface antenna with a wide impedance bandwidth is proposed in this paper. The proposed metasurface antenna is fed by a SIW slot and therefore achieves a wide 10-dB impedance bandwidth from 18.5 GHz to 42.9 GHz, namely a fractional bandwidth of 79%. With respect to the E-field distributions, the proposed metasurface antenna can support TM<inf>10</inf> mode, antiphase TM<inf>20</inf> mode, and TM<inf>30</inf> mode. The dimension of the proposed metasurface antenna is 0.80 $\lambda 0 \times 0.72 \lambda_{0} (\times 0.24) \lambda_{0}$, where $\lambda_{0}$ is the free-space wavelength at 30 GHz. The maximum gain within the interested frequency spectrum is 7.9 dBi.

articleTitle: Improved Reverse-Time Migration for Through-the-wall Radar Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Reverse-time migration (RTM) is a highly accurate migration method, especially in complex scenes. The cross-correlation imaging condition based on RTM is first used for through-the-wall imaging in this paper. However, it can be found that low-frequency noises exist in the RTM imaging. In order to suppress these noises and improve the imaging resolution, we propose an improved imaging method applying a wavefield decomposition to RTM. To verify the feasibility of our proposed method, the imaging of a target behind a wall is simulated. The numerical results show that good imaging results can be achieved by the RTM with wavefield decomposition.

articleTitle: A New One-Dimensional Photonic Crystals for Infrared Emission Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the wide application of infrared detection in the military field, the problem of how to reduce the probability of military targets being detected and identified has become urgent. In this paper, one-dimensional photonic crystals with wide incidence angle range are analyzed and simulated. The reflectance and transmittance properties of different structures are discussed with application in modulation of infrared emission.

articleTitle: Surface Current Analysis in a 2D Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper investigates the distribution of the currents in a 2D metamaterial realized with coupled-resonant circuits, when it is excited by a voltage source in an arbitrary cell. Possible different models for the analysis of these structures are illustrated and the effect of the approximations they introduce on the current values are shown for a $5\times 5$ array. Furthermore, the matching of the boundaries of the metamaterial is discussed and possible values for the matching impedances have been numerically calculated for arrays with a small number of resonators.

articleTitle: Pulse Signal Denoising Method Based on Frequency Domain Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Bandpass filtering and time-domain wavelet threshold denoising methods do not perform well in pulse signal denoising, which are not effective for Specific Emitter Identification (SEI). Base on this problem, we propose a frequency-domain wavelet threshold denoising method, and improve the threshold estimation method as well as threshold function. Simulation results show that the proposed method is more superior than traditional methods in restoring the envelope and instantaneous frequency of the single-frequency pulse signals, which proves that our method has the potential to improve the accuracy of SEI.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile Dual-Layer Top-Hat Monopole Antenna with Gain Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A high gain dual-layer top-hat monopole antenna is presented here. The proposed structure consists of a short monopole, a dual-layer top-hat, a metal ground plane and five shorting pins. The dual-layer top-hat decreases the profile of monopole and forms an open-ended cavity. The cavity structure increases the aperture and enhances the gain. Five shorting pins are added between top-hat and ground plane to match the input impedance. The impedance bandwidth of the monopole is 160MHz (2.12-2.28 GHz). The maximum gain is 5.35 dBi.

articleTitle: An Improved Stereo Matching Network Based on Modified PSMNet
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to solve the stereo matching problem better, the accuracy of the algorithm in the stereo matching task needs to be improved. To tackle the problem, we proposed a Dual Spatial Pyramid Pooling Stereo Matching Network with Attention Mechanism (DSANet), a stereo matching network with better multi-scale feature extraction capability based on the basic structure of Pyramid Stereo Matching Network (PSMNet). The network consists of two main modules: the dual spatial pyramid pooling module and the attention module. The former module extracts multi-scale features from different branches at the same time. After concatenating these different features, the latter module will optimize the fused features and generate the cost volume with different branches multi-scale feature. The proposed approach was evaluated on the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and Toyota Technological Institute (KITTI) 2015 dataset. Our experiment results on the KITTI 2015 dataset show that the mismatch rate of our network is 3.02%. Compared with the basic structure of PSMNet, the proposed method improves the effect of stereo matching.

articleTitle: Single Sideband Modulation Based Phase-coded Continuous Wave Inverse Synthetic Aperture Ladar Demonstration and Outdoor Experiment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Inverse synthetic aperture LADAR(ISAL) is a coherent imaging technology whose resolution is independent of the target distance. Compared with traditional linear frequency modulation scheme, phase-coded ISAL can refer to the methods in communication to reduce noise interference or compensate the carrier phase error. In this paper, a novel single sideband modulation based phased coded continuous-wave ISAL system is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The spectral efficiency of the new system is twice that of the traditional system, resulting in twice the utilization of echo energy. In addition, the use of continuous wave modulation improves anti-noise capability and imaging quality. Imaging results with azimuth resolution of 1.51cm are obtained by two 4cm aperture diameter telescopes at the distance of 7km, achieved about twenty times higher than conventional real aperture imaging system.

articleTitle: High-Gain Millimeter-Wave Reflectarray Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A high-gain reflectarray(RA) antenna is proposed in this paper for millimeter wave applications. The unit cell of the RA is etched on the top surface of a substrate, with a circular patch and a concentric circular ring. It can be found that this unit cell can cover a whole 360°, with an insertion loss lower than 0.3 dB. To verify the design idea, a 24×24 unit RA antenna was designed, fabricated, and measured. Its measured realized gain can be up to 28.1 dBi, with satisfactory cross-polar and sidelobe levels.

articleTitle: Cooperative Jamming Resource Allocation Based on Artificial Bee Colony Multi-objective Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Electromagnetic countermeasure plays an important role in modern warfare. Cooperative jamming is one of the main means to counter radar network. In order to improve jamming efficiency, a jamming resource allocation algorithm based on artificial bee colony multi-target decomposition is proposed in this paper. The algorithm takes into account the interference effect and cost, and uses the decomposition mechanism to improve the search efficiency. The simulation results show that the allocation solution set obtained by this algorithm has good performance in diversity and spacing.

articleTitle: Research on the scattering characteristics of fully ionized dusty plasma for FPL model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Starting from Boltzmann’s approximate equation, the Fokker-Planck-Landau (FPL) collision model of dusty plasma is derived. The expression of the electrical conductivity of the dusty plasma under the collision condition of the fully ionized FPL is obtained by combining the collision effect and charging effect of the dusty plasma. Using Z transform finite-difference time-domain (Z-FDTD) algorithm to analyze the scattering characteristics of metal cylinder coated with dusty plasma with different dusty plasma parameters. Results show that with the increase of electron density, size and density of dust particles in dusty plasma, the double-station RCS of metal cylinder coated with dusty plasma also increases. These findings provide references for studying the electromagnetic scatting of dusty plasma.

articleTitle: A Design of Honeycomb-shape Coil for Wireless Charging of Leadless Cardiac Pacemaker
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel transmitting coil for magnetic resonance wireless power transfer is designed, which is called honeycomb-shape coil. It surrounds the human body and can form a stronger magnetic field than the traditional coil. Take the leadless cardiac pacemaker as an example, suppose it is on the left side of the heart and design the LCC-C compensation topology circuit to build an energy transmission system working at 13. 56MHz, the simulation results show that the transmission efficiency is approximately 0.9%. When the received power is 1mW, the maximum average specific absorption rate (SAR) of the system is 0. 240W/kg, which accords with the EN62209-1 human electromagnetic radiation standard.

articleTitle: A Transmitted Cross-Polarization Converter With High Frequency Selectivity
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A method is proposed to improve the frequency selectivity for the transmitted polarization converters. The second-order and third-order resonant unit cells are presented, which can convert the Y-polarized electromagnetic(EM) waves to X-polarized EM waves with high frequency selectivity. The structure consists of a receiving patch, a filtering structure, and a transmitting patch. Moreover, each layer is connected by the metal holes. The third-order resonant element can achieve cross-polarization conversion in the passband 4.95-5.05GHz, and the frequency selectivity (FS) can achieve 212dB/GHz and 189dB/GHz, respectively at the low and high frequency of the passband edge. In general, the results indicate that the structures possess the characteristics of both high frequency selectivity and cross-polarization conversion.

articleTitle: Comparison of Three 1-bit Reflective Metasurfaces for Low-cost Phased Array Antenna Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper makes a comparison study of three 1-bit reconfigurable metasurfaces. Aimed at applying in low-cost phased array antenna, the three metasufaces adopt one PIN diode in each element and have a relatively large periodicity. Simulation results suggest that these three metasurfaces achieve 1-bit reflection phase with low loss and one of them has both lowest loss and widest working band.

articleTitle: Comparison of Three 1-bit Reflective Metasurfaces for Low-cost Phased Array Antenna Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper makes a comparison study of three 1-bit reconfigurable metasurfaces. Aimed at applying in low-cost phased array antenna, the three metasufaces adopt one PIN diode in each element and have a relatively large periodicity. Simulation results suggest that these three metasurfaces achieve 1-bit reflection phase with low loss and one of them has both lowest loss and widest working band.

articleTitle: A Shooting and Bouncing Ray Method for Scattering from Anisotropic Material
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A shooting and bouncing ray (SBR) method for anisotropic material is presented in this paper. The SBR technique describes the multi-reflection of electromagnetic rays on the target. The reflection coefficients of the anisotropic material are calculated by the generalized transmitting matrix (GTM) method. The present algorithm is able to calculating the radar cross section (RCS) of arbitrary target coated with anisotropic material. Numerical results show the good accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Planar Spatial-Fed Antenna Arrays for Terahertz Beamforming Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The terahertz technique has been undergoing rapid development recently due to the increasing demand for high-speed space communications and high-resolution imaging. As a significant component to support the terahertz wireless systems, high-performance antennas, such as spatial-fed antenna arrays, are urgently required. This paper reports some recent progress in terahertz beamforming spatial-fed antenna arrays in the State Key Lab of Millimeter-Waves, Southeast University, China, including a 140-GHz high-gain transmitarray antenna, a 400-GHz high-gain folded reflectarray antenna, and a 400-GHz compact Airy beam generator.

articleTitle: Multiple-Resonance-Based Wideband Phase Shifter with High-Performance and Extended Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: To meet the requirements in the wide scanning range, wide bandwidth, and precise radiation pattern, wideband phase shifters (PSs) with large phase shift range, small phase deviation, and compact circuit size are demanded. Recently, multiple resonance design method is proposed and developed to achieve excellent performances of the wideband PSs. In this work, the proposed multiple-resonance-based PSs are reviewed and concluded, including the working principle, design methods and examples for series and parallel topologies, and extended applications in antennas and FSSs. All of results demonstrate that multiple resonance design concept of the wideband PSs can be well employed in the modern wireless communications.

articleTitle: A C-Band Antenna Sensor Element for Monitoring Reflective Water Quality
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A C-band antenna sensor element is proposed for monitoring reflective water quality based on the reflectarray element of subwavelength resonant sinusoidal dipole loaded with a liquid channel at the bottom. The sensor element has a good phase shift performance, which is related to the change of permittivity through the reflection coefficient, and can be used to detect the change of water quality by monitoring the amplitude of reflection coefficient. The operating frequency of the element is 5.0 GHz, and the element period is $dx = dy =22$ mm or $0.03 \lambda_{0}$, where $\lambda_{0}$ is the free-space wavelength. With the loaded water at the bottom, the resonant frequency can be effectively shifted when the equivalent permittivity of water is changed. The feasibility and performance of the sensor element have been verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Parameter Inversion of Rough Surface based on GBDT Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the parameters of the Gaussian rough surface are inversed through the gradient lifting decision tree (GBDT) model. And the Bayesian optimization algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the GBDT model. The training set and test set are constructed with the backscattering coefficient from the rough surface by the method of moments (MoM). The accuracy of the GBDT model is shown

articleTitle: Fast Method For Calculation of Scattering Matrix in MIMO Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The scattering matrix is a key model for multiple input and multiple output radar. In this work, we propose a fast method for the calculation of scattering matrix in multiple input and multiple output radar. The calculation of bi-static radar cross section of the target is accelerated using reduced basis method, which can reduce the number of basis functions in solving the scattering field of different incident wave using method of moment. Numerical examples validate such method’s efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: FFT-FFG for electromagnetic scattering from random rough surfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper states that FG-FFT applies to electromagnetic scattering from random rough surfaces. FGFFT greatly improves the computational efficiency and reduces the memory demand with the correctness. Some numerical examples are provided to demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Active Bianisotropic Metasurfaces: from Dynamic Polarization-Dependent Wavefront Tailoring to Arbitrary Polarization Control
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we provide a brief summary of the recent progresses on active bianisotropic metasurfaces for dynamic manipulation of electromagnetic wavefront and polarization. Three illustrative design examples are presented, including a dynamic dual-polarized beam shaper for vortex beam generation, a dual-polarized reconfigurable reflectarray for wide-angle beam scanning, and a polarization converter for arbitrary output polarization generation. The proposed bianisotropic metasurfaces may enable new architectures in wireless communication systems, high-gain antennas, polarimetry radars, etc.

articleTitle: One dimensional direct inversion of electromagnetic method using exploration depth and longitudinal and transverse resistivity
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A one-dimensional direct inversion method of electromagnetic method using exploration depth and longitudinal and transverse resistivity is proposed. The earth is expressed as a one-dimensional layered uniform model, and the depth of each layer is the exploration depth. Make the apparent resistivity equal to the longitudinal and transverse resistivity above the depth of each layer. Due to the simultaneous use of longitudinal and transverse resistivity, the inversion can be carried out smoothly even if there is serious horizontal heterogeneity in the section. Some cases are shown to test the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of 2D Multi-section Smoothly Connected Low-scattering Shape
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Low-scattering metal carriers and brackets are important equipment in the design and manufacture of stealth aircraft. In the design of low-scattering shape, a suitable shape can reduce its own electromagnetic scattering. Traditionally, a simple and smooth shape usually composed of piecewise curved surfaces. Based on the analysis of the design mechanism, a multi-segment smoothly connected two-dimensional lowscattering shape is constructed by the universal analytical formula. The scattering of the TE and TM waves from the two-dimensional shape is calculated by the use of the method of moments and optimized by the particle swarm optimization algorithm. The desired two-dimensional low-scattering profile can be obtained.

articleTitle: A Wide-Band and Wide-Beam Antenna for Wide-Angle Scanning Linear Phased Array
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to widen the 3dB beam width of the traditional microstrip antenna and improve its narrowband shortcomings, this paper proposes a new type of broadband microstrip antenna based on the traditional microstrip antenna. The proposed new microstrip antenna creatively introduces a cavity while increasing the thickness of the dielectric substrate, and uses the feeding method of probe feeding. The size of the antenna is 10mm$\times$ 10mm$\times$ 10.82mm. Based on the proposed antenna element, it is simulated and calculated. The simulation results show that its working frequency range is 14.012GHz $\sim$ 16.660GHz, its relative bandwidth reaches 17.65%, its 3dB beam width reaches 201.4°, and its gain reaches 3. 36dBi. It has good radiation characteristics within the passband range. The increase in beamwidth enables it to perform well in wide-angle scanning phased arrays.

articleTitle: The Scattering Characteristics of Uncertain Hybrid Metal-dielectric Objects by Disturbance EFIE-PMCHWT Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: For the problem of electromagnetic scattering characteristics of multi-dimensional uncertain metal/dielectric hybrid targets, based on EFIE-PMCHWT integral equation method, a method which can analyze the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of metal/dielectric hybrid targets with uncertain shape and dielectric materials is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the metal/dielectric hybrid target is modeled by NURBS surface, then several independent control points are used to control the shape of the metal/dielectric hybrid target, and the random variables are introduced into the EFIE-PMCHWT integral equation. In order to accelerate the solving speed of electromagnetic scattering analysis of metal/dielectric hybrid target, a EFIE-PMCHWT disturbance method based on multilayer fast multipole method (MLFMA) is proposed in this paper, which speeds up the matrix vector multiplication between far fields, so as to speed up the whole solving process.

articleTitle: Near Field Coupling with a Twisted Bundle of Twisted Wire Pairs (TBTWPs) Above Ground Plane
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the field-to-wire coupling with a twisted bundle of twisted-wire pairs (TBTWPs) from a near radiating source is investigated by using the multi-conductor transmission line theory. To do that, the near radiating source is assumed to be a dipole antenna, after that, the induced voltage and current sources due to the radiations of the near-source are obtained. Therefore, the induced common-mode (CM) and differential-mode (DM) currents at the terminals of the TBTWPs are achieved. The results are validated by using the commercial software FEKO with a good agreement obtained. Moreover, the sensitivity of the induced CM and DM current due to the random fluctuations of the cable parameters are investigated. It is found that the DM signal is highly sensitive to any small geometry deformation of the cable.

articleTitle: Wideband Slot Antenna with Characteristic Mode Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A microstrip wide-band slot antenna is designed with the characteristic mode theory (CMT). Firstly, by characteristic mode analysis (CMA), the modes of the initial structure are obtained. Then, select the modes that can be excited according to the model significance (MS) and the characteristic current of the structure, and choose the appropriate way to excite the desired target mode. Multimode resonance is obtained by the above operation. Thus, the bandwidth of the slot antenna is increased. The antenna consists of a circular slot with rectangular branches around it and two semi-circular patches separated by a rectangular slot at the center of the circular patch. The antenna in this paper is fed with a 50 Ω microstrip line. The impedance bandwidth is 2.6-3.8 GHz and the relative bandwidth is 37.5%.

articleTitle: Three-layer Lunar Regolith Model of Inhomogeneous Layered Random Non-Spherical Particles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, Gauss-type pulses are used to detect the layered structure of the lunar regolith. And the thickness of regolith can be obtained by the digital elevation model (DEM) of lunar. The lunar regolith is divided into three layers. Meanwhile, every layer has a different volume fraction of rock scatterers. The Muller matrix solution containing surface scattering and volume scattering is derived. For the layered structure of the lunar surface, based on the vector radiative transfer (VRT) model, the incident wave intensity and different layered structures of lunar regolith were simulated, and the relationship between the volume fraction and layer thickness and echo intensity was analyzed.

articleTitle: Realization of Micro Vi-SAR Imaging Processing Based on Multi-core DSP
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Micro synthetic aperture radar (SAR) has become a hot topic because of its small size, low power consumption and light weight. Expanding micro SAR to micro video synthetic aperture radar (Vi-SAR) has always been an important research direction. Aiming at the problems of low imaging quality and slow imaging rate of micro SAR, a micro Vi-SAR imaging processing system based on multi-core digital signal processor (DSP) is proposed in this paper. The system includes principle of chirp scaling (PCS) module, azimuth Sinc interpolation module, sub image phase Gradient Autofocus (PGA) module. Verified by the measured data of micro SAR, the system can complete the data processing of five single precision floating-point images which are 1K\times 1K in 0. 98s, and finally output the images. The imaging frame rate is up to 5Hz, which is meeting the imaging requirements of real-time Vi-SAR.

articleTitle: Simulation on the Effects and Solution of Frequency Mismatch Phenomenon for Narrowband Active Power Filter Application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The frequency mismatch effect in narrowband active power filtering process is analyzed and a solution to alleviate the effect is validated by simulation. The result shows the performance of harmonic suppression gets worse in presence of frequency mismatch but this effect can be compensated by applying a suitable step-size value of least-mean-square algorithm.

articleTitle: A Dual Circularly Polarized Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a dual circularly polarized mircostrip antenna with wide impedance matching and radiation bandwidth is proposed. The antenna can realize the LHCP and RHCP radiation<sup>[1]</sup> with high transceiver isolation of simultaneous operation. The proposed antenna consists of feed network, a radiating patch and parasitic radiating structures which further improve the matching and radiation pattern bandwidth and lower profile. The simulation results show that the proposed antenna has stable radiation patterns frequency band from 2.1 to 2.5 GHz with the ports isolation better than 20dB. By controlling the amplitude and phase of the bridge feed network, the two ports can simultaneously generate LHCP and RHCP radiation.

articleTitle: An Improved Envelope Fitting Algorithm for Frequency Spectrum Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of undershoot and non-monotonicity in the envelope fitting applied to frequency spectrum analysis, this paper proposed an improved envelope fitting algorithm based on linear interpolation. The improved algorithm performs envelope fitting on the non-stationary region of the original signal by combining the method of finding extreme values and linear interpolation, and rejects the non-monotonic extreme points to ensure the monotonicity of the envelope. For the stationary signal regions, the envelope can tightly wrap the original signal and retain the characteristics of the original signal. The simulation results shows that the method proposed in this paper can effectively fit the envelope of the original signal without undershoot regions.

articleTitle: A New Criterion For Optimization Of Total Variation Denoising
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Based on Chambolle’s algorithm, we develop a data-driven optimization scheme based on minimization of Stein’s unbiased risk estimate (SURE)—statistically equivalent to mean squared error (MSE). We propose a recursive evaluation of SURE to monitor the estimation error during Chambolle’s iteration; the optimal value is then identified by the minimum SURE. We exemplify the proposed methods with 1-D signal denoising.

articleTitle: Decoupling Reflector based on Reflected Phase Regulation for MIMO Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a concept of decoupling reflector based on reflected phase regulation (DSRPR) is proposed for isolation enhancement between MIMO antenna elements. Firstly, an array antenna having only 0.01λ<inf>0</inf> edge-to-edge spacing between adjacent elements is chosen as the initial antenna (IA). Secondly, on the basis of theoretical analyses, DSRPR is developed as the wideband decoupling structure. The DSRPR consists of multiple sub-wavelength metal reflective patches loaded by open-circuit stubs, which are printed on a thin superstrate of antenna array. Working principles of DSRPR are illustrated by theory and simulation results. Secondly, on the basis of theoretical analyses, DSRPR is developed as the wideband decoupling structure for IA. Compared with array antenna decoupling surface (ADS), the antenna using MADS shows lower profile.

articleTitle: An AWE-Enhanced Wideband Subdomain DG-RTC Algorithm in Solving Electromagnetic Problems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this research, a Robin transmission condition enriched frequency-domain discontinuous Galerkin (DG-RTC) method is proposed to solve the electromagnetic problems. The proposed DG-RTC method directly discretizes the vector wave equation in each subdomain, and the numerical flux is used for the information communication of solutions between neighbor subdomains. Compared with the traditional Maxwell’s equations-based DG (ME-DG) method, the proposed DG-RTC method merely solves the E-field in the whole computational region, while the H-field is only present at the interfaces of adjacent subdomains, which thus significantly reduces the number of unknowns. Moreover, the finalized globally coupled matrix equation is split into a number of small local matrix equations pertinent to each subdomain, a finite-element tearing and interconnecting (FETI)-like procedure is developed. In this way, the direct solver PARDISO can be applied to solve them with trivial cost in a parallel way. In addition, for efficient wideband analysis, the asymptotic waveform evaluation (AWE) is incorporated into the subdomain DG-RTC solver, where merely a few points need to be evaluated in a broadband. Finally, to benchmark the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed algorithm, a microstrip transmission line and a SIW filter are investigated.

articleTitle: Frequency Beam Scanning Antenna Based on the Quasi-Coplanar Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a frequency beam scanning antenna based on the quasi-coplanar waveguide is proposed. The proposed design is employed by a quasi-coplanar waveguide (Q-CPW) line with periodic holes etched on its middle line to generate frequency scanning wave. The antenna is operated based on the higher-order modes of the spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs). Simulation results show that the bandwidth of the proposed antenna is about 100% (from 6-18 GHz for |S<inf>11</inf>|<-10 dB). Moreover, the scanning angle can reach 99° with an average peak gain level of 12.89 dB. The proposed Q-CPW-based frequency scanning antenna is beneficial to design the array structure, which can find potential applications in planar integrated communication systems.

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable Frequency Selective Absorber Based on Liquid Metal
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a reconfigurable frequency selective absorber based on liquid metal (LM) has been proposed. The unit cell consists of two layers, and two polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA) substrates with different channels are located on the upper and bottom layers respectively. By changing the filling of LM in the channels, this design can switch between absorption, transmission, and reflection around 5.1 GHz, while maintaining the absorption performance on both sides of the reconfigurable frequency band.

articleTitle: An Efficient Robust Adaptive Beamforming Based on Eigenvalue Decomposition and Interference Steering Vector Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This work has presented a unique robust adaptive beamforming (RAB) algorithm that improves the adaptive beamformer’s robustness. Firstly, the steering vectors of signal-of-interest (SOI) has been estimated by the eigenvalue-decomposition method. Then, using the estimated steering vectors (SVs) of the interference, we reconstructed the interference-plus-noise covariance matrix (INCM). The advantages of our algorithm can be well demonstrated in simulation results.

articleTitle: Ultra-Broadband and Dual-polarized Antenna with High Isolation for LTE Base Station Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An ultra-broadband and dual-polarized antenna for LTE (1700~2700 MHz) base station applications is proposed in this paper. The proposed antenna consists of the radiators, feed structures, and reflector. Specifically, the radiator has a pair of crisscross dipoles to realize dual-polarized. Each dipole is fed by a Y-shaped microstrip stub, which is directly fed by a coaxial cable. The simulated results by HFSS show that the antenna has the operating bandwidth of 1.72~2.72 GHz for S11<−10dB, and an average isolation of 30dB. Besides, the half-power beam width (HPBW) of the antenna is around 75°, and the gain of the antenna has an average gain of 8.5 dBi.

articleTitle: A Novel Wideband Dual-polarized Magneto-electric Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband antenna, designated as the dual-polarized magneto-electric dipole was proposed. A novel crossed $\Gamma$-shaped feeding strip is presented to decrease the cross-polarization. The simulation results indicate that this antenna has wide impedance bandwidth of 42%, stable radiation pattern with low cross-polarization.

articleTitle: An Equivalent Circuit Modeling Method of Near-field Probe Based on Vector Fitting Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, based on vector fitting (VF) algorithm, a precise equivalent circuit modeling method of a near-field probe with the bandwidth of 500MHz~1.5GHz can be constructed. Based on the S-parameters and the impedance magnitude/phase curves from the near-field probe and the related equivalent circuit model, the validity and flexibility can be demonstrated.

articleTitle: Composite EM Scattering from Targets located above Rough Ground Surface Covered by Vegetation Based on SBR-VRT Hybrid Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A SBR-VRT hybrid method combining the bouncing ray method (SBR) and the vector radiative transfer equation (VRT) is proposed in this paper. The basic idea of the hybrid method is illustrated. The composite scattering of a tank located above a rough ground surface covered by vegetation is calculated. The influence of different incident wave frequencies on the composite scattering results is discussed. By comparing the simulating results in the S-band and L-band, it can be found that: the values of ground scattering and composite scattering are in general agreement when the incident angles less than 10°. With the increasing of the incident angle, the total scattered coefficient decreases firstly and then increase, which reaching an interval peak at 25°, and finally decrease.

articleTitle: Scattering Center Modeling for Narrow Serrated Groove
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The narrow serrated groove at the joint of a stealth aircraft produces strong scattering fields when illuminated by radar. It compromises the overall stealth effect of the aircraft. This impact from the groove needs to be carefully considered when designing aircraft for radar cross section (RCS) reduction. Based on the scattering model of an infinite narrow rectangular groove, this paper proposes a scattering center model of a narrow serrated groove. This model can be used for fast simulation of its RCS, and the results are compared with the results of the full-wave numerical method.

articleTitle: Prediction of Metasurface Transmission Spectrum Based on An A-CNN-LSTM Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper employs an attention based convolutional neural network long short-term memory (A-CNN-LSTM) approach for the prediction of metasurface transmission spectrum. By inputting the pixel map of the metasurface structure, the trained A-CNN-LSTM model can quickly output corresponding transmission spectral data. The experimental results for different metasurface structures show that the A-CNN-LSTM has higher accuracy compared with the traditional CNN and CNN-LSTM models. And they agree well with traditional FDTD software simulation but can be much faster.

articleTitle: Band gap analysis of graphene-plasmonic photonic crystals based on Gaussian beams
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a composite periodic structure of graphene-plasma photonic crystal based on a Gaussian beam is designed. The transmission coefficient of graphene-plasma photonic crystal is calculated by using the modified transmission matrix method. Combined with COMSOL finite element software, the effects of plasma parameters and structural periods on the photonic band gap are analyzed. The results show that with the increase of electron density, the band gap widens and deepens, and the band gap center moves to high frequency. In addition, with the increase in the number of periodic structures, the position and width of the first photonic band gap are slightly affected, but the overall band gap transmittance will decrease. Therefore, compared with ordinary dielectric photonic crystals, graphene-plasma photonic crystals have more tunable parameters to control the photonic band gap, which provides a theoretical reference for the study of intelligent regulation of photonic crystals.

articleTitle: A Novel Structure of Magnetoelectric Antenna Based on Multiferroic Materials
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel structure of magnetoelectric (ME) antenna based on multiferroic materials is proposed in this paper. The structure consists of two layers. Its bottom layer and top layer are made of piezoelectric material and magnetostrictive material respectively, and a tapered slot is designed on the top layer. The easy axes of magnetization of the two areas of magnetostrictive material are antiparallel. The ME antenna with this structure has different near-field radiation characteristics from the reported ME antennas, and shows directional radiation characteristics.

articleTitle: Wide-View Association of 3D Scattering Centers Based on Muti-Manifold Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The existing 3D wide-view scattering centers (SCs) association methods have low accuracy and poor robustness for complex targets. Therefore, a new wide-view association method of 3D SCs based on multi-manifold clustering is proposed. Firstly, target 3D SCs at different angles are extracted using the shooting and bouncing ray (SBR) technique. Then accurate muti-manifold clustering of target SCs is achieved in high dimensional feature space. Simulation results show that 3D wide-view SCs belonging to the same local structure in complex targets are efficiently associated and separated. The proposed method can be used to construct 3D wide-view SC models for complex targets and is able to support the application requirements of scattering data compression and reconstruction, target feature extraction and recognition.

Author Keywords: the shooting and bouncing ray technique

articleTitle: Detailed Features Modeling of Vibrating Wing’s Micro-Motion Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Wings of flying targets vibrate due to the influence of external factors. This phenomenon is more pronounced for large wings and there will be detailed features that affect the micro-motion characteristics. The electromagnetic scattering characteristic of this kind of micro-motion of wings in actual flight is of great significance to target recognition and identification. This paper focuses on the modeling and analysis of the micro-motion characteristics and detailed features due to vibration and deformation. Firstly, the mathematical geometric model of wing vibration was established. Then the according to scattering field is simulated, and a time-frequency analysis was performed on the results. Micro-Doppler features different from conventional results were observed in the result. Starting from the detailed feature in spanwise, chordwise, and airfoil, the vibration modeling study of wings was carried out. Eventually, it was found that the twist of the airfoil caused this phenomenon.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Non-Equiripple All-Pole Ladder Filters Using Darlington Network Synthesis Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This conference paper presents a synthesis method for realizing non-equiripple lowpass prototype all-pole ladder filters in order to reduce the manufacturing sensitivity. First, the sensitivity analysis using Monte Carlo method is performed in the classic all-pole ladder Chebyshev filter and coupling matrix. Then, the characteristic functions of fourth-order non-equiripple all-pole filters can be derived readily, while the fifth-order or other higher orders can be derived by using Newton iteration method. Next, the lowpass prototype element values of ladder networks can be determined using Darlington network synthesis method. A series of such element values have been tabulated in this conference paper.

articleTitle: Design of 3D Printed Coaxial Sleeve Bandpass Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a new design concept of coaxial sleeve bandpass filter (BPF), which is based on two different resonators. The first resonator is a dual-mode coaxial cavity achieved by adding a sleeve to a conventional coaxial metal post, while the second one is a single-mode resonator. By cascading them together, the fundamental modes of two cavities are used to form a passband. This special configuration and port position can introduce two transmission zeros above the passband, which leads to high selectivity. To verify the design concept, a BPF operating at 2.06GHz with the bandwidth of 160MHz is designed and simulated.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Dual Antenna Pair Suitable for 5G MIMO Mobile Terminal with Metallic Bezels
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a dual-band dual antenna pair suitable for 5G mobile terminal with metallic bezels. The proposed antenna consists of a split on the metallic bezel and a slot on the main ground plane. Two orthogonal modes are excited through a Y-shaped feeding network and an end-shorted microstrip line. The proposed dual-band dual antenna pair with the volume of 25$\times7\times$2.5 mm3 operates at partial N78 and N79 bands of 3.3~3.6 GHz and 4.6~5.0 GHz. The simulated results show that the -6 dB operation bands are 3.30~3.62 GHz and 4.6~5.0 GHz for the slot mode, and 3.30~5.06 GHz for the in-phase current mode, the isolation is better than 19.4 dB, and the envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) is lower than 0.017 without any external decoupling structure. The average total efficiencies are better than -1.7 dB for the slot and -0.7 dB for the in-phase current. The proposed dual-band dual antenna pair exhibits a great potential to be applied in 5G MIMO mobile terminals.

articleTitle: The Design of Sparse Wideband Conformal Array in Wide Angle Scanning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the paper, a ultra-wideband sparse conformal array is proposed. The antenna array adopts a low-profile Vivaldi antenna element. The profile of the antenna is reduced from 110mm to 64mm by optimizing the radiation slot. The feeding adopts a transform from microstrip to slotline feed structure. The Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolutionary Strategy (CMA-ES) Algorithm is exploited into the design of sparse conformal array. Using peak sidelobe level in wide angle scanning as the fitness function, we convert the synthesis problem into an optimization problem, which is solved by CMA-ES. Finally, numerical examples illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Four-antenna System Design Based on Characteristic Mode Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the development of communication technology, multi-antenna systems are in demand in mobile handsets. In this work, a four-antenna system is designed relying fully on the metal frame of the handsets, providing high isolation and low correlations. Based on a given platform and the feeding of the first antenna, the locations of the other feedings are calculated based on theory of characteristic modes, and then applied in full wave simulations for validation. The proposed antenna system covers the 2.4 GHz WLAN band with an isolation of above 15 dB and correlation of below 0.0155. The proposed method is suitable for designing uncorrelated antennas on any predefined platform.

articleTitle: A Low RCS Slot Antenna Array Based on Polarization Conversion Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This Aiming at the problem that the radar cross section (RCS) of the traditional slot antenna array is too large, a new type of antenna is proposed that uses the polarization conversion metasurface (PCM) to reduce the radar cross section (RCS) and maintain the radiation characteristics of the slot antenna array. The wideband RCS reduction of the antenna is achieved without compromising the antenna performance. The PCM is placed on the upper surface of the slot array antenna and functions as an RCS reduction. The performance of slot antenna array loaded with PCM is analyzed. The impedance bandwidth of the antenna is 9.06-10.72 GHz, and the relative bandwidth is 16.6%. Under the impact of the normal direction plane wave in the wide frequency range of 8~12GHz, the single-station RCS is reduced by more than 8dB, and the maximum reduction amount reaches 21.5dB, achieving good radiation performance and scattering performance.

articleTitle: Comparison of Simulation and Measurements of Time-Domain Field-to-Line Coupling in Bounded wave Simulator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of time-domain electromagnetic pulse coupling to single wire. A field-to-line coupling model was established. The simulation is performed using the uniform plane wave excitation defined by measured high-altitude nuclear electromagnetic pulse (HEMP) field signal, the induced currents of two load terminals are simulated. The validation measurement of single wire above the grounding plate is conducted in the bounded wave simulator. The frequency response of the actual coupled current signal monitoring system is considered in the data preprocessing. The comparison between simulation and measurement results show that the peak amplitude and waveform can coincide well.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Design of a New Class of High-Performance Miniaturized Multiport Filtering Power Dividers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, synthesis and design of a new class of high-performance compact multi-port filtering power dividers (FPDs) is presented, based on the fully co-shared coupled resonant scheme. The transversal topology is explored as the initial topology in the synthesis process and ready to be transformed by similar transformations to attain a desired topology with high-performance filtering power division response. Meanwhile, based on power wave definition and the characteristic polynomial representation, such as this class of the FPDs freely match to arbitrary source and load impedance or power division ratio. For verification, two high-performance compact three-way FPD examples with different miniaturized topologies are synthesized and validated with provided design procedure.

articleTitle: A Prediction Model of HPEMP Effect for Vehicles Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a CNN (Convolutional Neural Network)-based prediction model for the HPEMP (High Power Electromagnetic Pulse) effect of ground vehicles, which is used to predict the composite scattering problem of the lower half space and the vehicle above when ground reflections are considered. This method overcomes the traditional Numerical methods are limited by high computational demands and complex half-space environments. The CNN prediction model in this paper provides a reference for evaluating the HPEMP effect of targets on complex half-space media.

articleTitle: A Novel Pointview of Independent and Identically Distributed Random Data In AI Electromagnetics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Advanced development in deep learning has been drawn a great attention to almost all applications, e.g. computer vision, natural language processing, autonomous vehicle driving, etc.. labeled training data plays the most important role in deep learning. Due to vision-based property of deep learning, the penetration of electromagnetic wave is not really suitable for the total solution by using current version of deep learning. In this paper, we introduce independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) random data in electromagnetics and investigate how to sample training data in EM simulations and tests.

articleTitle: Modeling of Short-Wave Propagation in the Anisotropic Ionosphere using Parabolic Equation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a parabolic equation model for predicting short-wave (SW) propagation in the anisotropic ionosphere. In this model, the influences of the geomagnetic field are described by integrating a double-refractive index. As a result, the refraction, absorption, and anisotropy of ionosphere are fully considered. Numerical examples are presented, and the time-frequency characteristics, double-refraction phenomenon, and the non-reciprocity of the ionosphere are analyzed by using the presented model. The simulation results are beneficial to the designs of sky-wave communication links.

articleTitle: Design of a Wideband Compact L-band 5-bit MMIC Phase Shifter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the design of an L-band 5-bit monolithic microwave integrated circuit (MMIC) phase shifter using 0.25-μm GaAs pHEMT processes is presented. In small phase-shift bits, an improved low-pass/resonator is adopted in order to achieve the miniaturization of chip size. The proposed phase shifter achieves a phase resolution of 11.25° with an rms phase error of less than 6.6° and an insertion loss (IL) less than 8.1dB from 5-7.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Polarization Conversion and Beam Separation Based on All-Dielectric Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An all-dielectric phase gradient metasurface is proposed, which consists of a periodic array of elliptical silicon nanopillars with a phase difference of $\pi$ on a quartz substrate. The polarization and transmission characteristics of the unit half-wave plate structure are comprehensively studied, and the simulation results show that its transmission efficiency in multiple communication frequency bands can reach 98%, and the polarization conversion efficiency can reach 90% $\sim$ 99%. Furthermore, we arrange the half-wave plates as a periodic integrated supercell array, which realizes the polarization conversion and spatial separation of the beams. he proposed all-dielectric metasurface offers a strategy for creating compact, integrated and high-performance plasmonic multifunctional devices.

articleTitle: Wide-Angle Polarization Conversion Metasurface and Its Application to RCS Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A wide-angle polarization conversion metasurface (PCM) is proposed in this article. The proposed PCM comprises a metal cut-wire array printed on a substrate, and a vertical periodic crossed cut-wire array which consists of orthogonal metal grating in front of the cut-wire separated by a dielectric spacer. The vertical periodic crossed cut-wire array is inserted between the planar array and the metal ground to improve the wide-angle polarization conversion. The artificial electromagnetic structure for angular responses is described with simulation results and electromagnetic response behaviors. At quasi-normal incidence, the simulated bandwidth characterized by more than 90% polarization conversion ratio (PCR) is 12.3~18.3 GHz, i.e., a fractional bandwidth (FBW) of 39.2%. At the incident angle of 60^°, the FBW of the PCR larger than 80% is 57.6%. The PCM is thin with a thickness of 3 mm, corresponding to 0.108 $\lambda_{0}$ at the lowest operating frequency. In addition, the designed PCR is applied to wide-angle radar cross section (RCS) reduction. The simulation results demonstrated that our proposed structure provides an effective way to achieve wide-angle responses.

articleTitle: Analytical Formulation for the Quantum Radar Scattering of the semi-Cylinder Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the photon backscattering of quantum radar from the semi-cylinder surface is considered. A uniform and analytical solution derived from an asymptotic evaluation of the high-frequency approximation is shown. So, for a typical monostatic scene, you can analytically calculate the QRCS for different elevation angles. Finally, we also analyzed the scattering mechanism difference of the analytical formulations between QRCS and CRCS the semi-cylinder surface.

articleTitle: Finite Element Method for Solving 1-D Boundary Value Problem
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Finite element method (FEM) is a numerical method for solving boundary value problem. The purpose of FEM is to solve partial differential equation (PDE) with specific boundary conditions. It is firstly applied in solid mechanics, and later extended to fluid mechanics, heat transfer, electromagnetism and so on, which is involved to the physics field problems. This paper will discuss applying three different methods to obtain the corresponding approximate solutions from a solvable differential equation. It is proved that the result from Galerkin method is the closest to the exact solution by comparing with the exact solution.

articleTitle: A Wideband Dual Layer Frequency Selective Surface Shielding Screen
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A dual layer polarization and incident angle insensitive frequency selective surface (FSS) with wideband feature for electromagnetic shielding is presented in this paper. A single layer FR4 dielectric substrate is attached both sides with periodic copper pattern. The front layer comprises of combined square and circle loop and the background layer comprises of combined circle loops and strips. The proposed FSS exhibits a 11.2 GHz ultra-wide stop band response from 4.3 to 15.5 GHz. Because of the symmetry of the structure, the FSS is polarization insensitive. Numerical computation validates the incident angles stability up to 60° in TE modes.

articleTitle: Equivalent Electromagnetic Parameter Inversion of Honeycomb Structures Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We present in this paper an effective BP neural network-based method for the equivalent electromagnetic parameter inversion of honeycomb structures. The BP neural network is trained using radar cross section (RCS) of different honeycomb structures and the equivalent dielectric constants of the honeycomb as the input and output variables, respectively. To simplify the sample data generation and reduce the dimension of output variables, the Hashin-Shtrikman (HS) variational theory is used to homogenize the honeycomb structure as homogenous materials. The hybrid finite element-boundary integral-multilevel fast multipole method (FE-BI-MLFMA) is used as the solver for scattering problems after homogenization. Numerical results show that the trained high-quality network model can achieve good accuracy, which provides an effective way for predicting equivalent electromagnetic parameter of microwave absorbing honeycomb structures.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Direction Finding Based on Time-Modulated Array with Double Long Baselines and Spectrum Harmonic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel two-dimensional direction-finding method is proposed based on time-modulated array (TMA) and spectrum harmonic analysis. Four antenna elements and double long baselines are meticulously arranged to form a TMA arm. Two TMA arms modulated by the radio frequency switches are placed vertically to form an L-shaped array. The azimuths and elevations of incident signals are first estimated independently using two TMA arms and then automatically paired through spectrum harmonic analysis. Thus, the two-dimensional direction of arrival can be accurately obtained. The proposed method has high precision and low complexity, and the utility is demonstrated through theoretical analysis and numerical simulations.

articleTitle: A Design of a multi parameter reconfigurable array antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A circularly polarized patch array antenna with frequency reconfiguration, radiation pattern reconfiguration and polarization reconfiguration is designed in this paper. By adjusting the capacitance of the varactor between the circular radiation patch and its parasitic patch, the frequency can be reconstructed. At the same time, the perturbation capacitance can be adjusted to realize the conversion between the left-hand circular polarization and the right-hand circular polarization. By switching the feed probes of four array elements, the radiation beam of the array antenna can be dynamically configured in five directions.

articleTitle: Measurement of Permittivity of Air-Chaff Mixture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The extraction method for permittivity of chaff is rarely addressed in previous works. In this paper, a permittivity measurement strategy for typical chaff is presented based on the waveguide method. Initially, the relationship between scattering coefficients and permittivity is derived according to the Nicholson-Ross-Weir (NRW) theory. Next, the scattering coefficients of the chaff are measured using the presented method. Furthermore, a material named expanded polystyrene is adopted as a substrate to reduce errors of measurements. To verify the method proposed in this paper, the experiments are performed and show that the proposed method can predict the permittivity of the chaff accurately. Finally, the permittivity of the air mixture of chaff which contains chaff elements with different diameters, quantities, and positions are evaluated experimentally. The effects of different conditions on the permittivity are given.

articleTitle: Mechanically Tunable Lowpass Filter in Form of Suspended Substrate Stripline
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A mechanically tunable lowpass filter is proposed in this paper, and the main part of the filter is a suspended-substrate-stripline-based high/low impedance lowpass filter. The tunability is introduced by applying a movable lid with several metal ribs. When the lid is moving, part area of each high or low impedance section will be overlapped by corresponding rib, and the total inductance/capacitance will be tuned, resulting in a continually tunable cutoff frequency of a lowpass filter. The designed tunable lowpass filter has a tunable range of the cutoff frequency from 0.64 to 1.1 GHz. Along with the tunable cutoff frequency, the insertion loss keeps to be less than 1dB and the return loss remains better than 10 dB. The simulated and measured results, which are in good agreement, have verified the performance of the proposed filter.

articleTitle: Generation and Applications of Spatiotemporally Modulated Vortex Beams
publicationTitle: 2022 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Among all technologies that have the potential to be used in the next generation of wireless communication, spatiotemporally modulated metasurface and electromagnetic vortex beam show great potential for increasing channel capacity. In addition, it is found that the rotational Doppler effect, a phenomenon unique to orbital angular momentum carrying beams, has the capability to detect spinning objects by measuring harmonic shifts. The rotational Doppler shifts can also be applied in harmonics manipulation. However, the research on spatiotemporally modulated vortex beams is in its early stage. To date, only the mode reconfigurable vortex beam is studied, the design of vortex metasurface and applications of spatiotemporally modulated vortex beams are yet to be explored further.
